chapters.title: Chapter 701 The Evolutions
paragraphs: [You have eliminated a player!]
[You have obtained the Beast Surge Ascension path!]
[You have obtained the ability Domain!]
[Merging the Beast Surge Ascension path with your body!]
Several messages flashed before Vritra right as he was about to start the battle.
He felt the change in his body, as information appeared in his mind and the ascension path started to merge automatically with him.
'Looks like this doesn't need any additional time.' Vritra thought, letting the change happen.
"What's wrong, honey?" Vanessa and the others paused too, looking back at him.
"I just got the rewards of killing that pig, let me try how it will work." He answered.
"Alright, the stage is all yours, hubby." Yasmine said, smiling.
After waiting for a few minutes, the merging process finally ended and Vritra now had three ascension paths.
He decided to try the Domain and the Beast Surge ascension path, wondering what exactly would happen.
[Domain Activated!]
As soon as the ability activated, a big domain made of blood appeared around them, it was eerie and gave a deadly feeling.
Vritra activated blood manipulation and just sent a blood blade flying forward, using a little bit of energy.
Yet, the domain amplified the attack, turning it at least thrice as powerful as it sliced into the body of a beast.
So it strengthened his abilities and physical attributes.
"And I think Beast Surge is somehow related to Morgan's ability to turn others into his puppets."
Vritra gave it a try, as blood threads spread around rapidly, connecting straight with the heads of the beasts.
The Beast Surge seemed to resonate perfectly with the domain and his blood manipulation.
And in less than ten seconds, Vritra was able to control the minds of a hundred beasts.
"Not bad, this will come in handy." He mumbled, impressed by the skills.
And even with such skills, Morgan was still so weak? Well, probably because he was avoiding entering the dangerous areas and was locked in a rather safer city.
In any case, Vritra would have to increase his strength as much as possible so they could go straight to the tower, directly killing the ten players and win this game.
And while they were here in the beast cave, they were safe from the protector of the world bank and the administrators of this game.
So it was a win win.
Finally, Vritra took out the red pill that Evelyn had handed him, he hesitated for a few moments.
'Divine, it is fine right?' he asked.
"Yes, you should know by now, she won't ever hurt you. It is partly because of her that you had survived until now." He replied, lying on a comfortable bed and enjoying his rest.
'Alright.' Vritra nodded and ate the pill right away, swallowing it down.
As soon as he did, his eyes began to emit a dim red light and immense energy started to burn into his veins and muscles.
It was like he was brimming with stamina and energy.
"Let's start!" Vritra gave a shout, as he rushed forward.
Dual blades appeared in his hands and madness appeared in his mind, only one thought to kill remained.
KSSHH
With a swing of his right hand, Vritra vertically tore a beast in half before punching the belly of another, blasting it to pieces.
His body moved like a blur, rushing in all directions so quickly that none of them could even follow him.
The beasts, even while continuously growing, were completely helpless against this monstrous human.
Waves of blood spikes rose in all directions, pinning the beasts into the ceiling, as he continued his slaughter.
The other nine were completely baffled by the scene, what were they even supposed to do here?
He was really like a killing machine, moving at full speed continuously without getting tired at all.
"Uh... Let's just select a different corner and start." Maeve mumbled, she merged with the shadows and disappeared.
The others followed as they moved further away from Vritra and started to fight the beasts.
Thankfully, there was no shortage of these creatures, no matter how many they killed more kept spawning.
All the women also started to slaughter them, their strength increasing rapidly.
Onest was running around while slashing their feet, his body was on constant auto dodge.
While Shitless turned into a metal man and just smashed into all the beasts.
And so the one sided slaughter began.
Thanks to the shields given by Evelyn, not a single attack was able to hurt any of them.
So, Vritra and the others were able to surpass the speed of growth of the beasts.
He kept using the sin points to get more attribute points and allocated the free attributes to balance them all out.
Unlike Vritra, the others took short rests, entering the circle which had no side effects.
While he continued with the endless slaughtering, it was much like the scene from back then.
Just more aggressive.
Thanks to Evelyn's help, their strength would grow faster and they would be able to clear this cave earlier than expected.
The beasts kept spawning hour after hour, thousands and hundreds of thousands of them.
It really seemed as if there was no end to them.
As Vritra's stats all reached 1000, he had reached the point of breakthrough.
And to evolve, he needed to evolve all three ascension paths, which was rather easy with the sin system.
After collecting enough sin points, he just used them to upgrade his ascension paths.
And entered the second round of evolution, and then killing the beasts became even easier though the beasts also reached that point soon.
Vritra was now controlling exactly 300 beasts to fight against their own kind, even the Domain, blood manipulation and Evomorph skill had gotten stronger.
His arms turned into big deadly blades, his body adjusting to give him the maximum speed as he flashed and beheaded beasts quickly.
Days passed, and the others too reached that point, Vritra spent more sin points and helped them all upgrade their ascension paths.
And soon they too had entered the second phase of evolution, going past 1000 attribute points, of course theirs weren't as full as Vritra's.
Still, compared to everyone else, they were still better with high stats in all attributes.
Even spiritual attribute was not a weakness among them.
While Vritra was continuing to slaughter, the women ate quickly and after a rest, they joined again.
Vritra allowed Yasmine to fight for some time but she was resting more often than the others.
She accepted it, despite everything it wouldn't be good if something happened to their baby.
Days blended into weeks and soon over two weeks had passed, with nothing but mindless slaughtering.
The cave was covered in the stench of blood and death, corpses lying all over the place.
Vritra used blood manipulation to throw them away, so they didn't block his path.
Even after fighting continuously for weeks, he didn't feel tired or hungry, that pill was really a great treasure.
By the sixteenth day, all the eggs on the walls and ceiling had been broken and not a single beast was left alive.
Vritra and the others had finally cleared up the beast cave, killing so many of the dangerous creatures.
By the end, those things had become so much more dangerous.

chapters.title: Chapter 702 The Ninth Evolution!
paragraphs: "Finally, we are done, I am tired of this stench. It's so frustrating to eat here." Shitless complained.

"Right, I haven't even been able to sleep properly with all the noise around, sigh look how dark the circles under my eyes became. I look like a fucking Shitless!" Onest said, seeing his handsome face getting ruined.
"You mugger, why did you look at me while saying that and use my name?! Are you looking for a fight, huh? Huh?"
And as usual, the two started to quarrel.
Finally after more than fifteen days, Vritra was resting, although the pill gave him an endless amount of stamina and energy but finally the exhaustion was catching up to him.
Though with his current strength, it was nothing big, just a sleep and he would be fine.
Chuckling at their fight, Vritra with his head resting in Yennefer's lap opened the status panel to see his stats.
The numbers were surprisingly big, but he had to spend a lot of sin points upgrading the ascension path or they would have been higher.
[Stats] (Strength: 9,925) (Agility: 9,995)
(Endurance: 9,933) (Spiritual: 9,999) {Free Attribute: 0} 』
{Sin Points: 34} Vritra's strength was close to the tenth evolution, the first was at reaching 100 then 1000, then 2000, 4000, 5000 and so on.
Except at 3000 attribute points.
The others' attributes were lower but they had all reached the ninth evolution, though barely.
Vritra could already control around three thousand creatures at once, this skill had helped him greatly.
He had to thank Morgan for this.
"These three weeks were very intense and full of hardships but it has pushed us far ahead of all the others, I don't think even any player has reached this level yet." Fiona spoke.
She actually enjoyed fighting quite a lot, and enjoying time with Vritra, doing both was just perfect.
Teresa sighed, she had also killed a lot of beasts here, and she had already gotten numb to killing others.
It conflicted with her earlier beliefs but she just put all her faith in Vritra, whatever he said was right.
That's all that mattered.
All of them rested after moving out of the bloodied cave.
"Heh Now I can flatten the land with a single punch. Hey mugger, wanna try fighting me?" Shitless asked, feeling very confident.
Though the entire time, all he did was collide with the beasts and tear them apart.
He didn't really know any fighting techniques, though his defence was terrifyingly high.
Even Vritra would need to hit several times to harm him.
As for Onest, his auto dodge ability and speed had reached the next level too.
"No thanks, you can't even touch me, so what's the point?" Onest said, yawning.
"I wonder how things have changed outside in these three weeks." Maeve mumbled and suggested.
"How about I go out to check the surroundings first?
In the apocalypse we still have to be as careful as possible and there are still those protectors and administrators."
"It's alright, we will be leaving very soon anyway, you should get some rest too."
They set up three tents, one for Vritra and his wives and the other two for Shitless and Onest.
After that last misunderstanding the two refused to stay in the same tent, they didn't want Vritra to think wrongly of them.
"If we go at full speed, I think we can reach the tower in a week or so.
But let's not rush too much, we will still continue with caution, even if it takes a bit more time." Vritra spoke.
"Yes, that's good, we can all reach the tenth evolution phase too maybe." Vanessa spoke.
Fighting alongside her son was far better than them just waiting back in that building.
"Good night, haa we will continue moving in the morning..." Vritra said, hugging Vanessa on one side and Yasmine on the other.
His wives took turns sleeping on either side of him, though Fiona just preferred sleeping on top of him, her head rested over his chest as she closed her eyes.
And soon, they all fell asleep.
The next morning, they all ate a lavish breakfast and lunch and were finally ready to continue.
Walking towards the part they had entered the cave from, they saw that the entrance had been blocked.
"Let me clear that up." Maeve spoke, as the shadows under her feet extended and quickly approached the blocked exit.
Then it pushed and found the weight of the muddy surface to be higher than she expected.
With a slightly harder push, Maeve was able to easily push the blockage away and instantly a large amount of water flooded inside.
Reacting quickly, Yennefer created an air barrier around them, stopping the water from reaching any of them.
"What's going on? Did the city get flooded or something?" the demoness spoke in surprise, sending the shadows to look outside.
And the sight shocked her even more.
"Wait, it really got flooded?!" Maeve exclaimed.
"Let's head outside first." Yennefer said and moved the air bubble forward as the entire cave started to get flooded.
The bubble flew up and soon came out of the downpour of black water.
The sky was covered by thick clouds, heavy rain was pouring down and the whole city was covered by water.
After snow, it was now water which was easily reaching over fifteen feet.
They rose high into the sky, getting out of the water level and instantly noticed the countless mutants in the water.
"Sigh Looks like things have gotten worse here, how are others going to survive in all this?" Vanessa shook her head.
Maybe the best way to save this planet was completing the game, although the lives of the people here didn't matter to them.
And most of the people they had met had been hostile.
Still, it wouldn't be bad to save a few if they could, and it aligned with their final goal anyway.
"Yeah, it seems the gods have increased the difficulty of this game. We should be fine for now, shall we start moving or find more mines?" he asked.
The forbidden zones didn't really pose any threat to them now, and they might hold some attribute stones.
"A few of the forbidden zones are pretty close, we might as well check them out on the way." Yasmine suggested.
"Yes, I also think we should check those places." Maeve chimed in.
"But what if we just end up wasting our time? This time will allow the players to get stronger."
Diana interrupted, after thinking from both sides.
"Hmm that's also true." Vritra nodded.
After some discussion, they decided to just continue.
Even without the attribute stones, they could get attributes from killing the sea mutants along the way.
Although they would need to kill more because of their high stats, there are plenty around.
There were many which were quite strong, with stats over 1k.
And if any forbidden zone or treasure was close, they could check it out.
After making up their minds, Yasmine scanned the surrounding area mentally and then launched powerful spiritual bursts that instantly killed thousands of creatures.
Vritra created a blood cart, big enough with seats and started to move it forward at high speed, at a relatively lower altitude.
Vritra and Yasmine kept launching spiritual bursts every once in a while to wipe out thousands of creatures.
After flying for a few kilometres, they came across a big human base which was fighting against mutants.

chapters.title: Chapter 703 Enemies in front and back!
paragraphs: Vritra and the others were flying over the blood cart, killing thousands of the mutants on their way.
Just as they passed by the centre of the city, they came across a human base which was engaged in a battle against mutants.
Without stopping, Vritra used a spiritual burst to kill all the mutants at once and continued.
He was quite curious to see what would happen after he crossed the 10th evolution.
Is that the limit or are there more stages after that?
He was pretty close to bringing all his attributes to 10,000, and after that he would need a large number of sin points.
Killing these creatures wouldn't increase his stats much, thankfully he could still just purchase the attribute points.
"W- What just happened? How did they all die?" the people in the human base were all baffled, they really thought all of them were going to die this time.
Finally they saw the blood cart, but couldn't see who was on top of it.
"Hurry, return inside the building!" they shouted, and after bowing, all the humans ran back inside.
The flood has really made things difficult for everyone.
"Master, we are close to one of the forbidden zones, if this map is still correct then it should be a kilometre to our right." Maeve spoke, she held a big map in her hands.
"Hmm let's go check it out, but will that place still be fine after this flood?" Vritra wondered.
And there is a high chance these forbidden zones would be of no benefit to them.
These places became forbidden zones because of how dangerous they were, it didn't necessarily mean they would have any treasure.
And this level of difficulty was nothing for Vritra and the group.
"I will just use my shadows to check it." Maeve replied, and Vritra changed the direction of the cart slightly.
"Wait, there are several protectors ahead." Suddenly Divine spoke as the cart came to an abrupt stop.
'Towards the forbidden zone? Why would they be gathered there?' Vritra asked.
"Yes, close to it. It was probably random, or maybe they found some clue to reach you." Divine replied with a shrug.
Vritra just rolled his eyes, he looked at Yasmine and spoke: "Wifey, you know your self proclaimed brother from previous life is an asshole."
"Yeah I do, I don't know why anyone would want to sacrifice themselves to save someone like that." Yasmine shook her head, wondering if she was just stupid in her previous life.
"Ouch Ouch." Divine received several critical blows, he could still handle Vritra's cursing.
But hearing such harsh words from his caring older sister? It hit him like knives slicing through his heart.
"Fine, they have found you, I was just trying not to scare you." Divine said, probably pouting.
"What? How?" Vritra frowned, pondering his next moves.
Despite the increase in his strength, he knew killing a demi god was impossible for him alone.
After all no one in this game was supposed to fight a real demi god, their starting point was zero and even as their strength grows they wouldn't reach the demi god level 0.
"They might have used that memory tracing treasure, and maybe through someone you have met here, they got information about you." Divine added.
'Through Shitless's slave? Ergen?' Vritra wondered, that was the only person who knew a lot about them.
So, through his memory they probably know our goal is that tower, sigh this is troublesome.
They might also be thinking that we would be clearing all the forbidden zones, so not heading there was the right decision.
"What's wrong, dear?" Diana asked, seeing the frown over Vritra's face.
"It's the protectors, they are present near the forbidden zone and might know our general location." Vritra spoke, changing the direction.
"We will take a bit of a detour to avoid them." He added.
"Alright, I wonder how they were able to find us right after we left the beast cave." Vanessa mumbled.
Vritra explained the possible reason, as they quickly approached the boundary of the city, the faster they leave the better.
But just then...
"Wait, there are several administrators surrounding the city." Divine spoke, making Vritra's frown deepen.
'Such a jinx you are, can't you ever give good news?' he complained, but was thankful for the help.
The administrators were here to catch the protectors and remove them from the game.
So normally they wouldn't interfere with the participants of the game.
But Vritra and the others' presence is an anomaly, if anyone noticed anything, then they would be in even more trouble.
And none of them would want to mess it up after fighting tirelessly inside the cave.
The cart came to a stop.
"What's wrong, pitiful one?" Shitless asked after Vritra stopped again.
Vritra sighed and stood up, then walking he flew up and observed the surroundings.
While doing so he explained the circumstances to both of them.
"What?! Outside are administrators and inside are the protectors? What are we going to do?" Shitless panicked instantly.
"We need to make the two parties meet." Vritra mumbled.
He flew higher, as the cart descended towards the water.
"Yenni, hide it for now." He called, as an air bubble appeared around the cart and it submerged into the flood water.
Then sounds of blasts echoed and Vritra sped towards the direction of the forbidden zone.
He could already sense the presence of nine men and with their strength, they too had sensed him.
But Vritra wasn't planning to fight them, he just needed to do one thing and that was to create a big enough explosion.
Energy began to burst out of Vritra's body, as he suddenly transformed into a blood demon, far more horrifying than before.
The surrounding air was covered by a bloody mist, Vritra's body grew rapidly with the Evomorph skill, quickly crossing 100 feet.
The nine protectors sensed it and rapidly approached the gigantic figure which just kept growing.
"This is him, he is our target. We have to bring him back, alive!" one of them spoke.
"But at the rate he is expanding at, he is going to explode. That energy blast will kill him." Another added.
The nine protectors glanced at each other and decided to first stop the explosion then arrest him, it was risky to stay here for too long anyway.
And they had been here for so long already.
[Domain Activated!]
A big semi sphere of blood suddenly appeared around the large monster, as its size rose even more, a dreadful amount of energy filling it.
It grew over two hundred feet, visible even from a big distance, it looked very scary.
Lightning thundered in the sky, dark clouds covering everything as the blood monster expanded more and more.
The administrators standing outside noticed the changes, frowns appearing over their faces.
At this point of time, there shouldn't be anyone, neither player nor mutant or even any human who should have reached that level, especially in this area.
So it was probably the doing of those protectors.
The administrators had to stop this explosion, they couldn't let anyone die because of external intervention.
Both sides approached the red giant, ready to stop it, as the deadly energy suddenly and violently shot up towards the sky.
WHOOSH
The blood monster appeared in the sky and then it just turned into a bloody rain, the energy dispersing as it vanished.
Baffling both sides.

Is that the limit or are there more stages after that?
He was pretty close to bringing all his attributes to 10,000, and after that he would need a large number of sin points.
Killing these creatures wouldn't increase his stats much, thankfully he could still just purchase the attribute points.
"W- What just happened?
How did they all die?" the people in the human base were all baffled, they really thought all of them were going to die this time.

Why would they be gathered there?' Vritra asked.
"Yes, close to it.

"Yeah I do, I don't know why anyone would want to sacrifice themselves to save someone like that." Yasmine shook her head, wondering if she was just stupid in her previous life.

But hearing such harsh words from his caring older sister?
It hit him like knives slicing through his heart.
"Fine, they have found you, I was just trying not to scare you." Divine said, probably pouting.
"What?
How?" Vritra frowned, pondering his next moves.

Ergen?' Vritra wondered, that was the only person who knew a lot about them.

chapters.title: Chapter 704 Smoker
paragraphs: TIP TIP TIP TIP
Blood rain poured over the nine protectors and ten administrators, who stood in bafflement, wondering what had just happened.
The blood giant had just disappeared. Covered in blood, the two sides looked at each other in silence.
Then they came to a realization, their mouths opening as they pointed their fingers at each other.
"Protectors, they are the ones we have to capture!" the administrators shouted.
"Administrators, they are the ones we have to avoid!" the Protectors shouted.
For a moment they both looked up and then down, the blood giant really was just gone.
Then they realized, the protectors thought: 'How cunning, so they did it all to make us reveal ourselves?'
While the administrators felt that these cunning protectors might have set some trap.
After slight hesitation, the administrators finally launched the attacks.
And soon, both sides were entangled in a deadly fight.
Vritra had entered the flood water and fled after pulling that stunt, he quickly joined the others and after entering the air bubble, they quickly started moving.
With his Evomorph skill and blood manipulation, he was able to completely merge into the water, erasing his presence.
"Huff We should be fine for now." He spoke and sat down, that still took a lot of energy.
Only after they were out of the city did they finally come out of the water.
Travelling in the water allowed them to kill even more mutants, and Vritra used all the points to draw rewards, his stats rising quickly.
[Stats]
(Strength: 9,996)
(Agility: 10,000)
(Endurance: 10,000)
(Spiritual: 10,000)
{Free Attribute: 0}
{Sin Points: 3}
'Just a little more...' he thought, his stats have grown to an insane level.
He could literally kill all the mutants, humans or even players with just a slap.
The journey ahead was pretty relaxed.
After travelling for a few more hours and killing a lot of mutants along the way, Vritra decided to stop at a tall building and rest.
Clearing the surroundings and the building, they took rooms on the top floor.
Right as they entered the room, Vritra was instantly surrounded by his wives.
It had been weeks since they did anything, and this only made them hungrier.
Vritra was just as hungry for them, so without wasting any time, wild sex started in the room.
For an entire day straight, Vritra satisfied all his wives, filling them until they were completely exhausted.
Their stamina had grown greatly but they still couldn't handle the pleasure he gave them for long.
But now that Yasmine was pregnant, all of them were even more enthusiastic to receive his seeds.
Only after getting their bellies filled to the brim did they finally stop, enjoying the feeling of the warmth in their bellies.
The group rested, in this time a few creatures attacked the building but Shitless and Onest easily killed them while playing around.
Finally after having lunch together, the group continued for an entire day.
They weren't rushing too fast, and were taking small rests on the way.
After crossing yet another city, a message popped before Vritra.
[Two Players have been detected in this city!]
"More players? Sigh." Vritra sighed, Morgan had caused so much trouble for them already.
And there were two here? But now, none in the group was weak.
"There are two players in this city, be careful. We might have to stay here a bit longer, as it is our objective to kill them."
Vritra announced, it felt like a chore but they had to do it.
After flying for a while, they saw a building on top of which people were fighting.
Not actually fighting, it seemed several men were beating up a small group.
Since he needed to get information and some sin points, Vritra decided to approach the building.
He transformed the cart into a boat and moved it over the water, approaching the building.
"Boss, a strange boat is approaching!" suddenly a man announced, looking down from the roof.
The men at the top were alerted as they all looked down and saw a few people standing on the boat.
"There are women!" the leader of the group exclaimed, he was a man with a buzz cut and slightly overweight.
He was still eating mutant meat while enjoying the sight of his slaves getting beat up.
"Should we go capture them- wait they have stopped near our building keke looks like they will come here on their own." Hunter, the right hand man of the leader spoke.
He was kinda slow mentally and couldn't form plans but was very brutal in fights, everyone was scared of him in the building.
"Boss, let's first check their strength." The left hand man of the boss, called Ribbit spoke.
"Hmm Ribbit is right, the previous time we almost got wiped out when that strange crow like man had appeared here." The boss nodded, blowing smoke out of his nose.
His ability was to make anyone see illusions, that's how he had managed to kill his enemies and take control of all the goons here.
Everyone feared him, he was always smoking, and even while he was sleeping, anyone who approached him ended up dead.
"Let's go and welcome our guests." Ribbit said while rubbing his palms.
"Boss, those women seem to be real beauties, if I kill those three guys, please let me have three of them." Hunter spoke, his face full of lust.
In the apocalypse aside from survival, such criminals only found pleasure in torturing others and women.
"Tsk Two at max, I will get three, and two will be for Ribbit." The boss whose name was Smoker spoke.
"Sigh fine, two are fine but I will be the first to choose!" Hunter said firmly.
"Fine fine, let's go down and greet them, we have to gain their trust first." Ribbit said, grinning as he saw the ten people on the boat hesitate.
"Stop right there! What are you doing here?" the people guarding the lower floors shouted.
But even they were baffled upon seeing the seven women, they were just too beautiful.
Vritra rolled his eyes, in a place where women are already getting extinct, such gorgeous wives of his are certainly going to grab too much attention.
"W- We were just passing by, searching for food when a mutant attacked us and a few of our friends got killed." Onest was the one to speak in a fearful tone.
"Sigh So you are here to loot us?" one of the guards smirked, as he sent someone to inform the boss.
"No no, we don't dare. We were just wondering if you would allow us to rest here for a while, we are all exhausted after a long journey." Shitless spoke, his face and body hidden.
He looked like a mutant after all.
"Hello friends, I am Smoker, and currently I am the leader of this building. I welcome you here, may I know who is your leader." Smoker and the others quickly arrived at the 3rd floor.
With the water level so high, there wasn't much difference between the boat and the third floor.
"It is me, I am called Shitless. If you don't mind, can we spend a day here? W- We can even offer you some food in return." Shitless spoke, though his voice sounded feminine.
'There are eight females?!' Smoker, Ribbit and Hunter looked at one another, their smiles widening.
"Of course, please come inside and we don't even need any fees. We are happy to help others." Smoker spoke with a kind smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 705 Suspicious Activity
paragraphs: "Did you guys come from Riverdel?" Smoker asked with a kind smile on his face, acting like a gentleman.
"Yes, we somehow managed to escape from a dangerous mutant there, but ended up losing most of our male companions."
Sonia spoke, her body covered by clothes completely.
"Oh that's too bad, only by relying on each other can we survive this apocalypse. We have enough food here, you all can stay as long as you want." Ribbit chimed in quickly.
"Also with me here, no mutant could harm you." Hunter added, secretly glancing at all the women.
Seeing them from this distance, they were far more beautiful, those men could barely hide their lust.
"Ah thank you very much, we promise we won't be a burden to you." Onest spoke.
"There are several vacant rooms, you can take them." Smoker said, blowing out a wisp of smoke.
Nodding, the group thanked them again and just entered two of the rooms.
Vritra was with all his wives while Shitless and Onest were in one room.
Seeing this arrangement, the men standing outside were baffled.
"W- Why is that bastard staying with all those women?" someone in the small crowd asked, feeling frustrated.
While some people die of thirst, others are drowning in it.
"No matter what, we will make our move soon. Ribbit, make sure to check out their strength, once we are sure hehe." Smoker said with a big smile.
But just then, the moans of a woman started to ring out of the room.
It was Sonia's moan, the people outside became even angrier.
There were no women in the entire building, it has been months since they last saw a woman, and that too was an old woman.
And these people were enjoying themselves to this degree.
KNOCK KNOCK
Ribbit decided to interrupt them, he knocked and decided to probe their strength.
Vritra sat on the bed in the other room with his wives, he yawned and then lay back.
"Darling, why don't we just kill them instead of wasting time?" Fiona asked, she didn't like those disgusting gazes.
"To extract information of course, let Shitless take care of it." Vritra replied.
"Extract information?" Vanessa repeated in surprise.
"Yes, sir Shitless is good at such tasks. For now, just enjoy your rest, we will continue once we find anything useful."
Vritra replied with a faint smile, then he took Vanessa's arm and pulled her to lie beside him.
"Hmm with their strength, they should be fine." Vanessa mumbled, then hugged her son, cuddling like this was just great.
On the other side, Smoker, Ribbit, Hunter and all the others were standing outside the door.
After a few seconds, the door opened and Onest peeked his head out.
"What is it?" he asked impatiently.
"Um If it's not a problem then can I come inside and-" Ribbit was speaking but he was interrupted.
"It is a problem, get lost now." Onest said before shutting the door hard.
'This bastard!' Ribbit was enraged, who dares to talk to him like that.
'Control, I will deal with him later on.' He consoled himself and knocked again.
"What the fuck do you want?" Onest shouted, peeking his head out.
"Actually, I need to talk to you about something privately, so can I-" before he could finish, Onest's hand shot out and clutched Ribbit's collar and dragged him inside the room.
Everyone outside was shocked, they looked at Smoker to see if they should do anything or just wait.
"L- Let's wait for now." Smoker said with a frown, he trusted Ribbit a lot.
Anyone could betray him, maybe even Hunter, but not Ribbit, even before the apocalypse they had been together.
They were almost like father and son.
"Ahhhh~"
Suddenly, everyone's expressions froze when they heard a moan from inside the room.
Smoker was the one to receive the highest level of shock, Ribbit actually went ahead and started to have fun.
"T- That pig, I said I would be the first to choose among the women!!" Hunter shouted, his body shaking and he just wanted to tear the door apart.
"That son of a bitch, he doesn't even respect his leader. Let him have her, he is only getting one woman and will be the one to go out in search of food alone." Smoker cursed angrily.
Moans continued to ring out from inside, and soon.
"Ahhhhh Fuck N- Not so hard ughhhhh T- Too deep!! Nooooo" suddenly, Ribbit's screams sounded from inside the room, startling everyone outside.
They glanced at each other and gulped, those few words left strange images in their minds.
"B- Boss, is Ribbit fine? M- Maybe we should go help him? I- I didn't know he had such strange tastes..." Hunter spoke, feeling a chill upon hearing the word deep.
So instead of an exit that guy treated his ass as an entrance?
They all felt disgusted, and then more and more of Ribbit's noises rang out, he kept shouting those same words.
Too deep, it's tearing me apart, it's flowing out, not so hard, not two at once, it's flowing...
"Huh? Two? Then the woman and man both have it?" all of them felt a chill.
"I- I think we should leave him alone for now, what do you think boss? He can also test their strength, with the poundin- I mean, his special skills." Hunter suggested.
Hearing this and imagining the stuff inside was pure torture.
Quickly, the people emptied the floor and walked away, they needed to plan how to kill the two men.
They needed to win the trust of the women instead of just forcefully capturing them, that way they would stay here willingly.
As the crowd dispersed, Onest removed his hand from Ribbit's mouth who was tied to a chair with two knives buried deep into his belly, hot blood flowing out.
"You bastards, once they find out, you are all going to die!!" Ribbit shouted with a tear filled face.
They muffled his screams, only letting him say those shameful things, he could imagine what those people must be thinking.
Ribbit's ability was his intelligence, his quick reflexes and fast speed, yet all of that was useless here.
He looked at the beautiful woman who turned into a red mutant, the ugly bald guy was grinning hideously.
Shitless really looked like a terrifying villain, a monster.
Sonia had already used her charms to get some information out of him, and they found out about some crow man.
There was a high chance it was a player.
After torturing him, they didn't get anything else.
"I guess we are done here." Onest said, his arms crossed over his chest.
"What are we going to do with him then?" they both looked at Ribbit who was scared badly.
"SOB p- please spare me, I have a family, I am innocent. I have never SOB h- harmed anyone ughh please I am begging you."
Ribbit instantly started to beg, and the two really felt pity for him.
"I think we should let him go, he doesn't look like a bad guy." Onest said.
"But what if he tells others about us? They will come to hunt us down." Shitless mumbled.
"N- No I won't do it, I won't tell anyone. I will keep silent! I will be your slave, don't kill me!" Ribbit thought, though there was no way he could forgive them.
"Alright we are sparing you." The two nodded.

KNOCK KNOCK
Ribbit decided to interrupt them, he knocked and decided to probe their strength.
Vritra sat on the bed in the other room with his wives, he yawned and then lay back.
"Darling, why don't we just kill them instead of wasting time?" Fiona asked, she didn't like those disgusting gazes.
"To extract information of course, let Shitless take care of it." Vritra replied.
"Extract information?" Vanessa repeated in surprise.
"Yes, sir Shitless is good at such tasks.
For now, just enjoy your rest, we will continue once we find anything useful."
Vritra replied with a faint smile, then he took Vanessa's arm and pulled her to lie beside him.
"Hmm with their strength, they should be fine." Vanessa mumbled, then hugged her son, cuddling like this was just great.
On the other side, Smoker, Ribbit, Hunter and all the others were standing outside the door.
After a few seconds, the door opened and Onest peeked his head out.
"What is it?" he asked impatiently.
"Um If it's not a problem then can I come inside and-" Ribbit was speaking but he was interrupted.
"It is a problem, get lost now." Onest said before shutting the door hard.
'This bastard!' Ribbit was enraged, who dares to talk to him like that.
'Control, I will deal with him later on.' He consoled himself and knocked again.
"What the fuck do you want?" Onest shouted, peeking his head out.
"Actually, I need to talk to you about something privately, so can I-" before he could finish, Onest's hand shot out and clutched Ribbit's collar and dragged him inside the room.
Everyone outside was shocked, they looked at Smoker to see if they should do anything or just wait.
"L- Let's wait for now." Smoker said with a frown, he trusted Ribbit a lot.
Anyone could betray him, maybe even Hunter, but not Ribbit, even before the apocalypse they had been together.
They were almost like father and son.
"Ahhhh~"
Suddenly, everyone's expressions froze when they heard a moan from inside the room.
Smoker was the one to receive the highest level of shock, Ribbit actually went ahead and started to have fun.
"T- That pig, I said I would be the first to choose among the women!!" Hunter shouted, his body shaking and he just wanted to tear the door apart.
"That son of a bitch, he doesn't even respect his leader.
Let him have her, he is only getting one woman and will be the one to go out in search of food alone." Smoker cursed angrily.
Moans continued to ring out from inside, and soon.
"Ahhhhh Fuck N- Not so hard ughhhhh T- Too deep!!
Nooooo" suddenly, Ribbit's screams sounded from inside the room, startling everyone outside.
They glanced at each other and gulped, those few words left strange images in their minds.
"B- Boss, is Ribbit fine?
M- Maybe we should go help him?
I- I didn't know he had such strange tastes..." Hunter spoke, feeling a chill upon hearing the word deep.
So instead of an exit that guy treated his ass as an entrance?
They all felt disgusted, and then more and more of Ribbit's noises rang out, he kept shouting those same words.
Too deep, it's tearing me apart, it's flowing out, not so hard, not two at once, it's flowing...
"Huh?
Two?
Then the woman and man both have it?" all of them felt a chill.
"I- I think we should leave him alone for now, what do you think boss?
He can also test their strength, with the poundin- I mean, his special skills." Hunter suggested.
Hearing this and imagining the stuff inside was pure torture.
Quickly, the people emptied the floor and walked away, they needed to plan how to kill the two men.
They needed to win the trust of the women instead of just forcefully capturing them, that way they would stay here willingly.
As the crowd dispersed, Onest removed his hand from Ribbit's mouth who was tied to a chair with two knives buried deep into his belly, hot blood flowing out.
"You bastards, once they find out, you are all going to die!!" Ribbit shouted with a tear filled face.
They muffled his screams, only letting him say those shameful things, he could imagine what those people must be thinking.
Ribbit's ability was his intelligence, his quick reflexes and fast speed, yet all of that was useless here.
He looked at the beautiful woman who turned into a red mutant, the ugly bald guy was grinning hideously.
Shitless really looked like a terrifying villain, a monster.
Sonia had already used her charms to get some information out of him, and they found out about some crow man.
There was a high chance it was a player.
After torturing him, they didn't get anything else.
"I guess we are done here." Onest said, his arms crossed over his chest.
"What are we going to do with him then?" they both looked at Ribbit who was scared badly.
"SOB p- please spare me, I have a family, I am innocent.
I have never SOB h- harmed anyone ughh please I am begging you."
Ribbit instantly started to beg, and the two really felt pity for him.
"I think we should let him go, he doesn't look like a bad guy." Onest said.
"But what if he tells others about us?
They will come to hunt us down." Shitless mumbled.
"N- No I won't do it, I won't tell anyone.
I will keep silent!
I will be your slave, don't kill me!" Ribbit thought, though there was no way he could forgive them.
"Alright we are sparing you." The two nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 706 The Crow
paragraphs: Vritra slept for a few hours with his wives, and soon they were ready to continue the journey.
Of course first was the task to kill the two players, the only difficulty was finding them.
After waking up, they took baths with the water in their inventory and dressed up into different sets of clothes.
"Let's go and see what Onest and Shitless have found." Vritra spoke, as they all walked out of the group.
Maeve spread her shadows in all directions, she has gotten used to keeping an eye on everything.
KNOCK KNOCK
"Who is it?" a female voice sounded from inside.
"It's me." Vritra said, rolling his eyes.
"Oh welcome, pitiful one!" Shitless said, standing there with a big smile.
"So what did you find?" Vritra asked, his gaze moving towards the window which had blood stains.
Ribbit was still hanging outside the window, his mouth was stuffed with Shitless's socks, arms broken.
He could do nothing.
"Just throw him out in the water, feed the mutant creatures." Diana walked closer to the window and with a flick of her finger added poison to his body.
"Alright!" Shitless nodded and cut the rope tied around his feet.
"Mmm! MMphhh!!" he tried to scream but only let out muffled sounds as his body fell into the water with a splash.
"Huh? Did something fall inside?" the guards there looked down, but they didn't really care.
Ribbit sank into the water, with the chair still tied to him.
"We found that not long ago a crow like man had visited this place and almost wiped out everyone, he was very strong and searching for some guy named Sonic." Onest spoke.
"I see, then let's meet the others and check if they know anything else." Vritra suggested.
The group left the room and headed for the upper floors where Smoker was planning things out with the others.
Vritra no longer wanted to waste time here, torturing such people is fun, but he just wanted to end the game quickly.
A few of the guards were standing in the hallway.
"Are you here to meet the boss?" one of the men asked, though his eyes moved to the group of women.
Vritra sighed, raising his right arm he flicked at the empty air and in the next moment the heads of the guards were crushed in a bloody mess.
The dead bodies fell, creating a blood pool.
"They are all inside, making pointless plans." Vritra muttered, he could clearly see through the wall.
"Wait, let me handle this first." Shitless said, he was enjoying it quite a lot.
He transformed into Sonia and knocked on the door.
One of the men opened the door and was shocked to see Sonia there, he quickly informed his boss about it.
"Whoa, you are the leader of this group?!" Smoker saw the beautiful woman who was hiding her face before.
He looked down at her heavy bosom and drooled, that bastard Ribbit got to spend time with her?
Licking his lips lasciviously, he asked: "H- How can I help you? Do you need food? I have got plenty."
"Yes, can I talk to you in private?" Shit- Sonia asked while biting her lips, her tone sultry.
Shitless has really gotten good at it.
"O- Of course, we can talk in private. You bastards, get the fuck out of here, don't you see I have an important meeting!!" Smoker shouted hurriedly.
'Where is that Ribbit? Did he get exhausted or something? In any case, I am only doing it with her and won't allow that other guy to enter!' Smoker looked at Onest while thinking.
Soon the others were thrown out of the room, while only Shitless and Smoker remained inside.
Vritra looked at the other men, aside from Hunter none of the others had any importance.
He glanced at Vanessa who smiled and nodded.
Instantly they were all consumed by an illusion, Hunter stood silently as all the other men took out their weapons.
In the next second, they all sliced their throats, trembling violently before falling with a thud.
Within moments, all of them were dead and Hunter didn't even notice it.
The room remained silent for a while then Smoker's screams started to ring out.
His illusions weren't going to work on Shitless.
"What happened?" Hunter was startled when he heard the screams, shouldn't the woman be screaming instead?
"Let's enter and check!" he shouted and turned back, only to be horrified to see dozens of corpses with their throats slit.
He was about to activate his skills but was suddenly frozen by the invisible walls.
"So whatever your name is, tell me if you have recently seen anyone very powerful and where he went, or you will be killed too." Vritra spoke slowly, but his voice scared the shit out of Hunter.
"I- I will speak!" Hunter instantly gave in, and gave the same information.
"Alright, good job." Vritra nodded after hearing, then threw him away.
His body smashed into the wall and then was thrown into the flood water.
Soon, Shitless also walked out, carrying a stone.
"Pitiful one, he finally spoke after getting hit a few times. Apparently, the crow man had left this stone behind, telling them to break it if anyone by the name Sonic arrives here."
Shitless said, his body looked metallic, arms covered in blood.
"That was easy, break it." Vritra said, he glanced into the room and saw Smoker's body lying all over the room in pieces.
CRACK
Shitless crushed it instantly, as smoke started to emit from the pieces.
The smoke soon flooded the entire floor and then flew into the sky.
"Let's go up and check, he most probably is the player." Yasmine spoke, killing them has become too easy after the grind.
The group climbed to the roof and waited, and after ten or so minutes, a dark dot finally appeared in the distance.
"He is here." Maeve informed, her gaze focused on the crow like entity.
WHOOSH
As the player got closer, Vritra checked his info.
[You have come in contact with a player!]
[Eliminate him to steal his ascension path and opportunities!]
[Player: Crow]
[Ability: Beast Evolution]
[Ascension Path: Beast Form]
"Crow, let's first see if he knows anything." Vritra waited, and soon the 7 feet tall man arrived above the building.
The flap of his wings generated powerful wind, his eyes scanning the area, he looked like a person with features of a crow.
There was even a beak on his face and black feathers over his body.
"KAW Who are you?" he might have been the first man here who showed no emotion even after seeing those beautiful women.
Maybe his taste was different.
"Are you searching for the other player?" Vritra replied with a question.
"Yes I was but he had already left this city, so why did you call me?!" his voice was dangerous, he was already planning to kill them.
"Where did he go? Do you know the locations of the other players?" Vritra asked.
"..." without speaking, Crow's gaze moved towards Shitless, he glared and questioned:
"You were the one to destroy the stone I gave to that smoke guy, so you killed him. Did he not tell you that this place was under my protection?"
"Oh, so that's what he meant when he was shouting, kaw kaw?" Shitless asked before bursting out laughing.

chapters.title: Chapter 707 The city of ruins
paragraphs: Shitless found his joke pretty funny but not the crow player, he glared at them.
"What was your purpose in calling me here?" Crow asked, flapping his large wings every now and then.
"That's to kill you." Vritra spoke, taking a step forward.
"Oh you seem pretty confident and it seems you know about the players, tsk tsk and you still dared to bring me here? The result is only going to be death!!"
Crow said, letting out a shrill scream as it flew higher, probably to charge for a powerful attack.
Vritra also got ready as blood started to spin around him, one attack would be enough to kill that guy.
But his ability and ascension path were pretty much useless as Vritra already possessed the Evomorph skill.
"Heh Whose death are you talking about?" Onest asked, ready to attack just in case.
"Kaw Of course..." the crow while flying higher looked down and added: "Mine!"
"Huh? Isn't he flying a bit too high? What sort of attack is he planning?" Shitless scratched his head as the crow man flew higher and higher.
He just wouldn't stop, and after reaching a very high altitude, he fled in the same direction he came from.
"T- That fucking bird is trying to escape!!" All of them were surprised, they didn't think Crow would choose to flee even before attempting to fight.
Vritra rolled his eyes, large wings appeared on his back, and with a single flap he flew high, turning into a blur.
WHOOSH
Crow was baffled to see Vritra catching up so fast, and how could that guy fly?
His body started to change rapidly as he transformed into some unknown bird with even higher speed.
Flapping his wings quickly as if life depended on it.
But Vritra was still way faster.
In a couple of seconds, he was flying right beside Crow.
"Hey, how are you holding up?" he asked, flying in a relaxed manner.
While Crow was covered in sweat, exhausting a large amount of his energy.
"KAWWWW, get away from me, I don't know anything!! Don't kill me!!" he shouted, changing his direction suddenly.
But it was useless.
"You don't know about what? Quickly say it or you will suffer far worse than what your leg did." Vritra spoke.
"M- My leg? What do you mean-"
BOOM
Suddenly, his right leg exploded, blood spluttering all around as the crow screamed in pain.
Losing his balance he started to fall down but Vritra just controlled his body through blood and made him freeze in the air.
"Now, tell me about what you don't know." Vritra said, it was better to get as much information as possible.
"Y- You won't KAW kill me if I do, right?" Crow asked fearfully, shaking violently.
The pain was quite bad but he could manage this much pain.
"Yes, I won't kill you if you are Onest, I swear over that Baldy friend of mine." Vritra said with an honest look on his face.
Crow hesitated, but there wasn't any choice really so he quickly spoke: "I- It wasn't me, it was that bastard KAW Sonic, he w- was behind the mass murder of Hankton city."
"SOB I really am innocent, I was just searching for him, he obtained some big powerful treasure and went mad. He annihilated an entire city!!"
Crow spoke quickly, he had sensed already that one of the players had died at Vritra's hand.
And the aura he was releasing naturally, as a beast he was very sensitive to it and sensed what a monster this guy is.
That's why his first instinct was to flee.
"Ah Hankton city is the one we will be heading into, that Sonic guy killed everyone in that city? Sigh." Vritra just sighed.
He pitied the people there, all the kids, men, women, pregnant women were all just killed in that city.
"Thanks for telling me, I will make sure to make him pay extra when I meet him." Vritra said.
"O- Okay, I can leave now right?" Crow asked hopefully.
"No, you are not Onest, so why would I let you go?" After speaking, flames burst out of his hands.
Crow screamed in extreme agony, his body was swallowed by fire, as his fur burned and skin started to melt.
He flailed his arms crying and screaming, dying by fire is considered one of the worst deaths.
And Vritra didn't make it any easier for Crow.
A few minutes later several messages popped before him, and Crow's body was completely burned to a crisp.
Vritra just threw whatever remained away, staring down at the flooded ground.
"Sonic... I will have to look for him." Vritra mumbled, he had already killed two players.
Then he disappeared.
Appearing back in the cart, Vritra sat down and explained what he found to everyone.
"Sonic, hmph these bastards, they have no morals." Onest cursed.
"Hubby, it is what it is, we can't do anything for them. What we can do is kill those gods!" Yasmine said, flames burning in her eyes.
Vritra nodded, those gods will have it coming for them very soon.
There were ten gods, and ten of them, what a perfect match.
All the gods could be replaced, at least the gods in control of their planet.
"Let's continue, there is nothing left here." Vritra said, and after a short chat they all returned to their seats.
The cart flew quickly as Yasmine continued to kill the mutants in the flood water with spiritual power.
Without any stop they flew for hours and exited the city.
And arrived in Hankton city, the land was completely destroyed, not a single building remained standing.
Blood and flesh could be seen all over the buildings which were above the flood water.
Even the mutants in the water were mostly dead, the tragedy had taken place not long ago.
It was very brutal, they were all killed while trying to survive the apocalypse.
They were struggling endlessly only to be killed without even knowing what struck them.
All the families gone.
Since Vritra has a family, he knew how precious family members are, and that's why he pitied all these people.
Looking down, all of them felt bad.
Without any stop the cart continued to fly rapidly, the entire land was badly destroyed.
"How strong is that Sonic guy that one attack was able to destroy the whole place?" Fiona asked.
With their current strength, they could do it too, but the players aren't supposed to be at their level yet.
"Probably the gods have spread various treasures all over the place, some might be too powerful. He might have obtained something good." Vritra said.
They still have to be a bit careful it seemed.
They ate some food without stopping and Vritra increased the size of the cart as they rested in there.
After a long travel they were out of Hankton city, the atmosphere there was really eerie.
But the next city was even stranger, there was no flood water, the buildings were all intact.
Everything seemed so normal as if no apocalypse had appeared there, it was way too peaceful.
Humans were walking around on the roads without a worry, this place looked completely normal.
"Now, what the hell is going on here?" Vritra stopped the blood cart outside the city and spoke in confusion.

The cart flew quickly as Yasmine continued to kill the mutants in the flood water with spiritual power.
Without any stop they flew for hours and exited the city.
And arrived in Hankton city, the land was completely destroyed, not a single building remained standing.
Blood and flesh could be seen all over the buildings which were above the flood water.
Even the mutants in the water were mostly dead, the tragedy had taken place not long ago.
It was very brutal, they were all killed while trying to survive the apocalypse.
They were struggling endlessly only to be killed without even knowing what struck them.
All the families gone.
Since Vritra has a family, he knew how precious family members are, and that's why he pitied all these people.
Looking down, all of them felt bad.
Without any stop the cart continued to fly rapidly, the entire land was badly destroyed.
"How strong is that Sonic guy that one attack was able to destroy the whole place?" Fiona asked.
With their current strength, they could do it too, but the players aren't supposed to be at their level yet.
"Probably the gods have spread various treasures all over the place, some might be too powerful.
He might have obtained something good." Vritra said.
They still have to be a bit careful it seemed.
They ate some food without stopping and Vritra increased the size of the cart as they rested in there.
After a long travel they were out of Hankton city, the atmosphere there was really eerie.
But the next city was even stranger, there was no flood water, the buildings were all intact.
Everything seemed so normal as if no apocalypse had appeared there, it was way too peaceful.
Humans were walking around on the roads without a worry, this place looked completely normal.
"Now, what the hell is going on here?" Vritra stopped the blood cart outside the city and spoke in confusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 708 Magna
paragraphs: "What is this city now?" all of them were confused as they stared at the normal looking city.
"This should be Renko city, how could this place be fine?" Maeve was just as baffled.
"I guess we will have to go in and check."
As the blood cart approached the city, Vritra sensed the presence of an enormous bubble that was surrounding the city.
It was actually keeping all the mutants outside and even the flood water.
"Who are you?" a loud voice reverberated from inside and then several humans appeared in front of them.
They were all flying.
"We want to cross through to the other side." Vritra said, he didn't sense any hostility, only protectiveness.
The men looked at one another, then spoke.
"We will have to go and inform our lord, if you don't have a problem, can you wait here for us?"
"Yes, as long as you don't take too long." Vritra spoke, shrugging, feeling quite curious about this city and the lord.
Could it be another player?
He could only know that after entering the city.
They waited for a while and soon the guards returned, Vritra felt someone observing them from the distance.
He didn't react and just waited.
"You can enter but you will have to wear these rings." The guards said, showing ten black metal rings.
"And what are these?" he asked, as the rings floated out and stopped in front of them, they were being controlled by one of the men.
"These rings are worn by everyone inside the Renko city, it is for your safety and others. If you try to hurt others, you will instantly be teleported out of this bubble." The guard explained.
Vritra nodded as he took the ring.
They all just stored the rings away but to the guards, who were already in an illusion, it appeared as if they had all worn the rings.
"That's good, it seems you are not here to cause trouble." The guards sighed and relaxed.
The bubble opened and the blood cart was allowed to enter.
"Whoa, how is this place so peaceful?" Shitless asked while Vritra was gazing at the message that popped in front of him.
[You have encountered a player!]
'So there really is a player here? Was it the lord they mentioned? Why is he helping these humans then?' he wondered.
"It is all because of our lord, he has been protecting this city for so long. Keeping us all alive and providing us with enough food." The guard spoke with reverence on his face.
"Do we need to go meet this lord of yours or something?" Vritra questioned, he couldn't just digest the fact that a player was actually a good person.
If it's really a good person then he would feel bad about killing him.
If he really kills that player then all the people who have survived here would end up dying.
Since they have stayed in safety, their strength haven't grown much.
"It's your choice, he doesn't force you to anything. You can just leave when you want." The guard spoke with a big smile.
It was almost like they were talking about their god.
"Alright, I would like to go meet this lord of yours." Vritra said.
"Oh good choice, maybe lord might give you some food for your travels." The guard said and one of them led them into the city.
They landed on the ground and sat into two cars, even the vehicles here were working perfectly fine.
Vritra glanced around at all the buildings, at the houses, the people were all relaxed.
There was no panic or fear.
If he really kills the player, won't he be indirectly killing them all?
Vritra hesitated a bit, he took out the black ring from his inventory and observed it.
"Dear, killing the players is one of our missions, but if we kill him, this city will be destroyed." Diana and the others shared the same thought.
It was a hard choice.
"Hmm we will decide that later." Vritra said, he too didn't have any answer for that.
Rolling the black ring between his fingers, they all soon arrived in front of a big luxurious building.
"This is the place where our lord lives!" the guard said, the ride only took like 30 minutes.
"Is he a good guy?" Teresa couldn't help but ask.
"Of course he is, without him, all of us would have been dead." The guard replied.
They got out of the cars, and then the guard gestured for them to follow him into the building.
"These people have come to meet lord." The guard announced and the ones standing there scanned the group.
They were surprised to see the group of women then nodded and ran back into the building.
After a couple of minutes, the guard reappeared and spoke while panting: "You can enter, the lord is currently listening to the problems of his subjects."
Vritra nodded as he led everyone into the luxurious building.
Many people were guarding the place, they were mostly holding guns.
The general strength of the people here was very weak, many were even unawakened.
They passed through a long corridor which was decorated with expensive gems and beautiful paintings.
"This lord guy sure loves to show off." Diana spoke, outside the people were dying and here they lived in such luxury.
"Yeah, if the lord just stays here how does he get strong enough to stop all others?" Vanessa asked.
After passing through the long corridor they arrived in a big hall, it was like they had returned to ancient times.
There was a big throne in the front and several seats on both sides, like in a palace.
Several men dressed in expensive outfits of various cultures sat on the seats and a group of men stood in between.
They were probably here to share their problems.
On the throne sat a handsome man who appeared to be in his late twenties or early thirties.
He was wearing a robe, which exposed his toned muscles.
He sat with one leg over the armrest, leaning back on his throne.
That guy gave off the vibe of a playboy, who is good with women and could never be serious.
Vritra instead focused on his status panel.
[You have come in contact with a player!]
[Eliminate him to steal his ascension path and opportunities!]
[Player: Magna]
[Ability: Steal]
[Ascension Path: Bubble Domain]
'Steal?' Vritra repeated, while Magna scanned over the group, his bored expression instantly disappeared.
"You are the new residents of the Renko city?" he leaned forward, asking with a big smile.
"We are not, anyway are you a good guy? How does this bubble thing work?" Vritra asked.
"Huh?" the lord was baffled, his gaze moving from the women to Vritra.
Upon seeing him he frowned, wondering why this guy looked better than him.
No wonder he has so many women.
Ignoring the question, he asked: "I am the lord of this city and have a lot of food, I am the sole reason this place is safe!"
All the people in the hall instantly bowed before him, showing great respect.
"So do any of you want to join me in my great cause?" Magna asked seriously, he had created a big harem for himself here.
But none of them could compare to these women.

chapters.title: Chapter 709 The Failed Assassination
paragraphs: "So do any of you want to join me in my great cause?" Magna asked seriously.
Vritra rolled his eyes, the audacity of this bitch, proposing his wives right in front of him.
Good or evil, lord or not, he just made a grave mistake.
"Tell me, do any of you want to join my hare-" he was just speaking when a gust of wind struck his forehead, throwing the lord back.
Magna's forehead bled as everyone in the hall stood up in great shock.
Then their gazes moved towards Vritra, his hand was still extended forward, he had just flicked the empty air.
"Lord, are you alright?" several of the men ran forward to help Magna up while the others surrounded Vritra.
"You have a death wish to attack our lord right in front of us!!"
They were ready to attack him.
"Wait COUGH Are they your wives? All of them?" Magna asked as he stood up and wiped his forehead.
"Yeah." Vritra said, his eyes narrowed, ready to erase this guy.
"Ah my bad then, I should have asked first. Sorry haha." he shook his head and actually apologized, leaving Vritra surprised.
"It is fine, everyone return to your seats. Anyway, you sure are strong, do you want to stay here?" Magna sat back on his throne, asking with a smile.
'Good, now if I refuse he will get angry and would force me to stay, the perfect moment to kill him.' Vritra thought and shook his head.
"No I won't, I need to go somewhere else."
"Too bad, this city would be a lot safer with you here. But you are free to do as you please." he said with a shrug.
'What the hell is going on? Aren't all players supposed to be scums? Why is there a good one? Sigh I still have to kill him.' Vritra thought.
Suddenly they were the bad guys who had entered a peaceful city, killed its ruler which would lead to the destruction of the city.
"You can stay here as long as you want, there is enough food and some empty houses. Just don't commit any crimes." Magna spoke.
'I know he is evil, but I just can't prove it.' Vritra thought, his eyes narrowing as he nodded.
Along with the others he stood to the side and decided to observe him for a bit longer.
Magna didn't eye the women anymore and just listened to the problems and solved them.
Soon, the meeting ended, Magna stood up and walked towards Vritra.
"I am Magna, and you are?" he asked while extending his arm.
"I am Einstein." Vritra said, shaking hands with him.
"Oh what a unique name, that's the first time I heard this. So, Einstein where are you going?" the lord asked while gesturing for them to walk out of the hall.
They walked along, Vritra answered: "Towards that big tower, I heard there is a treasure inside. Aren't you going to go there?"
"No, I don't. And I would advise you to not go there either, I heard it's too dangerous." Magna spoke and asked:
"How about I treat you all to dinner today?"
The sky was starting to darken, Vritra looked up and nodded.
He wanted to rest a bit anyway before continuing to the next city.
This was the third player he had encountered, if not for the city, he would have already killed him.
That Sonic guy destroyed an entire city, and if he did so, won't he just be the same?
While chatting, Magna led them towards a royal house.
There were a lot of servants, all of them beautiful maids.
Soon they were sitting around a big table with hot and tasty dishes arranged before them.
All the women were silently observing him too, just waiting for him to show his true colours.
But nothing really happened, he just chatted amiably throughout the dinner and then they left the building.
"Master, let me observe him with the shadows." Maeve suggested.
"Alright foxie, we will leave tomorrow after killing him." Vritra said.
Soon they were brought to an empty building, it was quite well maintained, clean and with some food stored.
Shitless and Onest took two separate rooms, while Vritra and his wives just needed one big room.
The night was long and sleepless, the room was filled with moans, as Vritra embraced his wives throughout the night.
He had left enough space in his belly during the dinner for his favourite milk from his mommy.
And Vanessa was more than happy to feed her son.
It wasn't until four in the morning that they had finally slept.
The sky was still dark, several figures moved in the darkness as they quickly approached the building.
They hid in the shadows, silently approaching, and were soon in the corridor.
"Have you checked it?" one of the ten men asked, his voice a bare whisper.
"Yes, this is exactly where they are staying." another person answered.
"Remember, don't make any sound. We have to kill them all without a sound, as ordered by our boss." the leader of the ten spoke.
They were quite experienced in assassination, so they doubted killing three men and seven women who were sleeping peacefully would be hard.
"It will be fine, why do you think boss chose us? He clearly knows how capable we are." another person added arrogantly.
"And how capable are you?" another voice suddenly sounded from behind him.

"Ha! What sort of question is it even? We are the ones who assassinated the president of this country right as the apocalypse started and then we killed the queen of-" the man was replying but as he turned he noticed that in the darkness stood not ten but eleven figures.
"Who are you?!!" the man almost shouted, startled to the core.
The leader of the group reacted quickly as he launched an attack towards the mysterious guy's head.
CLANG
The blade hit against something and bounced back.
"Who sent you here?" the person asked, appearing calm.
'My attack f- failed?' the leader was shocked, his attack was impossible to defend against especially at such a close range.
It was literally his ability that none of his attacks could miss, or was his defence so high?
He understood that killing this guy would be impossible so he muttered: "Run."
Before jumping back and throwing a strange ball at the figure, trying to flee.
Vritra stepped forward, his gaze locked onto the leader.
Blood tentacles shot in all directions, catching all of the assassins before they could even move away from the building.
"Were you sent here by the lord?" he asked, looking at the ten shocked assassins.
"Aren't you Adam? You are this powerful?!!" the leader was really shocked, they hadn't expected him to be this strong.
"We won't speak no matter what, even if our boss was eyeing those women, we won't tell who sent us or why he sent us here!!" one of the men shouted.
Vritra sighed, these people weren't idiots, anything they spoke might as well be a lie.
'But I have no other enemies here, the last ones who knew me are already dead. Only one player knows about me.' Vritra thought, he was more and more sure that it must be Magna who tried to kill him.
"Tell me!" he spoke, as the head of one of the assassins was torn away.

chapters.title: Chapter 710 Poor Lord
paragraphs: A brutal scene took place as the corpses of the assassins lay in pieces.
None of them were wearing the black ring that everyone in this city was wearing.
He was told that if he even thought of doing anything bad, he would be teleported outside of the city.
Of course Vritra or his family didn't wear those rings, who knows what tricks they might be hiding.
And since these people weren't wearing those rings, there was a high chance they were really Magna's people.
'In any case, that Magna must be behind this. Looks like I will have to go visit him.'
Throwing the corpses dozens of kilometres away, Vritra flew in the direction of Magna's house.
Arriving there within minutes, he kicked open the door, waking the lord with a start.
He was wearing sleepwear and was sleeping with several women surrounding him, most were the maids from earlier.
The women ran away in fear, Vritra didn't bother with them.
"You were the one who sent those assassins to kill me right?" Vritra asked, stopping before Magna.
"W- What are you talking about? I didn't do anything!!" he shouted, looking around as dozens of guards ran towards the room.
Vritra just created a blood shield around them, stopping them from entering.
"I was hesitating but thanks for giving me a reason to kill you." Vritra said, raising his right hand as a blood sword started to form in his hand.
"No wait wait, if you kill me the bubble will be destroyed!! Everyone here will die, I really didn't try to kill you, please believe me!!" he actually began to cry, begging.
"How long will this bubble last without you?" Vritra asked, lowering the sword.
"Only a few months then they all will die."
Seeing hope, Magna spoke quickly, his heart was thumping wildly.
He had seen Vritra's strength earlier in the day, so he didn't even dare to retaliate or even think of anything.
'W- Who the fuck attacked him? Why is he trying to kill me? Why me? I even apologized SOB' Magna was truly confused, he hadn't done anything bad to Vritra.
"That's enough." Vritra said as he swung his hand and cleanly cut off his head, there was still an expression of shock and fear on his face.
Several messages popped before Vritra's eyes, he obtained the ability and ascension path of Magna.
The Bubble and Steal, Vritra read about it. There was not much about the bubble, based on his strength he could create the same bubble.
Which would protect everyone inside from all sorts of things and the duration also depends on his strength.
The Steal was what surprised him.
Those rings were actually being used to steal away all the mutation progress of all the people in the city.
No wonder even without doing anything he was getting stronger.
And so many people in the city were not awakened, even if they ate mutant flesh, all the mutation progress would be stolen instantly.
But he wasn't really harming them in other ways.

"I- I will speak, I will speak. Stop this monster SOB please, don't make him take his pants off, I will tell everything."
He shouted quickly, afraid that Shitless might take out his torturing tool and hit him.
Shitless was confused, he was just going to hit him with the belt, why was this guy so scared?
