chapters.title: Chapter 711 The Prisoners
paragraphs: Vritra had killed Magna after believing that he was the one who sent the assassins.
In fact, these assassins were sent by someone called Asmodeus, as told by the young assassin.
"Hurry up and speak!" Shitless shouted while holding his belt threateningly.
"Y- Yes, our lord Asmodeus ordered them to kill you all because of a divination.
There is someone beside him who told us that you are going to be the reason for his death so..." the young assassin answered.
Vritra clicked his tongue, previously he had the sin system which informed him when someone lied, but now he could only depend on his instincts.
But now that Magna was already dead, there wasn't any point in regretting.
Now that he possessed the Bubble ability, the city would at least be safe for a long time.
As for Asmodeus, they would come face to face sooner or later.
"Where is this lord of yours?" Vritra asked after thinking about several things.
"I- I don't know, really! We were in the next city when our lord made us stay in the Renko city to wait for you." The young man spoke quickly.
"And do you have any way to prove that you all are from the same group?" he asked further.
The assassin looked around at the pieces of the corpses then walked closer to one, he picked up a torn hand and showed a tattoo.
And then displayed the same tattoo over his own arm.
"..." Vritra wasn't really sure, he felt that something was just wrong with the whole situation.
"And what is your ability?" he asked, frowning.
"I uhm I can run really fast." The assassin replied.
"Prove it, go run." Vritra said as a blood rope wrapped around the young guy's feet.
Right as Vritra said, the assassin stood up and ran at full speed, his speed was indeed quite fast.
Just to be sure, Vritra looked at his status panel.
"Onest, for now, just break his arms. We will drag him along, and once we have found Asmodeus, we can let him go." Vritra said.
"That's lord Asmodeus for you- wait and please SOB don't break my arms, I am begging." He shouted.
CRACK CRACK
But without wasting any time, Onest broke both his hands as the guy screamed and cried, then was thrown away after getting tied up.
"The city will be chaotic now that their lord has been killed." Vritra mumbled, a few people had seen him earlier so they might soon come to attack him.
With Vritra's strength, none of them could do anything, the people here were too weak after all.
He sighed at all this mess up, but what was done was done, he would soon be leaving this place anyway.
"Let's sleep a little longer, after eating we will leave this city." Vritra spoke as he headed towards his room.
After entering his room, he just created a blood barrier around the whole building to keep the attackers away for a while.
Then he climbed onto the bed and was embraced by his wives.
While Vritra and the others slept peacefully, a big wave of humans appeared outside and began to attack the blood barrier.
They slept for hours and finally Vritra woke up, he freshened up and decided to go out and check things.
He could sense thousands of people roaring outside, they sure were angry and very afraid.
"Deal with them hubby, we will eat food together once you are done." Yasmine said, giving a peck on his lips.
"Hmm It will take a few minutes." He said with a smile which disappeared as he stepped out of the room.
"Pitiful one, should I take care of them?" Shitless asked while cracking his knuckles.
"Nah, it's fine." Vritra flew out of the barrier, looking down at the faces of all the angry people.
They were roaring madly, and paused for a moment when they saw him coming out.
"Why did you kill our lord?! You are evil, he was so good to us all!!"
"We are going to kill you! Even when you attacked him, he forgave you and you assassinated him?"
"He was a kind soul, he cared for us all like we were his children. You killed our god!"
They were madly shouting.
"..." Vritra rolled his eyes, all humans are greedy by nature, they move by profit.
Even in a relation as pure as a parent and child, there is greed.
Greed from child to its parents and parents to the child for a better future.
Vritra didn't care about their words, he suddenly raised his hand, as everyone quieted down.
"I have the same ability as that god of yours, so even if he is dead, the bubble around it will still work just fine. And if I hear one more person shout, I will just leave this place."
As he spoke, his aura swept over the crowd, making them all shiver in fear.
Most of them were too weak, that aura alone gave them a reality check.
Then a bubble appeared over Vritra's hand, exactly the same as Magna's.
All the people looked at him wide eyed then they knelt suddenly, praying to Vritra in loud voices.
"Forgive us, god! We meant no disrespect."
"You are our true god, that bastard Magna was just a pretender, it was good you killed him. He had a loose character and looser pants."
"Thank you for protecting us from that bastard, everything here is yours. Please continue to protect us."
The people changed faster than the speed of light, now they were worshipping Vritra and begging him to stay there forever.
Vritra shook his head, he didn't care about any of this, but at least he would leave the bubble behind so they would be safe for some time.
A large amount of energy channelled into his arm as the bubble continued to grow bigger and bigger, it was way better than the other bubble.
Soon it had grown to the size of the entire city and just absorbed the other bubble.
Then he glanced towards Magna's palace and made a rip sign.
After doing so Vritra turned and returned to the room, while the people continued to chant his praises.
Hoping their earlier words didn't offend him.
"You are done already? Let's eat then." Teresa spoke with a smile, her beautiful face was not currently covered.
She looked absolutely gorgeous.
But looking at her brought a memory of Evelyn to his mind, as she was equally beautiful and had quite the opposite personality.
A lot of dishes were served over the table as Vritra and the others sat and chatted while eating.
Their plan was to move to the next city after eating, he had already killed three players, seven more left.
BOOOOM
Just then, a loud explosive sound rang out, shaking the bubble surrounding the Renko city.
Vritra frowned, while Shitless spat out the hot soup onto Onest's face, the other guy screaming in agony.
BANG BANG
Then loud noises started to ring out from the outside, and Vritra could sense that the bubble he had just created might actually break soon.
'Oh I didn't think there was anyone strong enough here.' He thought.
After all either the enemies were those players or mutants who were too weak or those protectors and administrators who were too strong.
Finally it seemed there was a change.
Previously an administrator had been killed, things had already become quite chaotic, strange changes were happening in the game.
Leaving the food there, he flew outside the building and saw that most of the people were still there, praying and begging.
Ignoring them, he flew closer to the bubble and saw a big group of people.
The one who was striking on the bubble was a creature whose body was white, a twisted round face, and arms like hammers.
BANG BANG
Over fifty people were there, none of them were from the human race, neither did they look like normal humans.
"New entries into the game? What is going on?"
"They are probably called here by the administrator, it's like they are antivirus who would sweep through the entire region and kill anything they find strange." Divine spoke.
Even if the administrators are very strong, there is only so much they could do while holding back their strength.
While these guys are different, aside from hurting the players or wiping out the humans completely, they are free to do as they please.
"I am the virus? Sigh anyway, who exactly are they? They look pretty tough." While speaking Vritra scanned the group.
And each of them had stats exactly 10,000, the same as him, it surprised Vritra greatly.
"These people are all criminals from the world prison, they get to fight and kill openly for some time in return for doing work for the gods, what more would they want." Divine answered.
Thin cracks started to spread across the bubble, if it broke then water would flood inside along with the mutants.
Vritra glanced at the people, although he didn't like them all that much, but if possible he could save them.
Of course without going out of his way, if things get worse, they will have to fend for themselves.
"Criminals, since our stats are the same, locked at ten thousand. It would mainly depend on our abilities and experience, but they have fifty." Vritra frowned.
While on this side, they were just ten.
Fiona, Yasmine, Vanessa, Diana, Maeve, Teresa, Yennefer, Shitless and Onest also rose behind him, flying.
It is only after the ninth evolution that they were able to fly.
And this fight was going to be very dangerous.

chapters.title: Chapter 712 The Maze
paragraphs: Vritra looked at the fifty or so creatures, all of their eyes fixed on him.
"I guess it is time to leave." He mumbled, the people in the city were already panicking.
Through the cracks, water was starting to rush inside.
"Sigh This game is anything but normal, first those administrators and protectors, then that crazy Evelyn and now these." Vritra shook his head.
Then he created another bubble, pouring even more energy into it.
While a blood cart formed beside him.
"Get ready, we are leaving this city." He announced as the bubble grew in size rapidly.
The people were overjoyed upon seeing Vritra create another barrier, they prayed to him continuously.
The hammer guy was thumping at the barrier, and it was nearly broken.
Those guys had stats locked at 10,000 but unlike Vritra not all their attributes were maxed out.
Soon the bubble had covered the entire city and the barrier that was about to break was absorbed by it.
Instantly the group sat on the blood cart and quickly flew out of the Renko city, heading towards the next one.
All the criminals were laughing maniacally, the hammer guy paused upon seeing that their prey were coming out.
"Let me handle this." A guy with a bluish goop-like body said, as its body expanded.
"Not with me around kekeke."
Another jumped forward, his height was just a metre and a body that resembled a raccoon but large mechanical hands were present on his back.
There were all sorts of criminals, belonging to different races.
As soon as the blood cart exited, dozens of attacks were launched at them.
But a blood shield wrapped around it.
BOOOM!
The shield was broken the moment all the attacks fell, the cart thrown down into the water.
BOOOM!
The shield was broken the moment all the attacks fell, the cart thrown down into the water.
"Hahaha It's my turn!!" it was a guy with a fish-like tail and a face full of sharp teeth.
He dived straight into the water, claws cutting the water apart, sending water blades shooting forward.
BANG BANG
The blades cut the cart apart as ten figures tried to go up.
"Kek You are not surviving!" another laughed, then screamed, sending a terrifying soundwave that created powerful waves over the flood water.
The figures instantly exploded into a bloody mess, splattering in all directions.
"Haa That was too easy, I didn't even get a chance to taste blood." one spoke, sighing in self pity.
He was locked up for the crime of wiping out a race almost entirely, but was stopped at the last moment.
Licking his blade he looked down and frowned.
"Huh? Why is there only blood? Where are the bones and flesh-"
KCCHH
A metallic hand suddenly tore through his back, and came out of the chest, as a chilling voice sounded in his ear.
"Of course, they are still attached to my body."
Shitless was the one who attacked him.
These guys might be very powerful but some had weak physical defence while others were weak to mental attacks.
Since the opponents were playing unfair, how could Vritra and the others just fight head on?
Shitless pulled his arm back, twisting it around to search for the criminal's heart.
"Ah found it! Onest, will it really explode if I pinch it- ah sorry..." Shitless turned his head and shouted.
On the other hand, Onest was about to sneak up behind an opponent, but because of that shitty monk, he got caught.
"You piece of shieettttttt-"
BOOOM
A blast swept over, throwing him away into the water.
Shitless pulled out his heart, then stuffed it back into the killer's mouth, before punching the jaw from below and kicking from behind.
"Safe journey!!" he shouted, his heavy body falling into the water.
BOOOOOM!!
The criminal's body exploded, sending the surrounding men flying away.
There were also a few female criminals, and their crimes weren't any less heinous than the men.
They too were here to enjoy the freedom and kill.
One of the women with a neck similar to a giraffe, and a body as heavy as a gorilla, was thrown back.
She fell into the water, but suddenly her body froze as a room appeared around her.
Then thousands of shadow tentacles struck her body while waves of spiritual bursts turned her head into mush.
"Aghhhhhhhhhh" she let out a shrill scream.
Her defence towards physical attacks was good but being attacked without being able to defend herself, even her body was torn apart.
Teresa, Maeve and Yasmine worked together to kill her.
They chose their opponents based on weaknesses and had the benefit of initial surprise.
Vritra caught a guy whose entire body was made of tentacles and the fish guy in the water.
His hands grew rapidly, big enough to completely envelop their bodies, using the Evomorph.
Then blood rampaged within his palms, as he launched waves of spiritual bursts to tear them to pieces.
Fiona, Yennefer and Diana managed to kill two more opponents, even so they only managed to kill five opponents.
There were still so many of them, and now that the surprise factor was gone, their locations were completely revealed.
"They are hiding there, attack them at once!!" the hammer guy shouted, he seemed to have taken the role of the leader.
"Hahahaha This is so exciting!! Die die die" a little cute girl with tears falling down her cheeks screamed madly.
All of these guys were complete psychos, only the thought of killing filled their minds.
Vanessa used her ability to trap everyone in a puzzle, now that she had almost reached the point of the 10th evolution, her mazes came to reality.
The scene around them changed, she had moved her family close while spreading those criminals far away from one another.
Though there were some with high spiritual strength who weren't bothered by this puzzle and the strength of some was just too damn high.
Not to mention their skills.
This maze was pretty simple but pretty big, consisting of walls that were as high as the sky.
"Alright let's move together, and kill as many as we can before this maze is destroyed." He said, dodging to the back as a white hair almost pierced into his skin.
Instead, it struck the wall, and instantly thin vein-like structures spread all over it, as the wall started to collapse.
He glanced to the side and saw a creature whose face resembled a hundred or so year old woman and body was completely covered by white hairs.
'What sort of creatures are these even?' he frowned.
But Fiona reacted quickly, sending a flood of red flames bursting out.
The white haired creature was shocked as it tried to flee while creating walls of white hairs, but it was useless.
All the walls were instantly swallowed by the flames and soon the creature itself was burned to death.
These people were certainly very powerful but had such weaknesses.
Thankfully Vritra's group possessed quite a few types of attacks, so long as they didn't have to fight them all at once, this fight wouldn't be life threatening.
Earlier while killing these prisoners, they had not focused on whether they had gained anything or not.
But there really were various messages that had popped before him.
All of them glanced at the messages and were surprised as they read the several lines.
[You have obtained a Blue Crystal.]
[Collect 20 blue crystals to go through the 10th Evolution.]
"Oh, that shouldn't be too hard. But we will have to hunt more." Vritra mumbled upon reading the messages.
They have already obtained six or so crystals.
"Let's keep going." Yennefer spoke, she loves hunting.
Her ability to control all the elements gave her an edge, she could target various types of weaknesses.
While scanning the surrounding, vanessa twisted and shifted the maze to keep the opponents separated.
Soon they came across a giant guy who was directly passing through the walls and was wearing a metal helmet.
His strength and endurance were extremely high but spiritual attribute was very low, but that helmet would protect him against the spiritual attacks.
"Shitless, remove that helmet. And wifey, get ready." Vritra said, he held Yasmine's hand.
Despite the protective charm given by Divine, her safety was still a big concern of his.
"Okay!" Shitless and Onest both sped up, while Teresa created a room around the big guy to freeze him.
Then Shitless jumped up and smashed hit body into the helmet, while Onest's sped up and pulled the criminal's leg.
With the combined effort, they were able to pull away the helmet that was stuck to its flesh.
Instantly, Vritra and Yasmine bombarded it with spiritual bursts.
A drop of blood floated high which instantly broke into countless tentacles that stabbed into his body.
Maeve, Fiona, Yennefer, all of them attacked at once and the giant creature couldn't even move because of Teresa's ability.
And soon, it got killed too.
[You have obtained a Blue Crystal.]
"Be careful, I will be back asap." Vritra spoke as his body transformed into the blood demon form.
In an instant he disappeared from there, flying at the full speed.
Vritra decided to go all out and wipe all these prisoners.
Or at least first gather 20 blue crystals, but the evolution might take long so they would have to wait for the fight to end anyway.
Like a flood of blood, he flew while attacking all the enemies around.
Six or seven of them were attracted, all of them attacking him at once.
But Vritra was ready, his body transformed into a gigantic blood demon, as he stomped onto one.
Despite growing in size, his agility was still just as fast.
BOOOOOOM

chapters.title: Chapter 713 Clap
paragraphs: BOOOOOOM
With a loud explosion, blades of blood struck all the ones who were attacking Vritra.
Though only two were hurt, the rest three either dodged or were just unaffected by physical attacks.
'Tsk These people's strength is also quite diverse, it is hard to fight a group.' He thought, sending out spiritual bursts.
It shook only two again, while the rest three were somewhat immune.
Hands transforming into giant blades, Vritra struck the two who were hurt earlier, appearing in front of them with a flash.
All his attributes were at the top, any attack that landed on his body wasn't as effective.
And with his blood form, the others were finding it impossible to hurt him at all.
CLANG
Vritra's hand cut through the body of one while the other barely blocked it, before being thrown back.
[You have obtained a blue crystal!]
Just as he was about to launch another attack the entire maze started to shake violently, and cracks appeared in the walls and air.
'Shit, it can't hold on!' Vritra ignored these opponents and quickly flew back towards his family.
And just as he expected in the next few seconds the maze broke apart.
Then the man with hammers on his hands was revealed kneeling in the sky, he was the reason behind it.
Actually his ability was more than just strength, he could break anything, whether it be a barrier or anyone's defences.
So, he could hurt even Vritra pretty badly.
Vritra stopped beside his family, still in his blood form as he looked around.
There were still more than forty criminals around, all looking at them with maniacal expressions.
They didn't care how many of them had been killed already, only one thought was present in their minds.
To kill!
"We have played enough by your rules, now it's your turn to enter our game." The hammer creature spoke in a heavy voice.
He stood up, as a dark fluid rose from under his feet then it transformed into a new sort of creature.
It was black and green, body like a jelly and body structure similar to the hammer guy.
"Trap them!" the hammer guy muttered, a twisted smile present on his face.
GUU GUU GUU GUU
Suddenly the black green creature releasing strange noises broke apart, countless clones like the hammer guy appeared.
And they were all trapped inside a big hall that was made completely from the body of that jelly like creature.
The enormous hall was dimly lit and only green light was present.
"Wifey, stay back, let me handle them. As for you all, just defend and try to find a way out." Vritra spoke slowly, the situation had just been flipped.
Fighting so many creatures despite their weaknesses wouldn't be easy even for him.
"Don't worry husband, we are going to support you as much as we can." Teresa said, a faint smile on her face under the veil.
Vritra nodded, creating hundreds of blood clones in the next moment.
GUU GUU GUU
The clones of the hammer guy suddenly started jumping towards the group, it was obvious that they couldn't copy the real abilities.
The eyes of all the Vritra's clones glowed brightly, flames bursting around their bodies, as they too transformed using the Evomorph.
Being able to produce so many clones was one of Neil's abilities.
Then he created a bubble around his family, their attacks could go outside but the attacks from outside would be hindered.
After which, he used the Domain that he obtained from Morgan, his abilities instantly growing stronger.
And finally he planned to use Morgan's ability to turn others into his puppets, as dozens of invisible threads shot out.
He couldn't take them lightly, all of them had various sets of skills and were clearly very experienced in killing.
CLAP
Just as the invisible threads connected with various of the prisoners, Vritra felt danger from behind.
He quickly jumped away, but was not fast enough.
A box like creature that was rotating quickly suddenly flashed behind him, it was teleportation.
And clearly someone else had teleported it.
The corner of the box creature slashed at Vritra's back, despite the armor and his defences, it actually cut through his skin.
Leaving behind a deep wound, making blood burst out for a second.
Not even his blood form was able to stop that attack.
Vritra frowned as he stopped the blood from flowing, stabbing with the spear that suddenly appeared in his hand.
CLAP
Again, he sensed danger and just jumped away at full speed, as another creature flashed in front of him.
Thankfully, Vritra reacted in time, as he almost got cut by the pincers of a strange looking creature.
'Who here has the ability to use teleportation?' with a deep frown he observed the area around.
The wound on his back was healing very slowly, it was also because of that space user.
Pouncing towards a short creature, Vritra stabbed the spear towards his face, while using spiritual burst.
CLAP
But at the last second, the creature just disappeared and a painful groan sounded from the distance.
The short creature was teleported away.
Vritra paused and carefully observed them all, there were still more than forty creatures in the battle.
He attacked another, speed bursting wildly and almost stabbed the spear into the head of another.
CLAP
Again that sound came and it was teleported away but among all the forty or so creatures none of them had done it.
'Then where is it?'
The opponents didn't give him any time to think, dozens of attacks were launched at him from all directions.
Vritra had no way to retaliate, all he could do was dodge and block, barely stopping them from cutting him.
Teresa, Maeve and all the others supported him behind the bubble, doing their best to stop all attacks before reaching him.
Vritra's blood clones were fighting against the black green clones of the hammer guy.
While the leader of the prisoners, the hammer creature itself was just standing at the back observing everything.
Suddenly, the smile on his face grew, he enjoyed it more when the enemy was broken mentally before physically.
And he had just found the perfect way to do that.
Vritra who had just dodged another attack noticed the big guy moving rapidly, it was heading straight towards the bubble.
'Not good!' he too flew at full speed in the hammer guy's direction, his hands waving around with madness, blocking all the attacks.
"Kekeke It is getting fun!" he grinned, raising both his hands, he struck the bubble.
But at the last second, he was covered by an invisible room that froze his body, as everyone inside the bubble heaved a sigh of relief.
CLAP
BOOOOM!
Before they could react, the leader was teleported to the other side of the bubble and his heavy arms bursting with strength landed on the bubble.
It shook violently as thin cracks spread quickly, Vritra had spent even more energy into it.
And since its size was smaller so it was even more powerful, yet it was almost broken apart.
Vritra felt way angrier towards the sneaky bastard who was hiding and using the teleporting ability.
Kicking a creature away he appeared before the hammer guy and struck him with the spear.
CLAP
But at the last second, even the spear disappeared from his hand.
"kek goodbye, you are too weak." The hammer guy's hand struck Vritra's body with immense force, it shook the space.
CLAP

paragraphs: CLAP
There was a clapping sound again, that sneaky creature was using the rules of space to weaken Vritra's defence even more.
BOOOOOOOM!!
Extremely violent energy surged, completely devouring Vritra's body, tearing his skin apart quickly.
BANG
He was thrown down to the black green floor, landing with a sickening explosion.
The breath of everyone in the bubble paused for a moment as they watched the scene.
Despite their abilities, the opponents clearly had way more abilities and now that they were all working together, their chance of winning was lower.
Vritra's body was breaking apart and pain flooded his senses, his arms broke under the crushing force.
Right at that moment, all the others started to attack him.
BOOOOM
CLAP
The attacks ignored Vritra's defences completely and directly hit him, breaking him further.
The hammer criminal laughed like a psycho, then he turned his gaze back to the bubble.
"Too fragile, too bad he didn't get to see you all die, I would have loved to watch him despair." He muttered and touched the surface of the bubble.
Then his smile broke, and he struck the bubble with powerful strikes again and again...
And finally, it cracked, the pieces of bubbles flying in different directions.
The women inside were trying to protect Vritra, they were very worried about him.
"You thick headed pig, you are not getting past me!!" Shitless jumped forward, his entire body was made of some very powerful metal.
"..." the big hammer creature looked at the smaller bald guy before him and then its fists descended.
BOOOOOM!!
"Heh it's useless!" Shitless let out a loud laugh, he didn't feel anything.
Defence was his strongest ability, how could he just be defeated so easily.
Unfortunately, the hammer guy's ability wasn't strength, but being able to break almost anything.
"So arrogant!" he laughed and hit Shitless several times, Onest ran to stop him.
CLAP
But suddenly a snake like creature that was teleported directly onto him wrapped around Onest, dragging him down.
He was helpless.
CLAP CLAP CLAP
Several loud claps sounded and any of the women who tried to use their ability was interrupted at the last moment.
Fiona almost hurt Diana just now with her flames but redirected them at the last moment.
They looked below and saw over thirty creatures bombarding Vritra with so many attacks and all of them were actually harming him.
BANG BANG
Soon cracks appeared over Shitless's body, he was baffled, raising his hands to defend.
BOOOM
But as the hammers descended both his arms were thrown back, and finally Shitless wasn't able to hold on.
He spurted out blood and was blasted away, instantly several creatures surrounded him and began attacking.
"Now, it's finally your turn!" he smiled, killing the most protected part of the group was the most fun part of the battle.
Both his arms rose, and without aiming he just launched strikes with all his might.
BOOOOM!!
At the last moment, Yasmine stepped forward.
She raised her hands, and was a bit afraid but the protection charm given by Divine worked.
"Oh, so your ability is barrier, this is even better!!" the hammer guy took a lot of pride in his hands and skill.
He could break apart literally anything, he had created endless chaos back then to test if he could break this and that.
He killed all people in the name of challenging his ability and was finally caught and locked in the world prison.
So breaking barriers and crushing the weak was his favourite activity.
BOOOM BOOOM BOOOM
With every bit of his strength he started to strike down, each clash sending powerful ripples through the air.
CLAP
The sneaky creature again tried to help him but despite the teleporting, the damage didn't travel to Yasmine.
"Kekekeke This is just perfect, be happy, this is the most powerful barrier I have ever seen. I will give you an easier death!" he laughed, very happy and even more determined.
Vritra who was bombarded by dozens of attacks every second found it hard to move, almost every bone in his body had been destroyed.
His flesh was torn apart and it was all because of that space ability user.
But seeing that hammer guy attack his family was the last straw, his bloodlust exploded with madness as waves of blood surged in all directions.
The ones who were attacking him earlier were all consumed by blood, though they were far from defeated.
'If not among them, then...' Vritra's gaze moved towards his blood clones and black green clones fighting.
Yes, that must be it.
That fucker must be hiding among those clones.
Vritra had to first take care of that thing or they would keep losing.
His speed increased as he shot towards the battle of the clones and started to destroy all of them.
BOOOOOOM!!
A large mushroom of flames rose as Vritra made a flood of blood explode, wiping out more than half of the clones.
"EXPLODE!!" He shouted, as all his blood clones stuck to the green clones and exploded at once.
BOOM BOOM BOOM
"Aggghhhh"
Finally a groan sounded, as a creature which was very thin and two metres long was thrown out of one of the green clones.
Its face looked like that of a fox, it looked extremely hateful.
Vritra's anger exploded as soon as he saw it, he flew forward and broke into hundreds of blood clones.
The fox like creature panicked, quickly clapping but still it couldn't find the exact location of Vritra.
It hurriedly teleported itself away and tried to hide.
In a strange language it called out to the hammer guy to protect it, but that hammer headed creature was too busy trying to break the barrier around Yasmine.
He was simply obsessed and forgot about everything else.
Vritra suddenly appeared in front of the fox creature, then grasped its neck.
CLA-
It was about to use its ability again but Vritra held its hand, his eyes were full of rage.
This bastard had been hiding since earlier and was creating so much trouble for him.
Finally now that the space ability was stopped, Vritra's wounds started to heal quickly and within moments he was back to peak.
"You are lucky I don't have much time to spare..." he spoke and tore its hand away as the fox creature screamed in pain, crying out for help.
But the hammer guy just kept striking with a psychotic smile on his face.
Just then Vritra sensed dozens of needles rushing towards his back.
He turned around suddenly and all the needles struck into the fox's body, as it screamed even more.
Those needles suddenly grew in size, becoming thicker and longer.
They vibrated and moved deeper into its body and began to tear apart the skin, flesh and crush the bones.
Although Vritra would have liked to torture it more but there was just not enough time.
He held its head and suddenly tore it apart, throwing the pieces in both directions.
[You have obtained a blue crystal!]
A similarly psychotic smile appeared on his face as his body transformed into the flames blood demon.
Kicking the ground, he shot forward at full speed and pulled his right hand back, twisting his waist slightly.
Waves of energy flooded into his right arm, almost expending half of his energy.
The insides of the big box was suddenly filled with a terrifying pressure and finally...
BOOOOOOOOOOOM!!

chapters.title: Chapter 715 Forgetting something?
paragraphs: The hammer guy was striking at Yasmine with all his might, but no matter how much he struck, not even a crack was appearing.
'What is happening? Why isn't her barrier breaking? Is it that powerful?' he wondered, forgetting about the rest of the battlefield.
The more unbreakable it seemed, the more he wanted to break it. He even ignored the fox creature's cries for help.
Just then a deadly pressure appeared on his right. The hammer guy paused momentarily as shock appeared in his eyes.
In front of his eyes, an enormous blood hand appeared, it was filled with so much energy.
He had no time to dodge, so all he could do was put his hands before his chest, hoping to block it.
BOOOOOOOOOM!!
The violent explosion shook the entire room, as a horrendous amount of energy flew out, shooting straight towards the sky.
BOOOM!
It collided with the ceiling, breaking the box apart as the green black jelly like creature screamed in pain and shrivelled up.
The leader was thrown into the sky as the destructive energy swallowed his entire body. Vritra had poured nearly half of his energy into that one attack.
He looked around at the stunned bunch of prisoners who stared at the sky in bafflement.
Vritra wasted no time. He scanned the crowd again and quickly noted down their weaknesses in his mind.
Then waves of powerful spiritual bursts rained down over twenty or so opponents, all of them instantly felt as if their heads were about to explode.
While his hands turned into several meter long blades, which were terrifyingly sharp, cleaving down the bodies of the stunned bunch.
WHOOSH
Teresa froze any of the prisoners Vritra was attacking, making them impossible to dodge or block.
KCCHH
Their bodies were torn apart mercilessly, as all his wives started to help him again.
Yasmine was breathing heavily, thankfully the protective charm had worked just now or they would have been in real trouble.
She touched her belly, her hands shaking.
Vritra's body separated into thousands of clones and finally he managed to turn a few of those creatures into parasites.
And started making them attack each other, as complete chaos engulfed the battlefield.
In the sky, the hammer guy was thrown several kilometres high, his entire body broken apart.
As the energy finally disappeared, he was left with grave wounds all over his body.
Both his arms, the weapons he took the most pride in, were gone completely along with his shoulders.
Even one of his feet was gone and several big holes were present in his torso, he was in such a sorry state.
But barely alive.
'I have to run, he is a m- monster!!' for the first time, the crazy criminal felt fear.
Even when he was caught and thrown in the world prison or almost got executed, he didn't feel any fear.
He was instead very happy, even more so when they were given this chance.
But now he was trembling in dread, every fibre of his being crying for him to run, escape as far away as possible.
Whatever remained of his body was trembling badly, strange liquid flowing out of his eyes.
'I have to run, run!' After taking one look at Vritra, the hammer guy suddenly turned and shot in a different direction.
As long as he could get away from that demon, everything would be fine, even that prison would be far better than this.
But suddenly he was covered by an invisible room, his body freezing instantly.
'What? Who?' his pupils moved slightly as he looked at the woman with her face covered, there was rage in her eyes.
Was he going to be killed because of the very people he was laughing at earlier and calling weak?
"Running somewhere?" suddenly, a bone chilling voice sounded from behind him.
The room disappeared but before he could try to escape again, a hand flashed, suddenly gripping his throat.
"Weak, weak, you are far too weak." Vritra spoke, shaking his head in contempt.
The hammer guy looked down wondering where that fox creature had gone, he was their only key towards winning.
"Looking for this?" Vritra raised his other hand which was gripping the torn corpse of the fox creature who had the space ability.
"H- How?" he couldn't understand how things changed so much in an instant, weren't they winning just now?
In fact it was only because of his obsession that gave Vritra an opening.
"Since you like this thing so much, then you can have him."
As Vritra spoke, two blood hands appeared out of nowhere, one gripping the criminal's jaw and the other gripping the upper part of his mouth.
And finally the hands pulled, as a tearing and sickening crack sounded.
His mouth was ripped open, then Vritra pushed the torn corpse of the fox into his mouth, pushing it deeper and deeper.
The leader's eyes were wide open but he couldn't even resist, tears filled his eyes.
It was painful and disgusting, as more and more of the corpse entered his body, he was being torn apart inside.
Soon the entire corpse was pushed into the leader, his throat seemed ready to burst just like his belly.
"Are you still hungry? Keep feeding him more corpses!" Vritra ordered as his blood clones who were massacring other prisoners below began to bring the corpses to the hammer guy.
He stood back and just observed as one by one more corpses were stuffed in.
And after a short while...
BOOM
His belly and throat burst out violently, sending pieces of flesh, organs and strange liquid in all directions.
He was feeling extreme pain as even this had not killed him.
The leader pleaded with his eyes, begging to just be killed.
"Hmm I don't like his eyes, gouge them out." he said lazily as the blood clones began to scratch and pull the eyeballs.
After the eyes burst, their hands were pushed into the eye sockets, moving towards the brain.
And finally the leader was dead as his brain was pulled out of his head and torn to pieces.
[You have obtained a blue crystal!]
"Let's wrap this up quickly." Vritra muttered, as he quickly started killing the rest of the prisoners.
And soon he had exactly 54 blue crystals.
It was only enough for two people though.
Vritra was going to use one, as for the other he decided to just let his wives decide it.
Shitless and Onest would come last, as usual.
"Sigh that was intense, my body is hurting..." Vritra could still feel the pain all over, even if his body had healed completely.
This random entry into the game truly took them by surprise.
The game was getting stranger by the day, they would have to finish it as soon as possible.
"Let's rest for a bit in the Renko city then we will continue." Vritra spoke as they turned and started to fly back towards the bubble.
"Huh? But aren't we forgetting something?" Onest asked, scratching his head.
After flying a bit longer they finally remembered, there were only nine of them, where was the tenth one?
All of them looked back collectively and scanned the flood water.

chapters.title: Chapter 716 Slaves?
paragraphs: After that large room was destroyed by Vritra, Shitless who was still in metallic form fell and sank into the sea.
Then he got devoured by some mutant.
"What should we do darling, do we need to help?" Fiona asked, though she just wanted to rest now.
"I am sure he will be fine, let's go and just rest." Vritra shrugged as the group turned and flew back.
It would be useless to search the entire flood water to find that one creature who might have swallowed him.
Sooner or later, he would be thrown out with poop or something just like before.
Vritra and the others just ignored the people who were bowing and thanking them, treating him as their god and saviour.
Soon the group returned to their rooms and just slept, the battle wasn't too long but was pretty intense.
They were all woken up by the sound of metal dragging against the floor, there was also the sound of water drops falling.
"Looks like Shitless is back." Vritra mumbled before going back to sleep.
The monk before returning to his room kicked open Onest's room.
He was still in his metallic form, completely wet and stained all over with something greenish.
"Oh Shitless, you are back? Ha... haha we were so worried about you, I even searched... wait!"
Without a word, Shitless jumped on top of the bed, smashing hard.
BANG
The bed broke, both the bed and Onest were now also covered with the green stuff with a really bad stench.
"Ughh What is this? It smells like shit." Onest wiped his face, a look of disgust on his face.
"100 points, correct answer!" Shitless clapped his metallic palms together, laughing evilly.
Onest vomited instantly before running towards the bathroom.
After a few hours, Vritra and his wives ate a delicious meal but for some reason Onest and Shitless didn't.
"I will be going through the 10th evolution, have you decided who is going to use those crystals?" Vritra asked.
"Yes, Teresa will be the one, her ability is very useful in fights after all." Yasmine spoke.
Vritra nodded, before leaving they would go through the evolution, so they would be better prepared for the future fights.
"Let's go Tess." He said, extending his hand.
"Yes husband." Nodding she held his hand, then the two flew up, going above the bubble.
After reaching a good enough height and moving some distance away from the Renko city.
Vritra created a big floating floor with blood, the two sat down on it with some distance between them.
"Let's start." The two nodded and took out twenty blue crystals.
Taking a deep breath, they initiated the process of evolution as the blue energy suddenly flooded their surroundings.
Instantly an enormous cocoon of energy formed around both of them.
The outside of the energy cocoon was pretty calm but inside there was a storm of energies.
This final evolution was bigger than any of the nine evolutions before, it filled their bodies with so much strength.
For both Vritra and Teresa, time seemed to have paused, they stopped sensing anything.
Meanwhile everyone waited on the ground.
Thankfully, the evolution didn't take too long, it ended after a little over two days.
The cocoons cracked and the energy faded into the air as Vritra and Teresa's figures were revealed.
Both were wearing a different set of clothes, as the previous ones were in a really bad state.
"How did it go?" Teresa asked with a beautiful smile on her face, that made Vritra stare at her for a few moments.
"Perfect" he replied, although there was no increase in the attributes, but he had truly reached the peak of this planet.
There would be no longer any progression, he was ready to challenge whatever was in that tower.
And now killing those criminals would be very easy.
"With my current strength, I could have locked all those prisoners and the battle would have ended in moments." Teresa spoke.
In the real world, she didn't possess any ability that could help her in battles.
She didn't really need one previously but now she did, though she could have used her gadgets for it.
So she wondered if they would still have these abilities after returning to the real world.
"Let's go down then, it is time to leave this place and quickly reach the tower." Vritra said, taking her soft hand in his.
"Husband, do you think back on the Zoratian planet, things would be peaceful in our absence?" she asked.
Although her family was full of scums she still cared for some like Rich and a little about her brother and grandfather.
"They should be, the mutation would be contained and before the trials start, we still have enough time." Vritra answered.
There was a difference in the passage of time too, and they haven't been here for that long.
"Hmm I hope things go fine once we have cleared this game." She sighed, making Vritra pause suddenly.
"No, why did you say that? Sigh."
Here he was trying his best to return to safety and his wife was just casually raising flags.
"O- Oh sorry, I didn't mean..." Teresa was still quite meek.
Vritra had forgotten that after arriving on this planet since she started fighting and all, but he forgot how emotionally weak she is.
Pulling her into his arms, he consoled, "It's fine, just don't say things like that, it brings trouble."
"Mhmm." She nodded, and after she had calmed down, the two flew down.
Shitless and Onest as usual were fighting over something, while the women were either just resting or walking around chatting.
When Vritra and Teresa returned they all surrounded the two to ask various questions.
Vritra was about to say they were going to leave, but upon glancing at Teresa and noticing her expression, he spoke,
"We will leave after eating."
An hour or so later, a big blood cart appeared in the sky, all of them already seated on it.
Shitless didn't forget to bring along that young assassin.
The people on the ground noticed the large cart and knew that their god was leaving.
They chased and begged but within seconds, the cart was just gone.
All of them could only sigh and work hard to get stronger.
This bubble would last a long time, enough for them to get stronger.
A few hours after they were gone, a person walked from the neighbouring city and swiftly entered the bubble city.
"Haha That was smooth, haa why am I so awesome? It's a pity those women are gone too but at least they would be doing my work like slaves keke."
The man laughed maniacally before walking away happily.
Vritra and the others were flying away rapidly, at their current speed, only the young assassin was having trouble.
The strength of the rest of the members was so high.
He was frozen by the invisible room from Teresa, making it impossible to even think of doing anything.
"How far is that lord Asmodeus of yours?" Shitless asked, though he just needed an excuse to beat him up.
Vritra sent hundreds of his blood clones in all directions, they would kill the mutants and search for anything helpful.
Like the players or those criminals.
And after a few hours of travel, one of the clones finally found something very special.

Without a word, Shitless jumped on top of the bed, smashing hard.
BANG
The bed broke, both the bed and Onest were now also covered with the green stuff with a really bad stench.
"Ughh What is this?
It smells like shit." Onest wiped his face, a look of disgust on his face.
"100 points, correct answer!" Shitless clapped his metallic palms together, laughing evilly.
Onest vomited instantly before running towards the bathroom.
After a few hours, Vritra and his wives ate a delicious meal but for some reason Onest and Shitless didn't.
"I will be going through the 10th evolution, have you decided who is going to use those crystals?" Vritra asked.
"Yes, Teresa will be the one, her ability is very useful in fights after all." Yasmine spoke.
Vritra nodded, before leaving they would go through the evolution, so they would be better prepared for the future fights.
"Let's go Tess." He said, extending his hand.
"Yes husband." Nodding she held his hand, then the two flew up, going above the bubble.
After reaching a good enough height and moving some distance away from the Renko city.
Vritra created a big floating floor with blood, the two sat down on it with some distance between them.
"Let's start." The two nodded and took out twenty blue crystals.
Taking a deep breath, they initiated the process of evolution as the blue energy suddenly flooded their surroundings.
Instantly an enormous cocoon of energy formed around both of them.
The outside of the energy cocoon was pretty calm but inside there was a storm of energies.
This final evolution was bigger than any of the nine evolutions before, it filled their bodies with so much strength.
For both Vritra and Teresa, time seemed to have paused, they stopped sensing anything.
Meanwhile everyone waited on the ground.
Thankfully, the evolution didn't take too long, it ended after a little over two days.
The cocoons cracked and the energy faded into the air as Vritra and Teresa's figures were revealed.
Both were wearing a different set of clothes, as the previous ones were in a really bad state.
"How did it go?" Teresa asked with a beautiful smile on her face, that made Vritra stare at her for a few moments.
"Perfect" he replied, although there was no increase in the attributes, but he had truly reached the peak of this planet.
There would be no longer any progression, he was ready to challenge whatever was in that tower.
And now killing those criminals would be very easy.
"With my current strength, I could have locked all those prisoners and the battle would have ended in moments." Teresa spoke.
In the real world, she didn't possess any ability that could help her in battles.
She didn't really need one previously but now she did, though she could have used her gadgets for it.
So she wondered if they would still have these abilities after returning to the real world.
"Let's go down then, it is time to leave this place and quickly reach the tower." Vritra said, taking her soft hand in his.
"Husband, do you think back on the Zoratian planet, things would be peaceful in our absence?" she asked.
Although her family was full of scums she still cared for some like Rich and a little about her brother and grandfather.
"They should be, the mutation would be contained and before the trials start, we still have enough time." Vritra answered.
There was a difference in the passage of time too, and they haven't been here for that long.
"Hmm I hope things go fine once we have cleared this game." She sighed, making Vritra pause suddenly.
"No, why did you say that?
Sigh."
Here he was trying his best to return to safety and his wife was just casually raising flags.
"O- Oh sorry, I didn't mean..." Teresa was still quite meek.
Vritra had forgotten that after arriving on this planet since she started fighting and all, but he forgot how emotionally weak she is.
Pulling her into his arms, he consoled, "It's fine, just don't say things like that, it brings trouble."
"Mhmm." She nodded, and after she had calmed down, the two flew down.
Shitless and Onest as usual were fighting over something, while the women were either just resting or walking around chatting.
When Vritra and Teresa returned they all surrounded the two to ask various questions.
Vritra was about to say they were going to leave, but upon glancing at Teresa and noticing her expression, he spoke,
"We will leave after eating."
An hour or so later, a big blood cart appeared in the sky, all of them already seated on it.
Shitless didn't forget to bring along that young assassin.
The people on the ground noticed the large cart and knew that their god was leaving.
They chased and begged but within seconds, the cart was just gone.
All of them could only sigh and work hard to get stronger.
This bubble would last a long time, enough for them to get stronger.
A few hours after they were gone, a person walked from the neighbouring city and swiftly entered the bubble city.
"Haha That was smooth, haa why am I so awesome?
It's a pity those women are gone too but at least they would be doing my work like slaves keke."
The man laughed maniacally before walking away happily.
Vritra and the others were flying away rapidly, at their current speed, only the young assassin was having trouble.
The strength of the rest of the members was so high.
He was frozen by the invisible room from Teresa, making it impossible to even think of doing anything.
"How far is that lord Asmodeus of yours?" Shitless asked, though he just needed an excuse to beat him up.
Vritra sent hundreds of his blood clones in all directions, they would kill the mutants and search for anything helpful.
Like the players or those criminals.
And after a few hours of travel, one of the clones finally found something very special.

chapters.title: Chapter 717 Stolen
paragraphs: After hours long travel at such fast speed, Vritra and others were just resting over the large blood cart.
It attracted quite a lot of attention, but mutants were killed instantly by spiritual bursts and most humans didn't dare get close.
While they were heading towards the towers, Vritra had spread a lot of his blood clones in all directions.
Though his strength had already reached the peak of the evolution here, they still needed to search for some more of those criminals.
It wasn't long before one of Vritra's blood clones finally found something.
Vritra was lying over a bed comfortably while being surrounded by his wives, it was just so comfortable.
But the blood cart came to an abrupt stop, as Vritra opened his eyes.
"Hmm Now what is this?" Although he shared his senses with the clones, it wasn't exactly very clear.
But it was definitely something enormous and special.
"Did they find anything hubby?" Yasmine asked, yawning.
"Yeah, don't worry though, just go back to sleep." He said, caressing her back.
"Mmm." Yasmine nodded and closed her eyes, leaning into his arms.
'Is it worth checking it out?' Vritra wondered.
In the end he decided to fly a bit closer and make sure it was not too dangerous first, hopefully it was either a player or those criminals.
The blood cart started moving again but in a slightly different direction. Back in the other rooms, Shitless and Onest noticed the change but just returned to rest.
After a travel of over two hours, Vritra arrived before what seemed like a huge space ship.
It was exactly the type that was shown in the web series back on Earth.
It was parked on the ground and had a big burn mark, it was big enough to house over a thousand people.
Vritra finally got up and flew out of the blood cart along with the others, and the sight simply baffled them all.
"What the fuck?" Vritra cursed out loud, his eyes wide.
What a joke of a game was this even? Now literally anything was happening?
How could there be a fucking space ship? Is this still a fair game? The gods truly are a joke.
"Did aliens invade or something?" Fiona asked, she had watched quite a lot of SciFi movies back in the day.
"Whoa, this thing, it's made entirely from energy." Teresa observed the space ship.
Vritra also looked at it but he could feel that it was solid matter not just energy.
"Tess, what do you mean?" He asked, she was the genius of their group in such types of things.

"I meant this whole ship was generated by a single person using their ability. So no, aliens haven't invaded, instead it might be someone who created it." Teresa explained, she seemed a little impressed by it.
"Oh, could it be a player?" Vritra wondered but just now he didn't receive any notification about any player being around.
"Wait here, I'll go check it out." Vritra said but before he could move, Teresa held his hand.
"Husband, can I come along?" She asked expectantly, the goth mommy seemed genuinely interested in this ship.
"Alright, let's go." Taking her hand, Vritra flew ahead but left a bubble around the others just in case.
They landed outside the enormous thing but couldn't sense any life inside.
The door was shut tight, and there was no visible entrance. Vritra was about to forcefully open the door but Teresa interrupted.
"Husband let me open it." She said and walked closer to the door. She used her ability over the door and the box fitted beside it.
And after a few moments the door actually opened, she really was such a genius.
"Good job Tess." He patted her head, then started walking inside.
Surprisingly the ship was well lit inside, it really resembled a futuristic alien technology that was shown on TV.
There were even strange weapons on the walls and all sorts of things that even Vritra had not seen before.
Teresa was even more interested in all that, she was checking out everything like a little kid.
"Looks like it has been abandoned." Vritra mumbled after walking around for a while.
"Tess, do you think this thing can work?" He asked.
"We will have to go into the control room to check." She spoke, excited to try flying this.
If they could then reaching the tower would be even easier.
Vritra nodded and they continued to explore it.
Outside on the blood cart, the young assassin with both his arms broken just woke up after noticing that the cart had stopped.
He blinked his eyes and sat back, then glancing towards the large ship, his eyes widened.
"T- That's my lord's ship, it's lord Asmodeus's ship!!" He shouted excitedly then a smug look appeared on his face, he chuckled and added:
"You are all done for now, once he finds what you have done to me and those assassins he is so going to kill you all kekeke."
"Wait where is that other guy? Don't tell me he entered the ship?!! Keke talk about walking to their own death."
BANG
A heavy kick connected with his face before he could finish, breaking his nose.
"Shut the fuck up, if we really find that shitty lord of yours then you'll die." Shitless said, kicking him with his metallic feet.
The young assassin quieted down instantly.
Inside the ship, Vritra and Teresa soon arrived inside the control room.
She got to work and began to check everything, sometimes a frown would appear over her face, then a look of realization.
She was understanding it right then and there, also trying to find the problems and fixing them.
Vritra just stood there and observed her work, she really looked so beautiful, and while moving around her breasts were moving even more than her.
After a while she spoke, "Whoever created it did a good job but wasn't able to make it work."
"Can you do it?" He asked, their travel would be so fast if they could.
"Yes I can." She replied confidently.
"That's great, but just in case, let's take this thing away."
After speaking the two walked out of the ship, then Teresa stored it away in her inventory.
"How did it go?" As the two arrived back on the blood cart, Vanessa asked.
"There was no one, but Teresa can make it work. And if it does work, we can reach the tower very quickly." He replied.
"Vritra, this assassin told us the ship belongs to his lord, Asmodeus." Onest spoke.
"Oh right, what abilities does Asmodeus have?" Vritra almost forgot to ask about this.

"That's lord Asmodeus for you, a- and he can create various types of powerful technology that no one has ever seen. Just like that big thing." The assassin spoke proudly only to receive a kick on the face from Shitless.
"Did he abandon this ship?" Vritra continued to ask.
"Yes." The beaten assassin nodded quickly.
No wonder Vritra didn't get the notification of the presence of a player, but it benefitted them greatly in the end.
"Let's go then, after traveling to a different location we will stop and let Tess work on it." Vritra said.
Then the assassin was thrown into the small prison while they all returned to their rooms.
Once again the blood cart continued to move, flying towards the tower.
After a couple of hours, Vritra finally stopped the ship, the surroundings were pretty much devoid of any life.
There were some mutants but they were killed in an instant.
Creating a big blood land, they landed and Vritra brought out the enormous flying ship.
"Time to work!" Teresa said excitedly, and along with her the rest also walked into the ship.
They were just as fascinated by it.
Some distance away, at the place where the ship mark was present.
A group of thirty or so men arrived, they were carrying a lot of objects, even a large amount of fuel and energy stones they dug out from a cave.
"Don't worry lord, with all these materials, the ship is definitely going to work. Just let us take care of it." One of the guys spoke confidently.
They had already done most of the work in it anyway, though many things still needed to be fixed.
"Yes lord, don't worry we will be the first to arrive at the tower and reap all the benefits." The underlings spoke trying to please the man walking in the front.
"Hmm good, if we do, you'll also receive great benefits." The man with a big build and buffed muscles spoke in a heavy tone.
He was wearing dozens of accessories made of gold, silver, platinum and other metals, adorned with beautiful rubies and diamonds.
He was shining hard.
Asmodeus never was the type of guy to lead groups but because of his current ability he needed a lot of manpower, so he had to bring them along even if it was irritating.
"Haha thank you lord, we will serve you well." A middle aged guy spoke happily.
"Idiot, that sounds wrong. Haha lord, he meant you can use us however you want." Another person corrected him.
Asmodeus rolled his eyes, he just had to endure this for a little longer.
After walking a little more they arrived in an open area, he pointed with his chin and ordered,
"Bring the materials inside."
"Yes lord." The men nodded as they turned and prepared to enter the ship but then paused in shock.
"B- But lord, the ship is kinda missing."
Whoosh
A wind blew past them, as they all stared in stunned silence, blowing their clothes.

chapters.title: Chapter 718 How did he do it?
paragraphs: "T- The flying ship is gone?!!" one of the men muttered in disbelief, asking: "Did s- someone steal it while we were away?"
"You stupid bastard, is that a toy that anyone can pick and run away?" Asmodeus shouted.
The only reason he didn't leave anyone behind was simple, because most humans or mutants cannot break into that thing or just carry something that big and heavy away.
And he didn't trust these idiots all that much, the ship was safer without them around.
"But how can... someone just take it away?" more than angry, Asmodeus was curious.
There weren't any marks around either, he had put so much work into it, first stopping the flood water from reaching into this part of the city.
"It is fine, you set a tracker inside right?" Asmodeus looked back at one of the guys, his expression still not panicked.
"Y- Yes, I did lord. Right, why didn't I think of that, we can track it using that, no wonder you are the lord and we are just here to serve you." The man spoke with reverence in his voice.
"Sigh shut up and track it!" Asmodeus really felt like cracking his skull open.
"O- Okay..." the man quickly activated his skill, and closed his eyes but walked around in circles and after a few minutes paused with a frown.
"I- I can't find it somehow, it's as if the ship itself has disappeared from this planet." The man spoke fearfully.
"Damnit, what use are you then?" Asmodeus almost killed him, now full of rage.
Will he really need to build it all from scratch? But finding so many components that he couldn't build himself would be near impossible.
"Grrrr Let's first search around for it!" he ordered, his fists clenched.
The group then began to run around the city but even after a while they didn't find anything.
Just then the GPS guy paused, his eyes wide and a big smile on his face.
"Lord, I found it! The ship is in that direction, I can definitely sense it haha!!" he shouted.
Asmodeus followed the direction and found that it was going towards the tower.
"Are you sure?" he asked, staring intently at the underling.
"100%, it is definitely in that direction. Maybe those thieves got it started somehow and took it away." He added.
"Whatever might be the case, we have to find it. Take these objects along, let's go!"
Without wasting any time, they started running in the direction of the flying ship.
On the other side, Vritra and the others were helping Teresa, she had already understood the mechanics and was now close to fixing it.
"We will need a lot of fuel." Teresa spoke.
"You don't have to worry about that, I have a whole lot of petrol and diesel." Vritra said.
"Hmm they can work, just give me a little more time and I will try to get it running. For now, fill the diesel into the tank." Teresa spoke.
And Vritra took out a lot of barrels, filling the tank of the flying ship, it consumed so much of the diesel.
Thankfully, Vritra wasn't lacking and could get even more easily.
After filling the tank to the brim, he returned to Teresa's side.

"Hmm we are mostly done, but it looks like we will need some sort of key. I can get it started without the key but then we would be wasting a lot of time." Teresa said as a frown appeared over her face.
"What sort of key is it?" Vritra asked.
"It's a set of objects, like the pupil of its creator, his hands and his energy. Only that can start the fuel, in other words we will still need the creator." Teresa answered.
The creator was smart and had made preparations in advance just in case anyone tried to steal it.
If she wanted to remove the key mechanics, then a lot needed to be changed in it.
"So we need to find Asmodeus..." the frown on his face deepened, how were they going to find that guy now?
What if he had already travelled far enough towards the tower by creating a better flying ship or something?
"So, we have to abandon this?" he sighed but just then...
[A player has been detected in the city.]
Vritra had already killed three players, Morgan, Crow and that stupid lord.
"Could it be Asmodeus? Hmm did he come here for his ship?" he wondered.
But it was great news.
"The key might be coming to us on its own." Vritra said, as he led the group outside the flying ship.
They sat down and started eating while waiting.
"What if it's some other player?" Maeve asked.
"Then we kill and continue on our path, I am sure we will meet Asmodeus sooner or later." Vritra replied with a shrug.
Then he asked: "Tess, if you redo it all, how long do you think it will take?"
"Hmm I will have to literally change everything, so it might even take several weeks." She replied helplessly.
Vritra nodded, so finding Asmodeus was their only choice currently.
After they finished eating, the group was just walking around when they sensed a group of thirty or so approaching them sneakily.
"Here they are." Vritra said as the corners of his lips curled up into a smile.
None of them reacted though.
Asmodeus and the others were hidden thanks to the ability of one of the lackeys.
"There it is!! There really is our ship, those are the thieves!!" one of the underlings shouted, before getting a slap on his head.
"Stay silent." Asmodeus cursed then observed it all.
There were no marks under the flying ship but the land was created from some red object, so it was possible that the mark could disappear.
'Hmm' after a few more observations about the ship, he determined that the flying ship had not yet been activated.
"But then how did it get here?" several thoughts popped into his mind.
'Great, whoever was behind it, if only I can make them work under me. Life would be so easy!'
He finally glanced at the people and his eyes widened.
"Whoa, so many beauties? Am I dreaming? L- Lord, what is going on?" one of the men asked, pinching Asmodeus to wake him up.
"Ugh bastard, pinch yourself!" Asmodeus shouted, but the sight was truly shocking.
Even though he wasn't overly lustful, but seeing those women, even he was frozen.
"Let's go and have a chat with them." Asmodeus smiled, finally walking out towards the ten people who were lazily strolling around.
"Whoaaaa who are you? How did you find us? Oh no, we are dead, let me escape!" right as the big group arrived, Shitless began his shitty acting.
"No one leaves now!" Asmodeus spoke arrogantly, his gaze sweeping over the women before stopping at Vritra.
"Tell me, how did you bring this thing here?"
"About that, we picked it up and carried it here." Vritra answered, shrugging before asking:
"Are you Asmodeus?"
After asking, he also opened his status panel.
[You have come in contact with a player!]
[Eliminate him to steal his ascension path and opportunities!]
[Player: Asmodeus]
[Ability: Create]
[Ascension Path: Creation]
'Jackpot!!' Vritra's lips instantly stretched into a big smile as soon as he saw the name.
