But finding so many components that he couldn't build himself would be near impossible.
"Grrrr Let's first search around for it!" he ordered, his fists clenched.
The group then began to run around the city but even after a while they didn't find anything.
Just then the GPS guy paused, his eyes wide and a big smile on his face.
"Lord, I found it!
The ship is in that direction, I can definitely sense it haha!!" he shouted.
Asmodeus followed the direction and found that it was going towards the tower.
"Are you sure?" he asked, staring intently at the underling.
"100%, it is definitely in that direction.
Maybe those thieves got it started somehow and took it away." He added.
"Whatever might be the case, we have to find it.
Take these objects along, let's go!"
Without wasting any time, they started running in the direction of the flying ship.
On the other side, Vritra and the others were helping Teresa, she had already understood the mechanics and was now close to fixing it.
"We will need a lot of fuel." Teresa spoke.
"You don't have to worry about that, I have a whole lot of petrol and diesel." Vritra said.
"Hmm they can work, just give me a little more time and I will try to get it running.
For now, fill the diesel into the tank." Teresa spoke.
And Vritra took out a lot of barrels, filling the tank of the flying ship, it consumed so much of the diesel.
Thankfully, Vritra wasn't lacking and could get even more easily.
After filling the tank to the brim, he returned to Teresa's side.
"Hmm we are mostly done, but it looks like we will need some sort of key.
I can get it started without the key but then we would be wasting a lot of time." Teresa said as a frown appeared over her face.
"What sort of key is it?" Vritra asked.
"It's a set of objects, like the pupil of its creator, his hands and his energy.
Only that can start the fuel, in other words we will still need the creator." Teresa answered.
The creator was smart and had made preparations in advance just in case anyone tried to steal it.
If she wanted to remove the key mechanics, then a lot needed to be changed in it.
"So we need to find Asmodeus..." the frown on his face deepened, how were they going to find that guy now?
What if he had already travelled far enough towards the tower by creating a better flying ship or something?
"So, we have to abandon this?" he sighed but just then...
[A player has been detected in the city.]
Vritra had already killed three players, Morgan, Crow and that stupid lord.
"Could it be Asmodeus?
Hmm did he come here for his ship?" he wondered.
But it was great news.
"The key might be coming to us on its own." Vritra said, as he led the group outside the flying ship.
They sat down and started eating while waiting.
"What if it's some other player?" Maeve asked.
"Then we kill and continue on our path, I am sure we will meet Asmodeus sooner or later." Vritra replied with a shrug.
Then he asked: "Tess, if you redo it all, how long do you think it will take?"
"Hmm I will have to literally change everything, so it might even take several weeks." She replied helplessly.
Vritra nodded, so finding Asmodeus was their only choice currently.
After they finished eating, the group was just walking around when they sensed a group of thirty or so approaching them sneakily.
"Here they are." Vritra said as the corners of his lips curled up into a smile.
None of them reacted though.
Asmodeus and the others were hidden thanks to the ability of one of the lackeys.
"There it is!!
There really is our ship, those are the thieves!!" one of the underlings shouted, before getting a slap on his head.
"Stay silent." Asmodeus cursed then observed it all.
There were no marks under the flying ship but the land was created from some red object, so it was possible that the mark could disappear.
'Hmm' after a few more observations about the ship, he determined that the flying ship had not yet been activated.
"But then how did it get here?" several thoughts popped into his mind.
'Great, whoever was behind it, if only I can make them work under me.
Life would be so easy!'
He finally glanced at the people and his eyes widened.
"Whoa, so many beauties?
Am I dreaming?
L- Lord, what is going on?" one of the men asked, pinching Asmodeus to wake him up.
"Ugh bastard, pinch yourself!" Asmodeus shouted, but the sight was truly shocking.
Even though he wasn't overly lustful, but seeing those women, even he was frozen.
"Let's go and have a chat with them." Asmodeus smiled, finally walking out towards the ten people who were lazily strolling around.
"Whoaaaa who are you?
How did you find us?
Oh no, we are dead, let me escape!" right as the big group arrived, Shitless began his shitty acting.
"No one leaves now!" Asmodeus spoke arrogantly, his gaze sweeping over the women before stopping at Vritra.
"Tell me, how did you bring this thing here?"
"About that, we picked it up and carried it here." Vritra answered, shrugging before asking:
"Are you Asmodeus?"
After asking, he also opened his status panel.
[You have come in contact with a player!]
[Eliminate him to steal his ascension path and opportunities!]
[Player: Asmodeus]
[Ability: Create]
[Ascension Path: Creation]
'Jackpot!!' Vritra's lips instantly stretched into a big smile as soon as he saw the name.

chapters.title: Chapter 719 The Master Mind
paragraphs: "Hmm? Yes I am Asmodeus. How do you know my name?" he asked, his smile disappearing.
The lackeys surrounding him were mainly for labour, they contributed little to the battle prowess of the team.
So Asmodeus would have to rely on himself in case a battle broke out.
'How do they know my name? Don't tell me, I wasn't the one following them, instead they brought us all here?'
Asmodeus suddenly had a bad feeling in his heart.
"T- Tell me, how did you steal this ship?!!" this time, he was less arrogant and slight fear was evident in his voice.
"Like this." Vritra said as he leaned back and touched the large flying ship, and it instantly disappeared.
"H- Huh? How? Is that a space ability?" he asked in bafflement.
Vritra brought the flying ship back, then Teresa touched it and it disappeared again.
"Y- You too possess a space ability? How?" Asmodeus was breathing heavily, feeling the weight of all his accessories even more.
"Anyway, my wife repaired this ship but she told me we need a key to get it started." While speaking, Vritra gestured towards Shitless with his eyes.
"Huh? Pitiful one, why are you rolling your eyes?" Shitless asked, he was just waiting to see chaos start.
"Haa this monk..." Vritra covered his face with his palm, this monk was getting worse, wasn't he?
Or was he this stupid from the beginning?
"Sir Shitless, if you can, please bring that assassin down?" Vritra asked with a kind smile that scared the monk Shitless shitless.
This monk was such an aura killer and embarrassment.
"Oh y- yes sir!" he saluted quickly, for some reason, he didn't doubt that Vritra might send him into the flood water if he angered him.
He wouldn't die but Shitless didn't want to go through that disgusting feeling ever again.
Not the third time.
He quickly ran away while Vritra shook his head and continued:
"And I heard the key is... your hands, your eyes and your energy, is that right?"
GULP
Asmodeus gulped his saliva, sweat dripping down his face heavily, he never thought anyone could ever understand it.
"..." he didn't know what to say.
"So, I planned to rip away your hands, pluck out your eyes and well I will keep you alive for a while to use your energy." Vritra said casually.
"L- Lord, what the hell is he saying? How dare he disrespect you!! Just let me go and I will beat him up!!" one of the men shouted, rage on his face.
"..." Asmodeus tried to free his hand, this guy was holding onto him for his dear life.
"Sigh since you don't want me to kill them, then lord please take care of them." The middle aged man sighed and stepped back.
"Uwaaaaah L- Let go of me, Baldy and don't you dare disrespect lord Asmodeus!!" suddenly a loud scream sounded.
Shitless dragged along the assassin, clutching his hair.
Then he threw him in front of Asmodeus.
"Why exactly did you send these assassins to kill me?" Vritra asked, his tone getting serious.
"Huh? Who is this? I only adopted these useless bastards, I don't know-" Asmodeus looked at the young assassin's face, speaking in confusion.
And what was this guy even talking about assassination? Weren't they just meeting for the first time?
"Lorrrdddd!! H- How can you... SOB How can you abandon me in the face of danger, they all died for you, look what they have done to me!! That Baldy even SOB even threw me into dirty water."
The young guy started to cry.
Vritra frowned, watching the drama, now which of them was lying?
"Huh? You stupid bastard, I don't even-" Asmodeus was enraged as he started to curse and pointed his fingers towards the assassin.
But right as he pointed, the assassin began to cough violently, blood appearing in his eyes and throat swelling.
"L- Lord, UGHH y- you didn't GRRKKK didn't have to kill COUGH COUGH me to bury the m- matte..."
BOOM
Suddenly, his throat exploded, his head flying in a different direction.
Asmodeus jumped back in fright, when did he get so strong? He looked at his fingers in wonder, did he obtain some new ability unconsciously?
Vritra: "..."
"The thirty of you, run away now." Vritra said lazily, his gaze fixed on Asmodeus.
"L- Lord..." they all looked at him firmly.
"Guys..." Asmodeus looked at their faces, and for the first time, felt proud.
He always cursed them and even beat them up, but now that they were facing a deadly situation, these guys stood by his side.
Even in the face of death they didn't abando-
"Please take care lord, we will wait for you." One of his underlings spoke in a sad tone.
Then he faced Vritra, and spoke angrily, while sneakily sliding backwards: "Don't you dare beat our lord too much, at least not his face, or... or we will come back!"
Then nodding towards Asmodeus as if the situation was under their control, they turned and ran away in a hurry.
'These fucking bitches, agggghhhhhh' he looked at Vritra and in an impatient tone, asked: "Can you kill those guys first?"
Rolling his eyes, Vritra ignored the men who ran away and repeated: "Tell me, were you really behind all this?"
Asmodeus looked at the corpse, then sighed, would his words even matter?
He too couldn't understand what was happening.
"Of course I wasn't, I don't even know you guys. I only came after this ship of mine- yours, I should leave now, haha right? please?" he asked, when necessary it was better to put aside pride.
And there was no one around too.
"Do you know someone named Magna?" Vritra questioned, folding his arms over his chest.
Normally he would have just killed this guy but there were too many things that were confusing him.
"Magna? Of course, I know that fucker. He is my sworn enemy, why wouldn't I know him!!" Asmodeus was instantly filled with anger.
"Oh, what is his ability? And what happened between you two?" Vritra asked, since the key of the flying ship was here.
They could now reach the tower really fast.
"His ability is copying but in a special manner, he can create clones, it is kinda complex-" Asmodeus was answering but got interrupted.
"What? Isn't his ability that bubble one?" Vritra asked, as expected there was something terribly wrong from the beginning.
"No? the bubble ability was Mentro's, he was Magna's friend- wait don't tell me he got Mentro too? Sigh I warned him..." Asmodeus shook his head.
Then added: "Magna almost killed my woman, but succeeded in killing off my brothers. He killed a lot of people back on our planet too."
"Hmm Then who was the one I killed? The name the status window displayed was clearly Magna's." Vritra frowned, and he had killed a player too.
"Did I kill that Mentro guy? But how?" Vritra quickly used blood to draw Magna's face in the air.
"Is that him?"
"Yes, that's Magna, you killed him?" Asmodeus didn't believe that clever guy would be killed so easily.
He was more cunning than a thousand foxes and way too ruthless, a psychopath.
"But the one I killed had the bubble ability, so he is still alive?"
Vritra didn't know how this clone ability worked but he was starting to understand Magna's plan now.
So those assassins were really sent by him!!

chapters.title: Chapter 720 Wiped Out!
paragraphs: "I- If he had the bubble ability then that must be Mentro but completely under Magna's control, already as a clone." Asmodeus spoke.
"I see, so he planned it from the beginning." Vritra now understood all of Magna's planning.
That guy wanted to use them to kill his enemy, but his ability sure was strange.
Maybe he didn't usually stay in the Renko city or just got lucky, but now he was not going to survive.
'But I doubt he would still be in the city.' Vritra thought, then looked back at Teresa.
"Tess, can we use this ship, now that the key is here?"
"Yes, but is the key willing?" she asked, an innocent smile on her face under the veil.
"Hmm I wonder, so key, are you?" Vritra too had a small smile as he looked at Asmodeus.
The arrogant, proud and strong lord shivered, he didn't know their strength but felt a single wrong decision would be the end of him.
"I- I am, I was born to be a key, d- damn lock where the fuck are you?!!" he quickly looked around but there was no flying ship.
Teresa brought back the spaceship and opened the door as they all made their way inside.
But before entering, Asmodeus didn't forget to leave a comment for his old comrades: "You bastards, you can all go to hell!!"
Soon, all of them were inside the control room, seated on the comfortable seats.
Asmodeus wasted no time as he fulfilled his duty as the key and stood to the side silently.
A part of him wanted to challenge Vritra, if only to test his strength, but he had this instinct stopping him.
"Ready, we are!" Teresa spoke, as the entire ship buzzed then let out a loud noise, it finally started.
'Whoa, they really made it work!!' Asmodeus thought, he was still sceptical about Vritra's words but it seemed that was not a lie.
Extreme heat emitted towards the blood floor, as the ship began to rise.
"Husband, are we going towards the tower?" Teresa asked excitedly.
"No, let's first go and check the Renko city." Vritra replied, he wanted to check it out.
"Alright, sit tight, everyone!" hearing her warning, all of them fastened their belts.
Teresa's seat was right near the controls, while there were over twenty seats behind.
Asmodeus quickly approached and sat on one of the seats at the back, trying to make sure his presence didn't disturb others.
'Heh this guy might be the most humble player.' Vritra chuckled seeing him, no wonder he was going around with that stupid bunch.
After reaching a certain height, the flying ship shot in the direction of the Renko city, its speed faster than anyone expected.
WHOOSH
It left behind a fiery trail, crossing several kilometres within a matter of seconds.
And within a few minutes they had actually arrived over the Renko city, the same distance that had taken them so many hours.
"This is wonderful!" Vritra exclaimed, the others were equally surprised.
"New slave, can you make one for me too?" Shitless asked, turning back to look at Asmodeus.
"Y- Yes sir, I can try but it might not work." Asmodeus replied while feeling angry that even this Baldy was acting so high.
The flying ship slowly approached the city but they all noticed several changes.
The bubble that Vritra had left was gone.
The city was full of flood water, it was a scene of complete destruction.
But more than that, Vritra couldn't sense a single life in the entire city.
He got out of the ship and flew around, seeing the marks and blood stains over the tall buildings.
It was obvious that all the humans there were killed before the bubble disappeared.
"So, Magna returned here after I left and killed them all?" Vritra's expression was solemn.
Although he wasn't really fond of the crowd there but it wasn't to the point of hating them.
It still left a bad taste that they were all just killed like that.
First that player named Sonic wiped everyone out and now this Magna.
These fucking players didn't think of life as anything, sigh the whole system was fucked up.
Floating at the top, Vritra looked down at the Renko city that was now in ruins, all lives lost.
All of them were gone, young, old, men, women, not even the kids were spared in this brutal massacre.
He was now in a bad mood.
So, that Magna guy not only ran away but killed them all before escaping.
Based on his cunning, Vritra expected that Magna wouldn't stay there, whether the plan succeeded or not.
But he was far too merciless and psychotic, the type to do anything for their goals.
'Well he didn't spare his own friend, what can be expected of him?' Vritra shook his head and flew back.
"They are all dead, and Magna is gone. These pigs are such psychos, sigh" Vritra spoke after returning to the ship.
Asmodeus's heartbeat rose, he was afraid that Vritra might kill him in rage.
He just sat there silently, hoping to disappear and not be seen.
"Let's just head towards the tower for now, maybe on the way we might find him." Vanessa spoke.
"Yeah and I can spread my shadows and master, you can spread your blood clones to search him." Maeve suggested.
"Hmm let's do that, anyway let's just head to the tower and get this game over with." He sat down, after releasing hundreds of blood clones in all directions.
Maeve also sent the shadows in different directions.
Then the ship started and flew, flying just as fast as before, although it was crazily consuming the diesel but they had way more than needed.
They passed through several cities within minutes, at such a speed within a few hours they would be near the tower.
Normally it would have taken them more than a week or two weeks, even if not more.
Vritra sat with his eyes closed, releasing spiritual bursts while letting his clones search the area.
Nearly twenty minutes had passed when Teresa stopped the flying ship.
It was almost an abrupt stop, though she had applied brakes in advance.
"What's wrong?" Fiona asked, she was just enjoying the ride.
"There is something enormous in the way, we will have to take a detour it seems." Teresa answered, looking at the screen of the ship.
"I will go check." Vritra stretched his arms and got up.
He jumped out as the doors opened.
'Wait, now that he has gone, should I make a run for my life?' Asmodeus wondered, but even these women were scary now.
They were exuding such a strong aura that despite being at the 2nd Evolution, he felt too weak.
So he decided to just stay put.
Vritra flew forward, sensing a very strong life force.
The air was a little foggy, but he could clearly see the enormous thing before him, it was nearly as big as a city and reaching so high up.
Vritra focused and looked at its status panel.
"Oh A whale? This sure got big." He mumbled to himself.
A round white object nearly 6 feet wide was moving over the blue surface of the mutant whale.
It was like an eye, which was constantly revolving over its skin.
Suddenly, the eye paused as it fixed on Vritra and then an ear piercing scream rang out.
IIIIIEEEEEEEEEEEE

But he was far too merciless and psychotic, the type to do anything for their goals.
'Well he didn't spare his own friend, what can be expected of him?' Vritra shook his head and flew back.
"They are all dead, and Magna is gone.
These pigs are such psychos, sigh" Vritra spoke after returning to the ship.
Asmodeus's heartbeat rose, he was afraid that Vritra might kill him in rage.
He just sat there silently, hoping to disappear and not be seen.
"Let's just head towards the tower for now, maybe on the way we might find him." Vanessa spoke.
"Yeah and I can spread my shadows and master, you can spread your blood clones to search him." Maeve suggested.
"Hmm let's do that, anyway let's just head to the tower and get this game over with." He sat down, after releasing hundreds of blood clones in all directions.
Maeve also sent the shadows in different directions.
Then the ship started and flew, flying just as fast as before, although it was crazily consuming the diesel but they had way more than needed.
They passed through several cities within minutes, at such a speed within a few hours they would be near the tower.
Normally it would have taken them more than a week or two weeks, even if not more.
Vritra sat with his eyes closed, releasing spiritual bursts while letting his clones search the area.
Nearly twenty minutes had passed when Teresa stopped the flying ship.
It was almost an abrupt stop, though she had applied brakes in advance.
"What's wrong?" Fiona asked, she was just enjoying the ride.
"There is something enormous in the way, we will have to take a detour it seems." Teresa answered, looking at the screen of the ship.
"I will go check." Vritra stretched his arms and got up.
He jumped out as the doors opened.
'Wait, now that he has gone, should I make a run for my life?' Asmodeus wondered, but even these women were scary now.
They were exuding such a strong aura that despite being at the 2nd Evolution, he felt too weak.
So he decided to just stay put.
Vritra flew forward, sensing a very strong life force.
The air was a little foggy, but he could clearly see the enormous thing before him, it was nearly as big as a city and reaching so high up.
Vritra focused and looked at its status panel.
"Oh A whale?
This sure got big." He mumbled to himself.
A round white object nearly 6 feet wide was moving over the blue surface of the mutant whale.
It was like an eye, which was constantly revolving over its skin.
Suddenly, the eye paused as it fixed on Vritra and then an ear piercing scream rang out.
IIIIIEEEEEEEEEEEE

chapters.title: Chapter 721 The Light Man
paragraphs: The big eye suddenly focused on Vritra, as the mutant whale let out a deafening roar.
Its size was seriously so big that an entire city seemed to be under it.
Vritra just rolled his eyes as he pointed his hand forward, this thing was too noisy.
"Blood Explosion" he mumbled.
Then a powerful wave of blood surged forward and drilled a massive hole into the whale's body as it screamed and began to roll over.
But suddenly...
BOOOOOOM
The insides exploded with so much force that the enormous body of the whale broke into countless tiny pieces, red blood and flesh started to rain down.
And it was gone, just like that.
'Holy fucking shit!! What the hell is this?!' back in the flying ship, Asmodeus's soul almost left his body.
He looked around and none even had a surprised expression, what sort of monsters was he surrounded by?
And he wanted to put up a fight against them?
Asmodeus slapped himself hard, cursing his past self for arrogantly following after his ship.
'It's all because of that tracker bastard, if I see him again I'll feed him to fishes!' Asmodeus thought, his face turning white in fear.
Vritra calmly returned into the ship, there was not a single drop of blood on his body.
"Let's continue." He spoke, so far the clones have not found anything useful.
The tower was still pretty far away, but they have already travelled such a long distance.
Teresa nodded and the flying ship started to move again.
"Key" Vritra called out.
"Y- Yes sir?" Asmodeus asked instantly, now he was far more tame than before.
"Do you have any way to locate the other players? Or do you know anything about that tower?" Vritra asked.
"N- No sir, I don't have any way to find them but I know a little about the tower..." he added quickly.
"That tower is supposed to be our final trial, after clearing it we will have cleared this game or by surviving long enough."
Vritra nodded, though he didn't get any new info.
To lighten his mood he chatted with his wives, the scene of deaths of all those humans was bothering him.
He had seen plenty of death but it never gets easy, especially thinking that even little kids were killed there brutally.
The ship flew at such incredible speed, most mutants couldn't even react to it but of course there were few flying mutants who were nearly as fast.
They tried to get close but were killed instantly by a single spiritual burst from Vritra or Yasmine.
And so after a few dozen minutes, they had crossed several cities and had gotten closer to the tower.
Right as they entered another city, a message popped before Vritra.
[You have encountered 4 players!]
"Four at once? Well we are indeed pretty close to the tower, I guess they are just hunting here."
The ground was still full of flood water but as they were getting closer to the tower, the quantity was decreasing.
And now there was barely any.
"Tess, we will be stopping here for a while and continue after a short rest." Vritra spoke.
Teresa slowly stopped the ship, then it landed in an open area.
Before walking out, Vritra filled the tanks of the flying ship with diesel again.
Then they walked out and stored the flying ship away.
The place was in complete ruins, barely any buildings were still intact.
But the city was pretty big and it wouldn't be easy to find those players.
'Maybe Asmodeus was counted in it too? Aside from Sonic and Magna, I have no knowledge about the rest of the four players.' Vritra thought as he lightly stretched his body.
But with Asmodeus around, he didn't have to worry.
"Key, create a device which could release extremely loud sound to attract all the mutants and humans." Vritra ordered.
"Uhm... Okay I will try." Asmodeus pondered and then nodded.
Instantly he got to work, wondering what sort of sound Vritra was going to use to attract them all.
Energy rushed out of his body and soon started to materialize, it became a big machine.
After around ten or so minutes...
"Sir, this thing should be loud enough to transmit your voice to nearly the entire city." Asmodeus said meekly.
"Sir Shitless, can you come here and ask for some help while mentioning a treasure?" Vritra asked.
'Huh? This Baldy? Pfft as if anyone would come when he is the one calling-' the meek guy laughed internally.
"Yes pitiful one." Shitless nodded, he stood before what looked like a mic.
His body started to transform and soon he had become a beautiful girl.
'W- What the fuck?!' Asmodeus stared in bafflement.
"Kiyaaa Please someone save me Ahhh These brute beasts want to HUFF steal my treasure Hnnn whoever can save me, can own me and the treasure ughhh hurry up to the south boundary."
Shitless spoke in a sexy tone, appearing helpless.
Hearing the loud noise, a lot of mutants began to rush towards them.
And not so surprisingly, even the normal mutants were very powerful here.
These guys were progressing way faster, maybe it was because of the tower.
Vritra killed them and threw their bodies away, they sat down to one side as Maeve's shadows covered them.
Only Shitless in woman form and Asmodeus were standing there now.
Soon a group of humans came to rescue the damsel but there was no player.
'Magna is such a womanizer, but he is also very cunning. I wonder if he would fall for it.' Vritra wondered.
Soon more mutants and humans started to appear, if any of the humans tried to attack they were killed instantly.
Otherwise they were just scared away.
And it wasn't long before a man whose body was glowing brightly like a sun approached and Vritra saw the status.
[You have come in contact with a player!]
[Eliminate him to steal his ascension path and opportunities!]
[Player: Addi]
[Ability: Light]
[Ascension Path: Light Man]
"Light?" Vritra stared at the player who was moving very fast, his ability greatly enhanced his speed.
And he was already close to the 5th Evolution.
"Let her go basta- huh? Asmodeus? What are you doing here? Didn't you hear our warning to not appear anywhere near the tower?"
The human torch chuckled upon seeing Asmodeus.
It seems this lord Asmodeus had quite the low status among the players, and was weak.
"Hmph you dog, do you think I am afraid of you? I am here to put that building up your ass!!" Asmodeus shouted, having someone as powerful as Vritra around gave him confidence.
"Oh, looks like you have grown a tongue now. Do you want to die?" Addi's expression darkened, the heat around him increasing.
"As if you can do anything, bastard if you dare try touching me!" Asmodeus said proudly, while waiting for Vritra to make his move.
"Hah look at this bitch, looks like you grew some balls now huh well time to burst your balls then." After speaking, Addi suddenly shot forward.
"H- Help!!" Asmodeus was afraid now, wondering why Vritra had not yet come.
An armour appeared around his body but as the glowing hand of Addi approached, it broke in an instant.
But right as the punch was about to collide, the glowing hand was stopped by a slender arm which then turned metallic.
"No one hurts my slave!!" Shitless announced.

chapters.title: Chapter 722 The Oldies
paragraphs: "Don't hurt my slave!" Shitless spoke, as he held the arm of Addi.
"S- Sir..." Asmodeus looked at the Baldy in reverence. He had been cursing Shitless all this time and in the end he is the one to save him.
Addi was terrified, as he let out a fearful scream.
A beautiful woman had just transformed into a terrifying bald red mutant, he felt his soul leaving his body.
Vritra and the others finally made their appearance.
Only upon seeing the real women did Addi calm down, Shitless had gotten too scary.
"Let go of me if you don't want to lose your arm or even your life. Is he really worth protecting?" Addi asked, wrinkling his nose.
"Shitless, just get rid of him. More players might arrive soon, let's not waste any time." Vritra interrupted.
"Alright, give me a second." Shitless looked at the human torch and muttered:
"There is nothing personal, but I am just that evil. I kill people for no reason, I am the worst right?" he asked, but instead of fear only contempt appeared over Addi's face.
"Sigh goodbye then." Shitless didn't give him any time and in the next moment...
BOOOM
Addi's head exploded with a single punch, as his body went limp and all life force disappeared.
"W- Whoa, you are very strong, sir!!" Asmodeus spoke in shock, so all of them are monsters?
Maybe as long as he doesn't make a mistake he is safer with them than being with those thirty idiots?
"Shitless, keep doing that and bring more players. We need to finish this game quickly." Vritra said as several messages popped before him.
He already had the power of fire so this new ability didn't contribute all that much, though it would increase his flying speed.
"Haha that guy's expressions were hilarious when Shitless transformed." Yasmine laughed, he really looked as if his world had turned upside down.
"More people are coming, let's hide." Maeve said, they only hoped that Sonic or Magna would arrive there.
They had already killed four of the players, and Asmodeus was with them so that left five more to go.
Shitless again began to shout into the mic in his sexy voice, Asmodeus stood beside him confidently this time.
He took on the role of the villain.
"Hehe beauty, just give up. No one strong is coming to save you, I am going to take that treasure and you for myself kekeke"
He spoke into the mic and didn't forget to add the villain's laugh.
Soon more mutants came running but were all instantly killed and thrown away by Vritra.
Many humans also came running.
"Beauty, I am here to help you. Just come with me!!" an old man with a shaky body shouted, with a bunch of old men following him.
Actually they were all young guys when the apocalypse started but he obtained a powerful but deadly ability.
The more energy he used the more of his life force was sucked and even of the ones around him.
Soon they had become such old guys though managed to survive all the danger.
"Just get lost if you don't want to die, I don't hurt old or women." Asmodeus muttered dismissively.
"How dare you COUGH COUGH" another guy shouted too hard and had a violent cough, as he coughed out blood.
"Just get lost, don't waste our time. We are just doing a play, I am not even a beauty." Shitless was annoyed, he spoke as his form transformed.
"U- Uwaaaaah Eyes My eyes aaaaaaaahhhhh" one old man clutched his eyes and began to roll on the ground.
Almost as if acid had been thrown into them.
While the coughing one coughed even harder, before falling to the ground, he seemed almost dead.
The others suddenly looked paler.
"BALDIEEE!! How dare you play with our feelings, you have to pay for it now!!" one of the old guys shouted.
"Yes brother, now that the women are gone. I don't even care as long as there is a hole, and with my eyesight I can't see anyway."
"YESSS!! We can't die virgins, we have to COUGH graduate before dying. Capture this hole guy right now!!"
The old men were suddenly filled with energy as they all screamed and ran towards Shitless.
For a moment both Shitless and Asmodeus were afraid, these guys looked as if a strong wind might be enough to push them into the graves.
"C- Can they even get it up?" Asmodeus wondered, only to receive a slap from Shitless.
"Go and check if you are so curious, this guy also has holes you can use." Shitless shouted and pushed Asmodeus towards the degenerate old men.
"Capture them all, no holes will be barred today!! Hahaha we are finally going to lose it!!"
Onest laughed from the corner.
"You can do it, oldies. Take him!!" he cheered on from the side.
Vritra shook his head, these guys were still playing around, what if a player comes now and there is no Sonia to show?
Several blood tentacles moved forward, wrapping around the feet of the old men, then threw them away far enough.
"Hoo that was close..." Asmodeus wiped his face, he couldn't believe he was this close to getting touched by the old men's group.
Shitless had already transformed into Sonia and was about to continue to speak in the mic.
BOOOOOOM!
Just then a guy landed there heavily, the explosion was so wild that it created a large crater.
He was wearing a heavy black armor and looked quite menacing.
'Another player, finally!' Vritra smiled as he opened his status panel, Shitless truly had a knack to attract attention.
Especially as Sonia, he could pull almost any man's interest.
[You have come in contact with a player!]
[Eliminate him to steal his ascension path and opportunities!]
[Player: Sonic]
[Ability: Sound]
[Ascension Path: Sound Waves]
'Sonic, so he is the guy who destroyed the entire city in a single attack after finding some treasure.' Vritra thought.
And it seemed this very armor was his treasure, it was not bad but nothing too impressive.
"What is going on here?" Sonic asked as his gaze fixed on Sonia, then moved onto Asmodeus.
"You weak bastard, why are you here? Didn't I order you to not approach the tower?" Sonic asked, his voice sounding arrogant.
Vritra observed him for a few moments, before finally revealing himself.
He and his wives walked out, standing before Sonic.
"So you are Sonic, the guy who destroyed a city. What do you think about that?" Vritra asked, standing calmly there.

"Hmm, did he tell you about me? Heh no wonder he dared to oppose me, so he got some backup huh, but why is your backup so full of women? Hahaha are they going to hurt me?" Sonic laughed and shook his head.
Then he answered: "Well yeah, I did kill them. I just obtained the treasure and wanted to test it, but who knew it was so powerful, it was an accident.
But eh, who cares, they are all bugs whose lives don't matter at all. Who cares, anyway, women how about you follow me instead of these losers?"
Vritra patiently listened to his answers, and nodded:
"Yeah right, everyone makes mistakes. It's really not a big deal, who even cares about others' life."

chapters.title: Chapter 723 The Punctured Sonic
paragraphs: "Right, haa you are smart. Now get lost before I do something accidental." Sonic warned.
He looked from Sonia to all the other women, really baffled that there were women of beauty of this level.

The dots kept getting bigger and soon they could see them perfectly clearly.

Teresa's face was already covered with a veil, Vritra covered his face with a mask then they began to walk around as if they hadn't noticed anything.
"Should I freeze them right away?" Teresa asked, her voice a whisper.
"No, don't attack until we are sure the real one is among them. We can't let the real one escape again."

"Once Diana is awake, we can keep torturing him and she can heal him, so he properly regrets his actions." Teresa said, as a smile appeared on her face.

All the clones nodded at once.

"Hey hey, don't be afraid calm down. We aren't here to hurt you, we are just passing by." One of the Magnas spoke.

"Magna, do you know who I am?
I am Einstein, the one who went to the Renko city, the one who killed that other clone of yours." Vritra said as his lips curled up in a twisted devil-like smile.
"Ah N-No it can't be... aahhhhhh R-Run I have to runnnnnnnn" Magna gave up on his clones, using his hand he tried to flee.
Unfortunately, he had become extremely weak now.
"Well you are in luck that my family is kinda busy now, so your torture will have to wait till tomorrow." Vritra muttered with a shake of his head.
"But since you are our guest, we gotta treat you right and can't leave you without any hospitality for the day." He added.
Magna stared in utter terror, screaming in dread as blood pooled under him.

chapters.title: Chapter 730 Clone Lover
paragraphs: Magna was just terrified, he began to beg for mercy, crying and saying all sorts of things.
But the screams only made the smile on Vritra's face bigger, this was truly so fun.
Magna's strength was quite high, if Vritra had not trained in that cave for weeks, he might not be a match right now.
After all he had wiped out an entire city.
In the end, his cunning and greed had brought him to his doom.
"Hmm there is still a little over a day for everyone to finish their evolution, till then..." Vritra pondered as he gazed around, then his smile widened.
"Since you like to play with your clones so much, then now I am giving you freedom. Go all out, forget all moralities or shame, use all of them and enjoy."
After speaking, Vritra created a blood room that locked Magna and all the clones inside.
"N-Noooooo please not thisssss aaaaaaah" he screamed even louder.
"You bastard, I didn't even ughhhh hurt you- COUGH g-get away from me, OWW my clothes nooooo-"
Soon the screams died down as Vritra sealed them up inside the room.
The over forty clones all crawled over Magna and began to make love with him.
"Hmm I wonder what's this called... selfcest?" he wondered, but finally felt a lot better.
"Hehe Husband, this is perfect. Let him enjoy himself for a day, tomorrow we will all torture and kill him." Teresa spoke in her sweet innocent voice.
Vritra nodded, patting her head.
"Let's go, we shouldn't disturb him." Vritra said, he didn't even want to imagine what should be happening inside.
Over forty clones, all of them on one man, it must be a complete disaster.
But Magna deserved it and worse.
And soon another player would be gone.
The two strolled around a little longer, Vritra saw a few more mutants which were attracted by the noise.
Vritra killed them all with mental energy.
Both were in a great mood, and their second day together was even better.
After two days had passed, one by one all of them began to wake up.
They had evolved and reached the maximum strength possible for this planet.
All his wives jumped into Vritra's arms as they came out, now they could just go to the tower.
And soon, everyone was awake.
First they ate a large meal, and then Vritra told them that they had caught Magna.
"Great, have you killed him already? What a pity, I would have loved to rip that bastard apart-" Yasmine cursed, just like the Bone Blood Cult back on the Zoratian planet.
She hates people like that.
"No, I have kept him alive. Once you are all full and rested, we will torture him and then head to the tower." Vritra said.
"Haha This is going to be so fun!!" Shitless was very happy, but he wouldn't be so happy after seeing that guy.
After they were all full, Vritra brought them all down towards the blood room.
"He is inside." Vritra pointed.
"Huh? Why are such strange noises coming from inside this? It sounds chaotic." Onest asked, somehow he felt that the noise was kinda familiar.
Didn't that Oracle guy also make such noises?
"Vritra, don't tell me you..." he looked back at Vritra, shaking his head and laughed.
"Yeah well he wanted to play with his clones, so I gave them a room. Anyway, let's deal with him and then we will continue." Vritra added.
With a snap of his finger, the blood room started burning, and soon over forty charred figures came into view.
Magna was lying at the centre, while all exhausted clones lay around him, they sure had a wild day.
First Vritra threw away the clones, making them explode.
Now only Magna remained, he was already in such a bad condition, but deserved way more than that.
One by one all the women launched attacks at him, flames, mental attacks, lightning, mental torture and much more.
Onest and Shitless didn't want to get close so they just threw metal rods that pierced through his body.
After all that, Vritra slowly drained all the blood in his body until he turned into a shrivelled up corpse.
It was a disturbing sight but none felt pity for him, not after what he had done.
"Time to leave." Vritra turned around, leaving the corpse there as various messages popped in front of him.
He had obtained the clone ability but he did not plan to use such a disgusting skill.
Soon the flying ship was ready to set off, but then Shitless remembered that his slave was missing.
Asmodeus, the proud player, hid in a room under a bed, hoping they would forget someone as insignificant as him and leave.
Unfortunately, Shitless soon found him and dragged him away.
They were all seated when Teresa started the engine and the flying ship slowly rose higher.
The tower wasn't too far now, very soon they would reach it and then start the final and biggest challenge.
WHOOSH
At incredible speed, it shot off.
They quickly crossed over a hundred kilometres, passing over the cities.
Vritra had already killed six players, the seventh was with him so now only three unknown remained.
If he found them on the way then he would fight, otherwise he wouldn't go looking for them.
There were many mutants on the way, getting stronger and stronger the closer they were to the tower.
Even reaching up to the 5th evolution but one spiritual shock from Vritra was enough to kill them all.
And so, after another short travel the ship finally came to a stop.
They had arrived at their destination.
The flying ship slowly descended and parked in an open area, but even before they could get out a large horde of mutant rats attacked them.
They were very quick and powerful, their strongest part was of course their teeth which seemed to be able to bite into anything.
Storing away the flying ship quickly, the group floated in the air.
Asmodeus was using his gadgets to float beside them, he looked quite frightened as even a single rat among them was stronger than him.
"T-There are so many of them!! Master, save me!!" he shouted, hiding behind Shitless.
"..." Shitless looked back and couldn't help but smile, his slave called him master.
"They look completely mad, somehow different from the mutants we have faced before." Yennefer spoke as she pointed her finger forward and lightning descended.
THUNDERRR
BOOOM
With a loud sound, most of the rats were blasted to pieces, but a few which survived still kept trying to attack them.
"Yes, it feels like someone is controlling them. Could it be another player?" Diana asked, she waved her hand through the air, spreading poison.
Of course it wouldn't affect any of them, but would kill all nearby threats.
"Hmm there is no one around, so the controller can control them from a large distance." Maeve spoke, as she used her shadows to scan all over the place.
"Yeah it must be a player, and being so close to the tower, plus their ability to control beasts like this. Their strength must already be very high." Yasmine added.
"Honey, do you want to deal with him first or just head to the tower?" Vanessa asked, as all gazes shifted to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 731 Jackal
paragraphs: Vritra didn't answer immediately, he looked forward and pondered.
The tower was pretty close, and there were no signs of the player, so the choice was pretty obvious.
"Let's continue to the tower, there is a high chance he will appear before us himself." He shrugged.
"Haa finally, this last challenge and we will be out of this damned place, I am tired of smelling blood all the time." Fiona spoke, sighing with mental exhaustion.
The group of eleven then continued to walk towards the tower.
It was so high that the tip had disappeared into the sky, the whole tower had a white colour and was round in shape.
There was a big door attached to it, and everything seemed pretty normal.
Walking for a while, the group arrived near the door.
"Are you all ready?" Vritra paused and looked back.
"Yes we are, honey!" Vanessa nodded, the others all agreed, only one hand rose tremblingly.
"U-Uhm can I leave now? I don't think I will be of any help to you." Asmodeus spoke in a meek tone.
"No, you will be coming inside with us. We need a scapegoat, right? In case something goes wrong." Vritra shrugged, he walked closer to the door and was about to push it open.
But just then...
RUMBLE
The ground rumbled and cracks started to form everywhere, in the next moment, thousands of tiny insects shot out of the ground.
They looked as if they were made of steel, and buzzed so violently, filling the surroundings with a strong noise.
"Sigh Looks like someone doesn't want us to enter, mom can you handle it?" Vritra asked.
To bring out the sneaky bug who was doing this all, they couldn't show their true strength.
"Of course." Vanessa nodded as she snapped her finger.
But no change occurred, in the next moment the insects were upon them.
The deadly metallic insects started to tear their bodies apart, Asmodeus was the first to try to flee but was devoured.
Vritra and the others were completely helpless against this, with each passing moment, their body condition worsening.
Far away from them, a man with a thin and tall build was gazing at them while holding a small mirror.
The small mirror showed the projections in which Vritra, Onest, Shitless, all of them were badly injured and even the women seemed close to death.
"Hmm? They are weaker than I thought, but what can one expect from someone who is hanging out with that weakling Asmodeus." Shaking his head he put away the mirror and stood up.
Then jumping down from the building he landed on the back of a big bird, that flew towards the one-sided battle area quickly.
He could control quite a few mutant beasts but it only had one drawback, anyone killed by his followers didn't give him any mutation energy.
So after the enemies were subdued, he needed to go kill them personally.
"Those women looked beautiful, I wonder if I should spare one or two of them. Keke it's been so long since I last talked with any person, while I am here, I should get one of them."
This thought made him very excited.
He had been searching for some women but this area had none at all.
After flying for a few minutes, he arrived at the battle area. Gazing down, he was happy that no one was dead yet, he had ordered the insects to not kill them after all.
After looking over all the women, he was confused and wondered which woman he should spare, they were all too beautiful.
'Well first let's deal with the men, can't give them the time to use their skills.' After thinking, he landed and took out a knife.
"So, Jackal, nice to meet you." A voice suddenly sounded out of nowhere, startling the player.
In the next moment, the scene changed completely, the buzzing insects were gone, lying all over the ground, dead.
The badly injured people were still perfectly fine, looking at him mockingly.
Vritra had his arms crossed as he looked at this guy, staring directly at his status panel.
[You have come in contact with a player!]
[Eliminate him to steal his ascension path and opportunities!]
[Player: Jackal]
[Ability: Control]
[Ascension Path: Mind Hex]
"H-Huh? Illusion?!!" Jackal's eyes widened in shock, he looked around and saw that they were all fine.
And it was probably that green-haired woman who was responsible for such a realistic illusion.
"Y-You bastard Asmodeus, you are helping an outsider to kill your own friend?!! You cowardly bastard, you backstabber, you traitor, you asshole-" Jackal furiously began to shout.
In fact he just needed to buy himself a little time, soon every creature he controlled would be here.
Even if they couldn't kill these people, he would have enough time to escape.
He continued to shout for a couple of minutes and internally called for support but just as the creatures got close, they disappeared.
'What is going on? They must be trying to trap me in another illusion, heh as if I will fall for the same thing again. I am going to kill them all!!'
Jackal's strength was actually rather high, he could even kill people who had achieved their 6th evolution.
But he was unfortunate enough to meet this group.
"You bastard Asmodeus, once we go back, I will butcher everyone you know. I will rip your intestines, I will feed you your own shit, I will cut you and let my dog eat you!!"
A few more minutes passed yet no help came.
"What have you done? Why aren't my mutants appearing?" finally Jackal could no longer pretend, he looked strangely at Vritra and Vanessa.
"Oh you were still waiting for them? I thought you just wanted to curse your friend that's why I didn't disturb you. As for those mutants..."
Vritra muttered then he pointed his finger towards the ground and then dragged it up.
And then thousands of different types of dead mutants were revealed, all of them had been killed the moment they got close enough.
There were no marks on their bodies but no life force either.
"Uwaaaaah!!" Jackal fell over on his butt in terror, at first he still had some confidence in defeating them if things went bad.
But now, he was completely in despair.
"Wait, this has to be your illusion, you bastards I am going to kill-"
Vritra shook his head, threw a stone forward that punctured through his waist, creating a large hole in Jackal's body.
COUGH COUGH
He coughed violently and fell back, his intestines were in a mess and belly torn apart.
Vritra threw a few more stones to finish him quickly, he didn't want to waste any more time on this useless player.
And as soon as Jackal died, various messages popped before Vritra.
Again, he got the new ability and ascension path.
"It is strange, so many of them have abilities that directly or indirectly control other beings, like Morgan, Magna, Jackal, I wonder if it has something to do with the challenge of the tower."
He wondered but there was no point in thinking.
Finally, Vritra pushed the door open as a blinding light flashed before their eyes.
A large floor was revealed which was crowded by thousands of zombies and at the centre of the horde was a giant.

chapters.title: Chapter 732 The Godly Talk
paragraphs: Vritra and the others paused as they entered the tower, from the side a large set of stairs were going upwards.
The entrance to the stairs however was behind a door, which seemed to be locked.
The entire floor was only a very big hall, that was filled with thousands of zombies and a giant at the centre.
But they all looked pretty weak.
"I guess this is just the entrance so they are all pretty weak." Vritra shrugged. The zombies were growling as their attention shifted towards the new group.
Some people had been in the tower before, some had managed to clear this floor while the initial ones had all died.
He didn't waste time on them and directly used spiritual burst to make the heads of them all explode at once.
BOOM BOOM BOOM BOOM
Their bodies instantly turned into a mess and began to pool on the floor, the giant had died right away too.
Then blood and flesh began to converge, and soon it had turned into a blood key.
"So, that is what we need to open the door." Yasmine said out what everyone was thinking.
It was pretty easy to understand and this floor was probably for introductions.
"Let's head up then, we will be slaughtering a lot of these disgusting creatures." Fiona called out, but then she wondered where all these came from.
Were they living people before or just created for the challenge?
Whatever might be the case, it didn't matter for now, they would have to continue going up.
Vritra used blood manipulation to move the key and pushed it into the keyhole, twisted it as the door buzzed and opened.
Climbing over the stairs, the group continued to the 2nd floor.
"I wonder how many floors there are..." Maeve muttered as she tried to use her shadows to inspect but the door ahead blocked it.
She could only sigh.
Climbing onto the 2nd floor which appeared even bigger than the last one, Vritra and the others gazed around.
It was full of giants over thirteen feet in height, their bodies bulging and grotesque faces, they were mutants too after all.
'SOB why am I here?'
Asmodeus who was behind the group felt like crying, rather than fighting, his skills were more inclined to support and creation.
Thankfully, Shitless or anyone else was not forcing him to fight.
"Giants..." Vritra scanned the area and wondered if there were any other creatures in their midst.
And there really was.
It was a wolf, whose body was quite gigantic compared to normal ones, reaching a height of 10 feet.
It was clearly stronger than the giants but was hidden in the crowd.
"So next round is going to be full of such wolves?" Vanessa spoke, all their theories would be answered soon.
GRRRRRRR...
As the giants noticed the group they turned, their movements much faster than the zombies below.
"Wifey, you are feeling fine, right?" ignoring the giants for a moment, Vritra glanced back at Yasmine and asked.
"Yes, I am." She smiled sweetly, feeling a warmth spread across her body.
She already knew how much caring he is, but such tenderness made her feel even more special and happy.
Although Vritra never played favourites among them but she certainly was receiving more of his care now.
Yasmine then glanced at her sister, smiling knowingly.
After they had woken up, Teresa was even walking a bit strangely and everyone had noticed it.
It made Yasmine wonder, just how hard her shy sister went at it, her hubby really didn't go easy.
"Pitiful one, let me kill them!!" Shitless was quite excited to try out his skills.
"Not now, later." Vritra however refused and just released a single spiritual burst, which was enough to kill them all.
Again, a key formed from the blood and flesh of the giants and the wolf, which opened the door to the stairs.

The baby god said, tearing his chest and showing the emptiness.

"What about that guy? The next Divine, did he survive?" an old voice sounded, it was a god who was also like humans but very thin and frail.
Of course, how could they forget about such a big threat, for whom even the god's punishment had been used.

chapters.title: Chapter 733 The Tower Climbers
paragraphs: "That kid? There is no way he would have survived that attack." Facing the oldest frail god, the angry bulky god spoke.
It was his attack that had been launched against Vritra at that time, he hated Divine the most.
"That matter is taken care of then, as for Divine, I doubt he can live for long." The oldest god spoke.
The ten gods fell silent, they didn't even want to talk about the cursed figure, that battle had left them all with injuries that had not healed even till now.
"Oh, they are clearing the floors very quickly." The baby god exclaimed, despite his appearance he had already lived thousands of years.
The gods can easily change their appearance, so their current appearance might not be their true ones.
"Hmm they have already crossed the twentieth floor, not bad but there are some attacks that could deal mass damage. It is no surprise." The book god spoke.
As the group continued, the gods got more and more surprised, not expecting them to move so quickly or so high.
But still none believed that these eleven could survive.
The group had already risen to the fiftieth floor.
It was flooded with thousands of snakes, all of them highly venomous and very high in agility.
Some snakes were as small as the pinky finger while some were over twenty feet long, it was a very dangerous floor.
But they were all still far from the 10th evolution stage, so it was still not a danger for the group.
"Pitiful one, please let me kill them this time." Shitless pleaded again, ever since they got so strong, he hadn't fought properly.
"Not yet, we can't waste any time here." Vritra shook his head and released yet another spiritual burst.
Despite having used this attack fifty times, he wasn't exhausted, the recovery speed was a lot faster after all.
"Let's go haa can't they just give the strongest boss for us to fight rather than this drag?" Vritra sighed as he walked towards the locked door.
The key formed like before and it flew towards the door.
CLICK
With a faint sound the door opened, and the group continued.
Fifty fifth floor, same attack and they were done.
Sixtieth floor, nothing changed still even though the strength of the mutants was getting higher and higher.
"This is already the ninetieth floor, how long are we supposed to go?" Yennefer spoke, looking very frustrated.
"This place is so stupid, what can we even expect from those incompetent gods!" Diana said with a frown, if she was the real god she would have just made one single floor.
"But they are doing all this for the entertainment of higher beings, I guess it makes sense." Yasmine shrugged.
Even after the ninetieth floor, they were only encountering mutants near the fifth evolution phase creatures.
Soon they were at the 100th floor.
Vritra pushed open the door, and stepped onto the next floor, wondering if there would be any changes.
This entire floor was filled with some sort of fluid and no life form could be sensed.
"Hmm now what is this?" they frowned and looked around.
Then some letters flashed before their eyes in big glowing letters.
[Escape this place in 10 minutes or be buried here for eternity!!]
Just as the message flashed, the fluid on the floor began to rise rapidly.
Vritra created a bubble around them to stop the fluid from touching them as he observed the surroundings.
There wasn't even any objective, these fucking gods...
Vritra cursed and decided to just destroy everything that was present there.
At the same time he released two attacks.
One was spiritual burst and the second was hundreds of thousands of blood arrows that rained down all over the floor.
The fluid splattered in all directions as the arrows crashed with such dangerous power.
BANG BANG BANG
KCHHH
Among the loud banging noises, a faint sound of something getting punctured was released as the fluid trembled.
"Oh, so this whole fluid thing was a part of a creature and the core was hidden somewhere." Vritra spoke.
But thanks to the two attacks, the core was destroyed within moments.
The fluid stopped and then converged into yet another key.
[The next floor will be far more dangerous, be careful!!]
A warning flashed in front of them, without removing the bubble Vritra decided to continue.
Although the creatures for now were weak but he can't look down on this tower, who knows what sort of dangers are hidden here.
"S- Sir, do I really need to continue?" Asmodeus had reached way past what he would have been capable of.
"Of course my slave, you follow me as long as I want. Create an automatic chair for everyone that can even climb the stairs." Shitless ordered.
"Uh..." Asmodeus frowned but then nodded, within a couple of minutes he created eleven comfortable seats that could move on their own.
"Oh not bad, pitiful one. It is good right?" Shitless sat on one then moved it around, it was even climbing the stairs without any difficulty.
Vritra just rolled his eyes, saying: "We don't have time to play around, let's keep going."
After speaking he sat down on one of the chairs and moved it over the stairs, it was pretty smooth.
Seeing this, his wives also decided to try.
Soon, all eleven of them were seated over those mechanical chairs that quickly brought them to the next floor.
All ten of the gods watching this scene were speechless, what was even going on?
This challenge, this tower was supposed to be very dangerous, it should be giving the feeling of despair and fear.
And yet, these nobodies were playing around?
All the gods had worked hard to create this all, so it felt like a slap to their faces, as if their hard work was being made fun of.
But they couldn't do anything.
The gods were still hopeful that these people would soon be feeling despair, in fact most of the ten gods wanted to see it so bad.
The higher beings were all watching it, and right now, they noticed that a lot of them were seeing that exact scene.
And they seemed to be enjoying it?!!
The group arrived at the 101st floor on their mechanical chairs, now they weren't so annoyed.
Vritra scanned the floor, and soon located a sole figure standing near the centre.
The mutant resembled a human but its body was full of pus and was gigantic, it held a large metallic vase and exuded a deadly presence.
Thousands of corpses of various creatures were lying all around it, this monster was really far more dangerous than anything before.
ROOAAARRRRRR...
The mutant let out a loud roar upon noticing them and raised the metallic vase, as the corpses began to move towards it.
Getting sucked into the vase.
[Spiritual burst!]
BOOOM!!
One attack and the head of the creature exploded at once, it was still no match for them.
The gods were again left unsatisfied, they really wanted to interfere with it unfortunately they couldn't.
They could only see what was happening from the screen.
"Very soon, they will be gone very soon." The biggest god spoke, trying to calm his anger.
Vritra and the others continued to the next floor on their chairs and again started to kill with a single attack.
"A- At this rate they will reach all the way-" the rope god spoke tensely.
"There is no way that will happen." A god whose body was glowing with a bright white light and had no particular shape spoke.
He was the leader of the gods, the Sun, possessed immense power and authority.
Most of the floors were his ideas and he had complete faith in it, there was no way a bunch of random humans could survive until the end.
"..." the other gods looked at him and then back at the screen.
Vritra's group cleared one level after another; all it needed was one attack.
Soon they had crossed the 170th floor, and the expressions of the gods even if they weren't visible turned strange.
All of the nine gods looked at Sun.
"They... will stop soon, a harder floor is arriving. Just wait till 200." Sun spoke confidently.
Vritra sighed and used another attack, but Yasmine tapped over his shoulder, saying: "Let me handle this hubby."
Then she released a powerful spiritual burst, killing all the creatures.
The mechanical chairs then moved to the next floor and so on.
Till the 200th floor they noticed no difficulty, all enemies died with literally one attack.
"Hah Now they are dead, none of them are going to survive this floor surely. This is one of my favourite floors!!" Sun suddenly exclaimed, startling the other gods.
They hadn't seen the Sun god so worked up.
Down in the tower, Vritra and the rest walked into the 200th floor, they were still cautious despite the easy challenges.
They had put away the chairs and were ready for any attack.
But as soon as the eleven set foot on the floor, their bodies buzzed and all of them were pulled into separate spaces.
Some in groups of two while some in three.
Vritra suddenly found himself and beside him was Diana, the beautiful goddess.
It was a land with sand all over the place, like some desert.
In another place was Fiona and Teresa, the two didn't have much amicable relation.
In fact Fiona still didn't like Teresa much, the two looked at one another and Fiona frowned.
In another place was Onest, Shitless and Asmodeus, the three men were standing close so they got together.
And lastly was Yasmine, Maeve, Vanessa and Yennefer.

chapters.title: Chapter 734 The Unexpected
paragraphs: "Haa What the hell is this now?" Vritra looked around at the sand land, frowning.
"Dear, there are poisonous creatures under the ground..." Diana spoke, stepping close to Vritra.
They looked around but couldn't see anything, it was only sand for hundreds of kilometres and again the objective was not clear.
"I hope the others are fine." He added, taking Diana's hand he flew forward at full speed.
They searched for a while but couldn't find anything, suddenly hundreds of centipedes shot through the ground.
Their bodies were over twenty feet long, their grotesque bodies wriggling strangely.
These creatures had already reached the 8th evolution, their strength was very high but still nothing compared to Vritra and the others.
One spiritual burst was still enough to wipe them all out.
But with the way the difficulty was rising, very soon dangerous creatures would start appearing.
In another part, Fiona and Teresa found themselves in front of a large canyon, strong wind blew around.
A flimsy bridge connected the two sides of the canyon, and it seemed to be the only way to go forth.
The two women tried to fly but that too seemed to be restricted, leaving them with only a single answer.
"I guess we need to head there and find some sort of clue or objective-" Teresa spoke, almost unconsciously.
"Oh thank you for telling me." Fiona smiled and added.
Teresa could only scratch her cheek, feeling a bit embarrassed.
There were several reasons behind Fiona not liking her, but there was nothing she could do.
Normally they don't really talk but now the two were stuck here.
Fiona started to walk over the bridge and Teresa followed a few steps behind her.
The flimsy wooden bridge was around a kilometre long, and was swinging with the wind.
And there was nothing to hold onto on either side, making the walk far more dangerous.
Carefully, they crossed around 80% of the bridge but then noticed dozens of zombies standing on the other side.
Bulky and heavy zombies, all of them looked at the two women with bloodthirsty expressions.
"Shit!" Fiona shot forward a flame bird that smashed into the zombies, burning them to a crisp but the explosion made the bridge swing even more heavily.
Yet in the next moment, more zombies appeared.
"Let me handle them." Teresa spoke.
"...Hmm" Fiona might not like Teresa but she was not stupid enough to get them both killed just because of some minor hatred.
Teresa quickly caught the zombies in invisible rooms, that made them pause.
They continued to walk slowly, each step taken forward after making sure that it wouldn't be fatal.
Just a little was left when a horde of thousands of zombies suddenly rushed forward.
Teresa frowned as she tried to catch them all in a giant room but the number was too large, more just kept running.
They were charging forward madly, hundreds of those zombies might have died under the feet of others.
The bridge shook violently, gritting their teeth the two started running forward.
Fighting the zombies was no problem but falling from the bridge was dangerous.
Fiona jumped forward, flames bursting from her feet as the zombies exploded to pieces and she landed safely.
Teresa jumped forward too, unfortunately for her though, the bridge snapped at the last moment.
"Ahhh-" her body started falling into the darkness of the canyon, and she could do nothing to stop it.
Fiona's expression changed too, as she tried to catch her but the distance was too big and before she had a chance.
Teresa disappeared in the darkness of the canyon.
"Noooo!!" she screamed but for a moment she hesitated if she should jump in or not.
Fiona didn't hate Teresa as she clearly is a good woman but she just didn't like her all that much.
And that slight hesitation was long enough that Teresa completely disappeared, even her voice drowned away.
"..." Fiona was left there alone, her heart thumping in panic and a bad feeling taking root in her heart.
"Hah I told you, this will be the floor they all fumble, no way all of them are going to pass through it!" the Sun god spoke, then he coughed and calmed down.
"Yes yes, Sun, you have clearly done a great job in creating those floors." The oldest god spoke, coughing lightly.
DING
A faint sound rang out, the ten gods who were all seated around the round table and in the large white space, frowned.
There shouldn't be any noise here.
They looked around, frowning.
"Who is here? Reveal yourself!!" the eyeless god spoke, his muscles bulging even more.
"You dare to interrupt the meeting of the Gods?!!" the largest god spoke, his body was bigger than most planets.
It seemed as if several races lived over his body itself.
BUZZZ
A tiny insect buzzed and entered the white space, slowly settling over the round table.
The gazes of all ten gods focused on the tiny insect, that was the only presence here but how did it get in here?
The baby god took out the lollipop from his mouth, then spoke: "Eww get that bug out of here, me don't like insects at all!!"
The other gods rolled their eyes, since the other prideful gods were doing nothing, the eyeless god decided to kill it.
But suddenly, the body of the insect started to glow and grow.
Under their surprised gazes, the body of the insect had grown into a man whose body glowed even more brightly than the Sun god.
He sat relaxedly over the table, looking back at the gods and yawned.
"Sup oldies, I heard you were missing me." He asked, over the face of the luminous body, a twisted smile spread strangely.
Hearing that voice, that manner of addressing them.
The ten gods froze, they wanted to launch an attack right away but found it impossible to even move their pupils.
"D- Divine!!" the female instrument god spoke, her voice trembling.
"Yes, it is yours truly." Divine stood over the table, his hands clasped behind his back.
"Y- You bastard, how dare you show your face here!! I am going to kill you for taking my eyes away!!" the eyeless god shouted.
"Return my heart, what have you done with it?!" the baby god also got furious upon seeing Divine.
"Ah that heart, it has already been put to good use. Anyway, how about we play a game, anyone who speaks gets his head blown."
Divine said, his joking tone was making them all feel nervous.
"You won't dare to-" the oldest frail god trembled, and shouted but got interrupted.
"And you are disqualified!" Divine said, he pointed his finger towards the old god.
The space distorted as his body suddenly flashed in front of the old god, lightly he tapped over his forehead.
BOOM
There was a light explosion and the head of the oldest god exploded, pieces of it getting thrown all over the space.
Divine caught something from within that brain matter, then turned to look at the others.
"Hey heartless kid, I see you still love sucking on things." Divine chuckled as he looked at the baby god.
"You bastard! I am-" the baby god became furious, he was about to use his ability but.
BOOM

chapters.title: Chapter 735 The Game
paragraphs: BOOM
Divine swiped at the air, created a spatial blade that moved extremely fast and made the head explode.
"Haa You all have gotten better at controlling your arrogance than before. Good boys, staying quiet just because I asked."
Divine laughed.
"How dare you-"
"You are going to die-"
"Never disrespect the Gods-"
The eyeless, biggest and smallest gods all spoke at once.
"Haha Got you!" Divine blew air that breezed past the three gods at once and their heads exploded.
Despite their current bodies' shapes, they still had a real form.
Divine then quickly caught several things from the brain matter, then looked at the remaining ones.
"My dear goddess, won't you speak for me?" Divine looked at one of the two female gods.
"OF course I will-" the instrument goddess instantly replied, she wouldn't mind getting hurt by him.
She loved pain and none other than Divine had given her as much pain, he had killed her family, beat her up so badly that she almost died.
He had made her feel true despair, she just loved him so much.
And hoped he could hurt her more, make her suffer so much that she cries and begs, just thinking of this made the strings of the guitar go loose.
"Thank you, here is your reward." Divine flicked a finger and her head exploded at once, making her so happy.
"Hmm now, only you are left." Divine said as he looked at the remaining four gods, then added:
"This is no fun, let's change the conditions."
The four remaining gods clenched their fists, he was humiliating them in such a manner.
But they knew they couldn't do anything to him, he could even put them to eternal sleep if he wanted.
They were also a little nervous and furiously asked for help from the higher beings, only they could take away this monster now.
Divine's aura was so wild that the energies in the bodies of the gods had hidden, and wouldn't buzz no matter what.
And this wasn't even the real body of Divine, but just an avatar who also wasn't at full power.
"The new rule is, any god who doesn't dance after I have counted to three will have their head exploded." Divine added after thinking.
Surrounded by the ten gods, he just closed his eyes without any sort of protection, this was just another level of disrespect for the gods.
The four remaining looked at one another and didn't know what to do.
"One... two... three!!" Divine counted and then opened his eyes.
"..." he looked at the rope god first but he was completely still.
"Out!" Divine snapped his fingers and the head of the god exploded.
Then he looked at the book god, he too had remained still.
"Out!" another head exploded, but since their shapes were strange it seemed as if a random part of their body had exploded.
The ten gods were all very prideful, even if they had always put their greed above all things, there was no way any of the gods could be dancing.
Divine looked at the giant eyeless god, who was brimming with rage but his body refused to move.
"You too are out!" another head exploded and finally only one god remained.
The tenth god was a shadow woman, her presence was so low that no one ever noticed her.
She had been here from the beginning yet didn't utter a word neither did any god speak to her or even glance at her.
As Divine looked at her, only then did the other gods remember there was a tenth among them.
But seeing the sight, even Divine was surprised.
The shadow goddess had the form of a woman but was completely covered in darkness.
And right now, she was dancing?!!
Her waist moved from left to right, arms raised and moving in the air, as she danced on some strange rhythm.
Divine: "..."
He rolled his eyes but it was his game's rules so he couldn't break it.
"You passed... sigh" he added.
"Than-"
BOOM!
"Got you heh" and finally all ten gods seated had their heads gone.
Divine caught the final object then spoke: "So long, remember not to get too stressed, it could really give a headache."
BUZZZZ...
Then turning back into an insect he just disappeared, leaving ten headless gods there.
His presence was so heavy that the healing abilities of the gods had stopped working, only after he left did their heads start to regenerate.
The ten glanced at one another, their expressions turning grim.
"No one is to ever speak of this matter to anyone!" the oldest god spoke.
"B- But he took away those things, without them how are we supposed to make the players-" the book god spoke.
"We will deal with it, but not only will it bring immense shame but we will be in deep trouble." The oldest god interrupted.
A depressing silence descended over the space, the ten gods just stared at the table but then they were even more shocked.
It seemed as if everything had changed in that moment they were distracted.
The gods were even more baffled by the outcome.
Vritra was travelling with Diana after killing the centipedes, but there was no exit.
Yet soon a portal flashed in front of him.
"Is this another trap?" he wondered, and paused before the portal.
"Go in." Divine's voice sounded in his mind just then.
Vritra was a little surprised at first but then he stepped inside and saw that Shitless, Onest and Asmodeus were walking from another portal.
"Woah pitiful one!!" Shitless exclaimed, they were thrown in some strange place with a lot of strange looking mutants.
Who kept chasing them down.
The three didn't even want to think about that.
From another portal came Vanessa, Yennefer, Maeve and Yasmine.
Vritra looked to the side and saw Fiona kneeling not too far away as she stared into the darkness.
"Where is Tess?" Vritra spoke, as he looked around but couldn't find her.
Fiona trembled as she heard his voice, her eyes were a bit teary as she looked behind, she was feeling incredibly guilty.
"S- She fell down... I tried- it's my fault..." she muttered, making Vritra's expression shift.
"She fell there?!!" he asked, hurrying towards her and looked down into the darkness.
"Y- Yes we were crossing the bridge but then-" Fiona was interrupted as Vritra listened to her no longer and jumped into the darkness.
Yet just as he was about to fall, he heard a faint sound from above.
Vritra looked up and saw that a portal had opened there, and from inside it fell Teresa who seemed a little scared.
"Ahhhhh..." she could only let out a shrieking scream, trying to use her ability yet it didn't do anything.
Taking a few steps back, Vritra caught her into his arms safely.
She was so out of it that even after she was in his arms, Teresa didn't notice and continued to scream.
"Tess, are you okay?" Vritra's own heart was thumping faster; he was filled with fear in that instant.
Only after hearing his voice did she finally open her eyes, her hands clenched into fists as she stayed in his arms like a frightened kitten.
"Mmm" Teresa just hugged him, just now she really felt she was done for.
