chapters.title: Chapter 736 The Top of the Tower!!
paragraphs: Teresa calmed down after staying in Vritra's arms for a while.
After knowing everything that happened, he knew that it wasn't Fiona's fault, neither did she want to harm Teresa.
But he knew that the relation between the two wasn't good, and it was completely because of Fiona.
So maybe the guilt she was feeling would resolve the earlier hate.
Vritra didn't blame Fiona and just allowed the two women to talk it out properly.
Fiona apologized and Teresa didn't even blame her, so the two quickly made up and the earlier distance was certainly reduced.
Fiona was no longer so cold towards her and Teresa didn't feel hesitant to talk to her.
Once everything was resolved, it was time to move to the next floor.
"But there is no key." Vritra spoke, he looked at the door and found that it was already open.
"Let's continue." Although Teresa was safe now, it was only because of Divine's intervention.
She was in so much danger and almost died, this put Vritra in a terrible mood.
The already piling hatred in his heart for the gods increased even further, and he knew that this tower was only going to get more dangerous.
"Be careful, we will be increasing our speed." He spoke.
The gods in the white space were shocked to see that somehow Teresa was safe and all of them were already moving to the next floor.
What had happened in their moments of carelessness?
Divine just came, beat them up, took very precious things, made changes to the game and left, just like that.
While the ten gods could do nothing, his strength was too terrifying.
The gods could kill thousands of demigods with a snap, destroy planets, their strength wasn't weak.
It was just that Divine was too damn terrifying.
"Hoo, it is fine. This tower is designed only for players, the normal humans are allowed to enter only for the entertainment of the higher beings.
There is no chance they could pass through." The Sun god spoke calmly.
They all pretended as if what happened earlier was unreal.
Back in the tower, Vritra and the others quickly moved to the next floor.
However, before the danger even arrived, a violent explosion took place, sweeping through the entire floor.
BOOOOOOM!!
All the creatures inside were instantly annihilated, and the key appeared.
Vritra had just used the blood explosion to clear the floor the moment they had set foot on it.
"Next floor!!" Shitless said, he was waiting to be able to fight and the opportunity was approaching.
Just like that, they had reached the 265th floor and by now the mutants had reached the 9th evolution.
The gods were pretty shocked.
It had been several months since this game started, but they didn't expect anyone to reach this level.
They hadn't left any such opportunity that could make anyone so strong.
So the Sun god ordered the book god to check things about them.
The book god wasted no time and within a couple of minutes gathered as much info as he could.
And it shocked him greatly.
"T- They had been locked in their room for nearly 6 months and only some time ago did they start their evolution!" the book god spoke in surprise.
"After leaving, their strength has grown rapidly and the biggest jump came after they entered the death trap we had set up. The beast cave!" he spoke, surprising everyone.
That was just to wipe out more humans, it wasn't some training ground but a death trap.
"So they had killed all the beasts and came out? No wonder their strength is so high, looks like we underestimated the people of this planet." The rope god spoke, thinking of some way to stop them.
"Like I said, they can't clear it no matter what, since they aren't players." The Sun god interrupted.
The others could only nod, but this group was quickly approaching the 300th floor which was the top.
"And floor 289 is cleared!!" Shitless announced happily, very soon he would be able to return to their planet.
Bullo must be missing him so much, he almost became teary thinking about Bullo.
Shitless wanted to introduce his new slave to him.
Vritra and the others climbed and stepped onto the 290th floor, there were no creatures around.
There were only ten rooms, and then a text appeared before them.
[Just enter one of the rooms to pass the floor.]
"Ah so this is meant to wipe out some people from the group if there are more than 10." Diana spoke, as her gaze moved to Asmodeus.
"..." Asmodeus stood straight, looking at the rooms with a fearless look.
"You can go, it is fine. I would have died long ago anyway, sigh goodbye master." He turned his head to the other side, tears leaking from his eyes.
"Nooo, my slave... I will remember you." Shitless turned his heart into stone, this sacrifice had to be made.
They began to enter the rooms, the women entered first then Vritra and finally Shitless and Onest.
Asmodeus sighed, so this is how it all ends.
He only hoped that the death is painless, he only participated in these games to protect some important people.
It wasn't his fighting capability that had brought him so far though.
After all, the games not only test strength, he was far more creative than the other players.
The doors to the rooms closed one after another.
But just as he closed his eyes, his body, like a puppet, started to move on its own.
"Huh? What is happening?" he then moved into the room Shitless was standing in.
"It is fine, you can go too if you are just a puppet." Vritra spoke, he had gotten many abilities through which he could turn people into his puppets.
Although he was still a live human, now he was just a mere weapon and shouldn't be stopped.
The doors finally closed, and complete darkness engulfed them.
Asmodeus was very nervous at first.
After a few moments, the eleven of them appeared on the next floor, leaving the gods speechless.
And then he was incredibly happy, he thanked Vritra, feeling really grateful.
They all looked at the Sun god who coughed lightly and added: "There could always be some loopholes."
Sighing, they looked back at the screen, and one after another Vritra's group continued to clear up the floor.
The monsters were incredibly powerful by now, their strength reaching close to the 10th evolution.
So even after using several spiritual bursts, the mutants didn't die.
Vritra had to kill them using the blood manipulation skill, and soon they were at the 298th floor.
Then thousands of golems with extremely high defenses appeared in front of them.
Killing them all with blood would take a while and they didn't have any blood in their bodies.
So, Vritra finally gave Shitless the permission he wanted.
"Shitless, go kill them all, the battlefield is all yours."
"Hahaha Finally!! Just watch me, my slave, how I beat them all!" turning his body into metal, Shitless ran forward at full speed.
BOOM BOOM BOOM
He smashed into the golems who also began to charge forward.
The bodies of the golems exploded to pieces as Shitless laughed loudly, breaking them apart.
He ran around wildly, using his full strength and kept destroying them all.
Some that moved past him were killed by others, it still wasn't too difficult for the group.
After a while the whole room had been cleared, all the golems were dead.
Soon the pieces of their bodies turned into a key which opened the door to the next floor.
299th floor!
"Sun, they are already so high, shouldn't we do something?" the smallest god asked.
"It is fine, they can't clear the 300th floor anyway. They are not players!" the Sun god spoke firmly, he had designed the floors and had set it in this way.
Arriving on the new floor, Vritra saw a long road in front of them, there were no creatures but a lot of portals were present above the road.
"Looks like this time we are only going to defend." Vanessa spoke, they all could sense that the portals were dangerous.
Vritra created several layers of bubbles around them, opened the domain, created a blood shield and finally started to move forward.
The road was around 500 metres, and at the end of the road was an open door.
The plan was to cross it very quickly, but then a line made them pause.
[Cross the road by walking, running will create penalties!]
"Tch" the group collectively clicked their tongues, sighing they started to walk forward.
BOOM BANG
CRASH
Instantly, waves of attacks came crashing down at them, each attack extremely powerful.
The group completely disappeared within the barrage of attacks, there were all sorts of attacks.
From physical weapons to elemental to pure energy and much more, several bubble layers broke apart quickly.
These attacks had already reached the 10th evolution level, enough to kill them if they were careless.
Teresa and the others also began to use their abilities to stop the attacks, a layer of shadow appeared, then layers of water, air and much more.
The group continued to walk and the attacks only got stronger and stronger, so strong that they could destroy an entire city.
All the layers of barriers broke apart, as even spatial attacks struck them.
Vritra's body transformed into blood as he began to take over the attacks with his body, the others also used the abilities of their ascension path.
Despite the destructiveness, the eleven continued to walk forward.
Until there was only 1 metre or so left and an extremely powerful attack landed.

chapters.title: Chapter 737 The Traps
paragraphs: A powerful wave of attack raged towards the group of eleven, the surroundings blasting constantly.
What seemed to be a sphere consisting of countless colours moved towards them, making the very space buzz with destruction.
The bubbles and all sorts of barriers they had put up the moment they came in contact.
BOOM
BOOOOOOM
'Shit!' Vritra frowned, all of them came together using every bit of their energy to put up the strongest barriers.
BANG
Yet even they were getting destroyed, and the sphere was barely affected, it was too powerful.
'...' Vritra knew their strength wouldn't be enough to stop this attack, there was only one way left now.
Without even glancing at the points, he muttered: "Use all the points and buy the strongest barrier for us, right away."
He didn't look as a few messages flashed before him.
It had been a long time since he had used the sin points, after killing so many creatures, the points had already reached millions.
In the next moment, a bright white barrier appeared around them, finally giving them some time to breathe.
The colourful sphere collided with the barrier, making it shudder violently.
"Please work..." they all had the same feeling, if it didn't work then they would at the very least be heavily injured.
To reinforce the barrier, the group once again used their abilities.
WHIZZZZZZ
The battle between the two sides continued for a couple of minutes before finally cracks formed over the barrier but the sphere also started to reduce in size.
The group once again resumed walking forward as the pressure decreased.
It seemed the barrier was still weaker than that colourful sphere.
BOOOOM!!
Finally, the barrier gave out and exploded violently but it was enough time for the group to pass.
They all quickly jumped into the open door, barely escaping from the explosion.
The sphere collided with the ground and consumed everything around.
"Haa that was close, and now we are at the 300th floor, with such a level of danger this must be the final one." Diana muttered, taking deep breaths.
That sure was hectic.
"Let's rest a bit first, still be careful." Vritra said, his heart was thumping rapidly, the last level was too close of a call.
Just how dangerous would this level be then?
And now there weren't even any points left.
After a few minutes of rest, they finally decided to explore the floor.
The floor looked like a normal land, grass covered the ground and there was a sun in the sky.
Green trees surrounded the path and cold wind blew past them, none of them could sense any danger at all.
The gods watched this and sighed, this group had actually managed to climb so high.
Not even the ten players would be able to do so.
There wasn't anything the ten could do, even they have to follow the rules after all.
"It is fine, there is no way they can cross this level. This is something only players can go through." The Sun god spoke, he was very confident in himself.
"I sure do hope so." The biggest god shook his head.
After walking for a while, the eleven found themselves standing before a door.
And a language none of them recognized appeared before them.
"What is this now?" Vanessa asked, looking at the strange symbols floating in the air.
There was absolutely nothing around to make sense of.
"Dear, you know various languages, right? Can you understand this?" the goddess asked with hope in her eyes.
"Oh right, hubby you had that skill but will it still work?" Yasmine remembered, for a moment a smile appeared on her face.
But then they all looked unsure as none of the abilities from before worked now, and they had no other option.
"Yes, I indeed can understand this." Vritra nodded, that skill put a lot of knowledge in his mind.
Although the skill was not there anymore, all the knowledge was still present and with Vritra's memory he would have no problem.
"It says, push the door to move forward after burning the talisman." Vritra said, his gaze fixed at the paper talisman hanging on the door's handle.
"Ah there it is, so we just need to burn it to continue forward." Fiona said, happy and proud of her husband.
"Yeah, go ahead though this isn't the end of this floor." Vritra nodded, gesturing to Fiona.
Fiona pointed her finger at the talisman as it caught fire and turned to ashes instantly.
Then Vritra pushed it, opening the door.
This time they arrived in a winter land, the ground was completely covered by snow, as well as the surrounding mountains.
Stepping to the other side, the group again saw a message pop before them in the same language.
It was the language those players use on their planet and all of them know it.
So the scene where Vritra actually understood them shocked them, the Sun god felt his confidence falter a little.
This was one of the traps that would stop anyone who isn't a player but there was more, so he still waited.
"This says, climb to the top of the Tirosishima mountain within an hour to continue..." Vritra spoke as he gazed around, seeing so many mountains.
This mountain was something all players would recognize but not Vritra and his group.
Wait, there is one player among them.
"I know this!!" Asmodeus almost jumped in excitement, finally he could have some use.
He had been carried all the way here and having been saved by them, seeing that it was a mountain from his planet.
Asmodeus knew it was finally his chance to shine and be helpful.
"Good job, my slave." Shitless said proudly.
"This is a mountain from my planet, it is very famous since it is very tricky to climb but if you know the paths then it wouldn't be so hard." Asmodeus explained.
If someone new tries to climb it they would easily spend more than an hour just being stuck in the maze.
"Alright, lead us then." Vritra spoke, thankfully he had brought one of the players along.
He had anticipated something like this and knew there might come a time where they would need the help of a player.
And he also understood one thing, the gods were using these levels to stop anyone who isn't a player.
Normal humans even if they managed to climb all the way here wouldn't be able to find the right mountain in a short time.
And even if they luckily selected the right one, they would be stuck in the maze.
Vritra tried to fly or use his ability to shoot himself upwards and found that it was impossible.
So their only option right now was to walk.
"Yes sir, please follow me. I will bring you to the top in at most 40 minutes!" he said and began to walk forward on the snowy path.
The group followed Asmodeus, it was a bit tough to walk in the snow especially because of the high slope.
But they had gotten used to such conditions, and their strength wasn't locked like their ability to fly.
Passing through strange shortcuts in the maze, Asmodeus actually managed to bring them to the top in less than 40 minutes.
And at the top was another door, which was already open for them.

chapters.title: Chapter 738 Troubled Gods
paragraphs: Passing through the door, the group finally arrived at the end of the floor.
This was now truly the finish line of the tower and the door was right in front of them.
But right in front of the door was a single zombie, it wasn't bulky or special, it looked completely normal.
Exactly like the countless zombies they had killed down on the ground, but eyes could be deceptive.
And many times nothing is what it looks like.
"None of them can pass through that door, it is designed in a way that only the players could enter." The Sun god spoke.
The book god hummed, he finally regained confidence and muttered:
"Hmm, this door, that's right they can't pass through. There is a clear difference between normal humans and the players."
So even if their strength is higher than the players, they still can't do anything.
Finally the gods have won and they have lost, and this loss was worse than any since they were so close to victory.
It was purely for entertainment that they can even enter the tower, how big of a joke would these ten gods be if some random humans won?
They relaxed and waited to see the expressions of confusion and despair on the faces of the ten.
But since Asmodeus is a player, he can pass easily.
It seemed this guy has truly lucked out, he would be the first to clear this game.
For a few moments, Vritra just stared at the mutant and wondered if it was some sort of trap.
"..." then he created a blood blade and shot it towards the head of the mutant.
BANG!
It struck the head of the mutant zombie, making it explode violently as pieces of brain and skull splashed in all directions.
Finally, a message popped before them.
Again Vritra read it out loud:
"Pass through the door without killing the mutant, and if you do kill the mutant then flee within a minute. The tower is about to explode..."
All of them were speechless, these bastard gods waited to show this message until they had killed the mutant.
There was no way they could go back down and out of the tower in just a minute so the only option was the door in front of them.
But just as they approached the door another message popped, making them stop.
"To enter the door, you must possess the player core, otherwise you would be killed right away for intrusion."
Vritra frowned, feeling extremely irritated and angry.
The gods were playing with them, he knew that they would only allow the players to go through this but wasn't this too absurd?
The normal human would never stand a chance to clear the tower.
'Divine?' he called out, stopping before the door.
"Just go through it, I have already made all the arrangements." Divine spoke, as confident as ever.
But soon after they pass through the door and clear the game, this avatar that he had been using to talk to Vritra and help him would disappear.
He had already exhausted all the energy, but thankfully another avatar of Divine was very close to them, always protecting them secretly.
Even changing fate to some extent, stopping any tragedies from happening.
And this avatar was far closer than Vritra would expect, protecting him and all his wives.
After getting the confirmation from Divine, Vritra took a deep breath and told his words to the others.
"Let's go then, hubby, finally we will be out of this cursed apocalyptic place." Yasmine spoke, she didn't like the vibe there at all.
And wanted to spend time in peace for some time, it would be better for their baby after all.
Rather than seeing the ugly mutants, she would let the baby grow peacefully back there.
"Haha These naïve kids, they really are underestimating our warning." The oldest frail god shook his head, laughing mockingly.
"It is fine, the higher beings love deaths. After struggling for so long the entire family will die, what would be better than that?" the rope god spoke.
He wondered if he should just capture their souls to show the reactions to others.
The smiles on the faces of the gods became wider as Vritra pushed the door open, then...
He stepped foot inside and everything was consumed by flames, the sight of the gods was blocked too.
Even the higher beings that were watching their plaything try their best in the game, laughed as such a violent explosion took place.
The gods chuckled, finally completely relaxed.
Despite their sureness, they still were a bit worried that somehow this bunch might find a way to continue.
But that wasn't the case it seemed.
"Let's see how many players are still alive-" the Sun god ignored the tower already and shifted his attention to the other players.
As the flames died down, the bodies of the eleven couldn't be seen, nothing was left of them.
That wasn't shocking, but what shocked the gods and the higher beings was what happened after that.
It was of course Vritra who had created that explosion to make whichever fuckers were enjoying their suffering happy, but for a moment.
After all, disappointment is greatest after the peak point.
Just like Divine had said, the group easily crossed through the door and found themselves standing in an endless dark space.
Then messages popped in front of the eleven, in languages they all could understand.
[You have cleared the level 3 game!!]
[Congratulations, you are now able to evolve to level 3 demigods!!]
[Please wait, you will soon be graced by the presence of the gods!!]
[You will afterward be sent back to your original planet, few among you might even receive special rewards!!]
There was a barrage of messages, though it didn't matter to ten of them.
But it did to Asmodeus, he was quite happy with it even if it means nothing after a few minutes.
He wasn't sure about anything either just like the gods, these ten weren't players so how did they win the game?
But Asmodeus wasn't as worried, on the other hand the gods all rose to their feet in extreme shock.
How was this possible? This wasn't just against their arrangement, this was against the very law, the rules.
And for such an event, all ten of them would be in great trouble.
This was a blunder none had expected, how could these normal humans have the player cores?
"W- what has just happened?" all gods were utterly shocked and unable to think anything.
It was already too late though, they couldn't even do damage control now.
"Should we go meet those humans for questions? Maybe we can find a way to solve this problem before higher beings are involved?" the smallest god spoke, his voice tense.
"It is too late, now they and us will all be answering to the court of higher beings, I believe we have all been tricked.
Something big has been going on in the background." The book god spoke.
"Yes, no wonder even Divine himself appeared but let's not mention that.
Now we just need to wait for the official letter-" the Sun god hadn't even finished speaking when a letter appeared before them.
A similar letter appeared in front of Vritra and the others.
The higher beings sure worked fast, the gods were in big trouble now.

sentences.text: Passing through the door, the group finally arrived at the end of the floor.
This was now truly the finish line of the tower and the door was right in front of them.
But right in front of the door was a single zombie, it wasn't bulky or special, it looked completely normal.
Exactly like the countless zombies they had killed down on the ground, but eyes could be deceptive.
And many times nothing is what it looks like.
"None of them can pass through that door, it is designed in a way that only the players could enter." The Sun god spoke.
The book god hummed, he finally regained confidence and muttered:
"Hmm, this door, that's right they can't pass through.
There is a clear difference between normal humans and the players."
So even if their strength is higher than the players, they still can't do anything.
Finally the gods have won and they have lost, and this loss was worse than any since they were so close to victory.
It was purely for entertainment that they can even enter the tower, how big of a joke would these ten gods be if some random humans won?
They relaxed and waited to see the expressions of confusion and despair on the faces of the ten.
But since Asmodeus is a player, he can pass easily.
It seemed this guy has truly lucked out, he would be the first to clear this game.
For a few moments, Vritra just stared at the mutant and wondered if it was some sort of trap.
"..." then he created a blood blade and shot it towards the head of the mutant.
BANG!
It struck the head of the mutant zombie, making it explode violently as pieces of brain and skull splashed in all directions.
Finally, a message popped before them.
Again Vritra read it out loud:
"Pass through the door without killing the mutant, and if you do kill the mutant then flee within a minute.
The tower is about to explode..."
All of them were speechless, these bastard gods waited to show this message until they had killed the mutant.
There was no way they could go back down and out of the tower in just a minute so the only option was the door in front of them.
But just as they approached the door another message popped, making them stop.
"To enter the door, you must possess the player core, otherwise you would be killed right away for intrusion."
Vritra frowned, feeling extremely irritated and angry.
The gods were playing with them, he knew that they would only allow the players to go through this but wasn't this too absurd?
The normal human would never stand a chance to clear the tower.
'Divine?' he called out, stopping before the door.
"Just go through it, I have already made all the arrangements." Divine spoke, as confident as ever.
But soon after they pass through the door and clear the game, this avatar that he had been using to talk to Vritra and help him would disappear.
He had already exhausted all the energy, but thankfully another avatar of Divine was very close to them, always protecting them secretly.
Even changing fate to some extent, stopping any tragedies from happening.
And this avatar was far closer than Vritra would expect, protecting him and all his wives.
After getting the confirmation from Divine, Vritra took a deep breath and told his words to the others.
"Let's go then, hubby, finally we will be out of this cursed apocalyptic place." Yasmine spoke, she didn't like the vibe there at all.
And wanted to spend time in peace for some time, it would be better for their baby after all.
Rather than seeing the ugly mutants, she would let the baby grow peacefully back there.
"Haha These naïve kids, they really are underestimating our warning." The oldest frail god shook his head, laughing mockingly.
"It is fine, the higher beings love deaths.
After struggling for so long the entire family will die, what would be better than that?" the rope god spoke.
He wondered if he should just capture their souls to show the reactions to others.
The smiles on the faces of the gods became wider as Vritra pushed the door open, then...
He stepped foot inside and everything was consumed by flames, the sight of the gods was blocked too.
Even the higher beings that were watching their plaything try their best in the game, laughed as such a violent explosion took place.
The gods chuckled, finally completely relaxed.
Despite their sureness, they still were a bit worried that somehow this bunch might find a way to continue.
But that wasn't the case it seemed.
"Let's see how many players are still alive-" the Sun god ignored the tower already and shifted his attention to the other players.
As the flames died down, the bodies of the eleven couldn't be seen, nothing was left of them.
That wasn't shocking, but what shocked the gods and the higher beings was what happened after that.
It was of course Vritra who had created that explosion to make whichever fuckers were enjoying their suffering happy, but for a moment.
After all, disappointment is greatest after the peak point.
Just like Divine had said, the group easily crossed through the door and found themselves standing in an endless dark space.
Then messages popped in front of the eleven, in languages they all could understand.
[You have cleared the level 3 game!!]
[Congratulations, you are now able to evolve to level 3 demigods!!]
[Please wait, you will soon be graced by the presence of the gods!!]
[You will afterward be sent back to your original planet, few among you might even receive special rewards!!]
There was a barrage of messages, though it didn't matter to ten of them.
But it did to Asmodeus, he was quite happy with it even if it means nothing after a few minutes.
He wasn't sure about anything either just like the gods, these ten weren't players so how did they win the game?
But Asmodeus wasn't as worried, on the other hand the gods all rose to their feet in extreme shock.
How was this possible?
This wasn't just against their arrangement, this was against the very law, the rules.
And for such an event, all ten of them would be in great trouble.
This was a blunder none had expected, how could these normal humans have the player cores?
"W- what has just happened?" all gods were utterly shocked and unable to think anything.
It was already too late though, they couldn't even do damage control now.
"Should we go meet those humans for questions?
Maybe we can find a way to solve this problem before higher beings are involved?" the smallest god spoke, his voice tense.
"It is too late, now they and us will all be answering to the court of higher beings, I believe we have all been tricked.
Something big has been going on in the background." The book god spoke.
"Yes, no wonder even Divine himself appeared but let's not mention that.

chapters.title: Chapter 739 The Court
paragraphs: Vritra and the others suddenly found themselves standing in a completely black area.
Before they had a chance to say anything, a scroll appeared before them.
"What is this now?" Yennefer asked, hoping there was no more trouble.
Vritra extended his hand to catch it, but the scroll opened on its own and big characters that they all could read appeared.
[You all have been summoned to the Court of Higher Beings!!]
[Your trial will start in an hour, prepare yourself!]
[If you are unable to find an advocate within the allotted time, the court will provide one for you!]
[No disrespect towards the judge will be tolerated, be careful. A mistake can cost you more than just your lives!]
[Sorry for the inconvenience and thanks for your patience...]
"The hell is this now? Didn't we win the game? What is happening?" Vritra asked, he was hoping to be sent back to the Zoratian planet already.
"Divine, didn't we only need to win this game to solve the problem? What's happening now?"
There was only one guy who could have the answers.
"Well this is expected, some random humans who were no more than NPCs in the game according to the gods have won. It is a big blunder for them." Divine spoke, then continued.
"For now, just fight your own case, don't get any advocate from the court. And explain how your planet was attacked first and it should be fine."
"Sigh, you better pray nothing goes wrong." Vritra had an even stronger urge to beat Divine up, unfortunately he hadn't even seen that guy.
"I guess we have an hour worth of free time for now, what did he say?" Vanessa asked, looking concerned.
"..." Sighing again, Vritra told everything Divine had said to him.
And it really wasn't much of a help.
"Don't we need some sort of evidence or witnesses?" Diana asked, she hadn't directly talked with the gods.
But she was well aware of how shrewd these gods can be, they can't be trusted or underestimated.
"Nothing we can do for now, let's just go there and see how it goes. The gods might have already thought of this possibility and removed the evidence already." Vritra shrugged.
For now, none of them could feel any of their strength.
Neither as demigods nor the strength they had gathered, it all seemed to be locked away.
If they win the case then the Zoratian planet will be safe and their strength will increase greatly and the gods will also be punished.
But if they lose then they and the planet are a lost cause.
And here they were at a disadvantage since the gods have more information and should be well prepared.
"Looks like they aren't calling for me..." Just then Asmodeus spoke.
He was a player so him winning the game was nothing strange, not only does he not need to go to the court but he will also receive his prize soon after the case is finalized.
Asmodeus had gotten completely different messages from them all, but he had already gotten attached to this group.
So even winning didn't bring him as much joy, instead he was worried about them.
"Oh right, I almost forgot about you." Vritra spoke, his gaze moving to Asmodeus.
"And now we have our witness."
"H- Huh? Me? But I don't know anything..." Asmodeus spoke in confusion.
"You don't know anything about the plan of sabotaging the Zoratian planet to cancel the further competition?" Vritra asked, frowning, this guy can't be this useless, right?
"I- I don't... The others were doing something shady but I don't mix with their group... So I don't know." Asmodeus spoke meekly.
"Alright, it's okay. Just lie then." Vritra said and explained the whole story.
"Alright sir, I'll do my best!" he spoke with confidence.
They chatted for a while and an hour passed very quickly, then another scroll appeared in front of them.
[Prepare yourself, you'll be teleported into the Higher Beings court in a minute.]
[Remember, every mistake you make will push you towards defeat.]
Vritra looked at others who nodded.
Just as the time was about to end, a question popped before them.
[Would you like to get an advocate from the court?]
"No." Vritra answered.
[Very well, then get ready.]
A few moments later, the eleven of them were swallowed by a bright light and disappeared.
In the next second, they all found themselves sitting on wooden chairs, present in a large courtroom.
The eleven of them sat in the front row seats while more than a hundred seats were behind them which were filled with creatures of different races.
It looked pretty much like a human court, the only difference being no humans could be found around.
Beside and in front of the seat of the judge, a few figures dressed completely in white were standing, not even their faces were visible though.
There was a big throne for the judge of the trial and on either side were two stands for both the parties.
Yasmine and the others looked to the other side and saw ten blurry figures sitting on the wooden chairs.
It was the gods.
"..." Vritra looked at them for a few moments, it wasn't hard to find their identity as the other party of this trial.
"Yo gods, how you doing?" Vritra called out, fully aware that here they can't do anything.
"..." All ten of the gods looked at him strangely, although they had been pretty shocked earlier but they had now completely calmed down.
"You are from the Zoratian planet?" one of the gods spoke, but for Vritra they all looked exactly the same.
He could not see their shapes.
"Yes, we are." Vritra nodded.
"And Divine is backing you?" another god asked, the tension in his voice was pretty clear.
"Divine? The guy who died long ago? Of course not, it is one among you who has helped me, you didn't think the friendship between the ten of you is good, right?" Vritra said, shaking his head.
"Clearly, one of you wants to remove the others, he even made sure that we would win this trial."
The gods didn't believe one word he said but the confidence in his voice and all the events still made them unsure.
They still believed that Divine must be backing him but now there was a seed of doubt in their minds.
"Be quiet! All of you may rise from your seats, the judge is here!!" one of the persons in dark attire announced in a loud heavy voice.
Everyone in the court rose to their feet, even the gods and Vritra's group.
Despite Vritra's confidence earlier, he was also a bit worried about this trial, they had no information or any backup.
The only way for them to win was if Divine had made some arrangements in advance.
Otherwise matching the gods who had planned things thoroughly and have who knows how many backups would be impossible.
The whole court was filled with silence and after a few tense seconds, the judge finally walked towards the throne.
All eyes drew towards the judge, but most looked down the next moment in fear, that was a higher being after all.
Even the gods don't dare to do anything stupid right now, they all bowed as if servants to their masters.
All the women in Vritra's group looked a bit surprised but none of it could compare to what Vritra felt.
The graceful judge took her seat after gesturing for them to sit, her eyes however instantly moved to Vritra.
For an instant she flashed a smile, before appearing serious, as if she knew no one here.
'E- Evelyn? What is she doing here? She is the judge!!' Vritra exclaimed, his eyes wide open.
Right in front of everyone was none other than the beautiful Evelyn that Vritra had met twice already.
And both times, she had been quite aggressive with him.
'So she is on my side unless she lied about any of it and used some trick or something, which I doubt, then haven't we already won?' Vritra thought.
'Divine, is she really on our side?' he asked just to confirm.
"She is." Divine answered right away.
Vritra then looked to the side at the ten gods who had just taken their seats, they looked pretty confident and arrogant.
Just from their posture and movement.
Vritra could sense their gazes as if they were already the winners.
"The court will now proceed with the hearing!" one of the dark clothed men announced.
Then added: "The advocates of both sides, please explain your cases."
The man in black was doing this after so long, such cases don't come often after all.
He was being careful to not make any mistakes and remember what exactly were the dialogues he was supposed to speak.
From the side of the gods, a man with three feet height and an octopus-like face stood up, he was wearing a strange attire that consisted of rainbow colors.
He walked away from the seats and looked arrogantly towards Vritra's side, waiting to see their advocate.
"Hello everyone, I am the world famous and the greatest ever advocate PetoPhil. And today I have taken this case so you already know who is going to win." PetoPhil spoke confidently.
And the people sitting among the three hundred seats began to whisper among themselves.
'Looks like this guy is pretty famous...' Vritra thought as he heard a few of them talk, then stood up.
After taking a deep breath, Vritra stood up, he glanced at Evelyn first who sat there without any expression.
But he could clearly feel the intense gaze.

chapters.title: Chapter 740 Respectful Judge
paragraphs: Vritra stood up, then walked forward, standing on the opposite side of the world-famous advocate PetoPhil.
"Hmm? Are you an advocate? I have never seen you before." PetoPhil asked, curiously looking at Vritra.
"No, I will be fighting for my own case-" before he could finish, the advocate burst into loud laughter.
To the point that he started to cry, for a few minutes he just couldn't control himself.
"Hahaha Y- You mean to say, you are going to stand against me, the greatest PetoPhil?
You? Pfftt, it's like bullying a kid, what's even the point of this trial anymore, honorable man just announce it as my victory." He spoke in extreme arrogance.
"...We will see about that." Vritra just rolled his eyes, this guy might be the best lawyer there is but if the judge had already made her decision what can he even do?
"Stop playing around and explain your cases!!" one of the dark clothed men shouted, interrupting PetoPhil.
"Ah yes yes, please forgive me, I lost my composure there for a moment, it was just too hilarious."
The dwarf lawyer wiped tears from his eyes then looked back at the gods.
"Don't worry, your investment in me won't be wasted, this case is as good as ours, there is absolutely nothing to worry about.
If I lose, you can do whatever you want, even make me eat dog shit and I wouldn't refuse hahaha."
Hearing PetoPhil's confident voice, the gods felt even better, thankfully they had prepared for such scenarios in advance.
They had gotten a bit worried by Vritra's claim about a mole among the ten of them but now everything would be fine.
"COUGH As a professional lawyer, I will start first so my unprofessional friend could learn a thing or two." PetoPhil spoke then looked at the judge.
Evelyn's emotionless eyes focused on him as she nodded and spoke: "You may start."
"Thank you, let's not drag it too much, let me summarize it.
These ten people, the residents of the Zoratian planet, had sneaked into the third game of Zitorge planet.
Then they disrupted the game several times, committed several mass murders, killed most of the players, helped the World Bank's protectors to sneak in and make a mess of the game.
They have caused several more problems as you can see in this document."
After speaking, he gave the page to one of the dark clothed men who quickly glanced at it and then passed it to Evelyn.
Then Evelyn read the document and looked back at the proud lawyer.
"These ten have won the game, they even kidnapped one of the players and turned him into a puppet.

The game has been completely ruined and so many resources wasted, it would take too much time and resources to conduct the games again, but now with so many of the players of Zitorge planet dead, it wouldn't be fair to them."
He took a brief pause, a confident smile on his face, his voice was slow but loud.
All the people in the courtroom who heard these allegations instantly looked at Vritra's group with unfriendly gazes.
But they still had to listen to the other side so they still couldn't be completely sure.

"For such heinous crimes, I beg you to give the ten of them the harshest punishment, so terrifying that even their souls aren't spared, make them suffer to set an example among everyone. That is all I had to say, thank you."
PetoPhil bowed then took a couple of steps back, he smirked towards Vritra, feeling very proud and giving him a challenging look.
"I see, now then Vritra Arclis, what do you have to say for yourself?" Evelyn asked after noting something.
"Why does that name sound so familiar?" the baby god pulled out his candy and scratched his head.
"Isn't that the name of the next Divine? The guy who had supposedly died by the god's punishment, how is he still alive?!!" the book god spoke in utter shock.
All ten of them were quite baffled, no one of his strength should have survived an attack like that, their body, mind, soul, everything would be gone for good.
"So, Divine really was behind this all!!"
They were only highly doubtful about this before but now they were all 100% sure, and suddenly Vritra's importance increased in their eyes.
Using everything they have, they had to kill this threat before he got out of their league.
Because of their shameful memory with Divine just now where he beat all ten up, they didn't mention it to their lawyer.
But now they had to mention it to make their case even stronger. Divine is a criminal, and anyone associated with him will also be killed.
This trial was truly going to be over very quickly it seemed, but before that they had to inform PetoPhil about this important matter.
The gods decided quickly and gestured toward PetoPhil, calling him closer.
"..." PetoPhil gestured at them back to wait, he needed to listen to Vritra to make fun of him.
"We are from the Zoratian planet, and a few months ago there appeared something that began to change everything.
The weather and even the humans, only later did I find out that it was because these gods had joined hands with some of these players and tried to cancel the competition in advance."
Vritra paused then added: "So we had no choice but to do this to protect ourselves and the planet."
"Hmm PetoPhil, what do you have to say about this? Do you have any evidence to prove them wrong? If not you'll be declared lost." Evelyn spoke quickly.
"H- Huh?" PetoPhil was taken aback, he was completely speechless and wondered if he had missed something.
"S- Shouldn't they be the ones to prove it first and then I prove that they are wrong?" he spoke in a strange tone.

'No way she is siding with those random humans right? Yeah, she is a respectful judge and a higher being, there is no way she would be partial.' PetoPhil thought, taking a deep breath to calm himself.
Evelyn frowned, but before she could speak, Vritra spoke:
"We do have a witness, please allow me to present him."
"You can." Evelyn looked straight into his eyes, the corner of her lips rising ever so slightly.
She was barely holding herself from just jumping into his arms, but she needed to take care of this first.
Asmodeus stood up, he was a pretty confident guy, even while being stared at by everyone he didn't falter and walked forward to stand.
"Tell everyone what had happened." Vritra said.

"Yes, the other players made a deal with the gods. In return for weakening the Zoratian planet in advance so we can easily win the 4th game, they were paid with heavy prices." Asmodeus spoke, his voice full of confidence.
"I see, so the gods did that. After seeing all evidence and the witness, I have made my decision and I am punishing the-" Evelyn began to pass her judgment.
PetoPhil almost staggered back, what was even going on? She was going to pass judgment just after listening to a witness?
What if he is just lying? He wondered if Evelyn was...
No, no way, she is a higher being, she wouldn't do that after all, respect matters a great deal to them.
Many higher beings have lost their lives, everything they owned just for their reputation, it was one of the most precious things for them all if not the most.
"Wait, honorable ma'am, please allow me to ask some questions and prove he is lying. I also have evidence to prove that we are right."

"Hmph, interrupting me in the middle of speaking, is this what you are taught? As punishment, you will be doing a handstand the entire time and will be whipped a hundred times whether you win or lose." Evelyn announced and color drained from PetoPhil's face.
"S- Sorry, I didn't mean any disrespect- sigh..." he knew, it was pointless to argue further.
And seeing the piercing gaze of the black clothed men, he knew there was no other choice.
With slight difficulty, he turned upside down and performed a handstand, then he walked towards Asmodeus and asked:
"Can I begin questioning now?"
"You can." Clicking her tongue, Evelyn added, she really wanted this trial to end quickly so she could meet him.
"COUGH- COUGH COUGH" PetoPhil was trying to clear his throat but because of his position, he broke into a violent cough.

"Sorry, so Asmodeus, you said gods were paid a heavy price. Can you tell me exactly what they received or what you players can even offer the gods that they already wouldn't have or can't get themselves? Do you have any proof of your words?"
He asked, fighting a trial while doing a handstand was not easy.
"I-" Asmodeus didn't know what to say as he literally knew nothing about the deal.
"Well that proves how much truth was in your words. Can you tell me, did you go along with these humans on your own or were you abducted?" PetoPhil asked further.
"On my own of course, why would they need to force me?" Asmodeus quickly spoke.
"Haha you are a bad liar, Mr. Asmodeus, in the video here, you clearly don't seem to like their company. You were clearly getting abducted."
PetoPhil played the video in which Vritra and Asmodeus had met for the first time and he was dragged along the group.
"I- I was just playing around, that means nothin-" Asmodeus tried to make some excuse but he was no match for this lawyer.

"Hmm?
Are you an advocate?
I have never seen you before." PetoPhil asked, curiously looking at Vritra.
"No, I will be fighting for my own case-" before he could finish, the advocate burst into loud laughter.
To the point that he started to cry, for a few minutes he just couldn't control himself.
"Hahaha Y- You mean to say, you are going to stand against me, the greatest PetoPhil?
You?
Pfftt, it's like bullying a kid, what's even the point of this trial anymore, honorable man just announce it as my victory." He spoke in extreme arrogance.
"...We will see about that." Vritra just rolled his eyes, this guy might be the best lawyer there is but if the judge had already made her decision what can he even do?
"Stop playing around and explain your cases!!" one of the dark clothed men shouted, interrupting PetoPhil.
"Ah yes yes, please forgive me, I lost my composure there for a moment, it was just too hilarious."
The dwarf lawyer wiped tears from his eyes then looked back at the gods.
"Don't worry, your investment in me won't be wasted, this case is as good as ours, there is absolutely nothing to worry about.
If I lose, you can do whatever you want, even make me eat dog shit and I wouldn't refuse hahaha."
Hearing PetoPhil's confident voice, the gods felt even better, thankfully they had prepared for such scenarios in advance.
They had gotten a bit worried by Vritra's claim about a mole among the ten of them but now everything would be fine.
"COUGH As a professional lawyer, I will start first so my unprofessional friend could learn a thing or two." PetoPhil spoke then looked at the judge.
Evelyn's emotionless eyes focused on him as she nodded and spoke: "You may start."
"Thank you, let's not drag it too much, let me summarize it.
These ten people, the residents of the Zoratian planet, had sneaked into the third game of Zitorge planet.
Then they disrupted the game several times, committed several mass murders, killed most of the players, helped the World Bank's protectors to sneak in and make a mess of the game.
They have caused several more problems as you can see in this document."
After speaking, he gave the page to one of the dark clothed men who quickly glanced at it and then passed it to Evelyn.
Then Evelyn read the document and looked back at the proud lawyer.
"These ten have won the game, they even kidnapped one of the players and turned him into a puppet.

The game has been completely ruined and so many resources wasted, it would take too much time and resources to conduct the games again, but now with so many of the players of Zitorge planet dead, it wouldn't be fair to them."
He took a brief pause, a confident smile on his face, his voice was slow but loud.
All the people in the courtroom who heard these allegations instantly looked at Vritra's group with unfriendly gazes.
But they still had to listen to the other side so they still couldn't be completely sure.
"For such heinous crimes, I beg you to give the ten of them the harshest punishment, so terrifying that even their souls aren't spared, make them suffer to set an example among everyone.
That is all I had to say, thank you."
PetoPhil bowed then took a couple of steps back, he smirked towards Vritra, feeling very proud and giving him a challenging look.
"I see, now then Vritra Arclis, what do you have to say for yourself?" Evelyn asked after noting something.
"Why does that name sound so familiar?" the baby god pulled out his candy and scratched his head.
"Isn't that the name of the next Divine?
The guy who had supposedly died by the god's punishment, how is he still alive?!!" the book god spoke in utter shock.
All ten of them were quite baffled, no one of his strength should have survived an attack like that, their body, mind, soul, everything would be gone for good.
"So, Divine really was behind this all!!"
They were only highly doubtful about this before but now they were all 100% sure, and suddenly Vritra's importance increased in their eyes.
Using everything they have, they had to kill this threat before he got out of their league.
Because of their shameful memory with Divine just now where he beat all ten up, they didn't mention it to their lawyer.
But now they had to mention it to make their case even stronger.
Divine is a criminal, and anyone associated with him will also be killed.
This trial was truly going to be over very quickly it seemed, but before that they had to inform PetoPhil about this important matter.
The gods decided quickly and gestured toward PetoPhil, calling him closer.

"Hmm PetoPhil, what do you have to say about this?
Do you have any evidence to prove them wrong?
If not you'll be declared lost." Evelyn spoke quickly.
"H- Huh?" PetoPhil was taken aback, he was completely speechless and wondered if he had missed something.
"S- Shouldn't they be the ones to prove it first and then I prove that they are wrong?" he spoke in a strange tone.

Yeah, she is a respectful judge and a higher being, there is no way she would be partial.' PetoPhil thought, taking a deep breath to calm himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 741 The Criminal Lawyer
paragraphs: "I- I was just playing around, that means nothin-" Asmodeus tried to make some excuse but he was no match for this lawyer.
"So you roleplay getting kidnapped by people you are meeting for the first time? That's a strange hobby, you can now leave, thank you for your time."
With a big grin, PetoPhil spoke, he had made his point and from the light whispers it was evident that they all could tell it.
"Impressive!" one of the gods said, they were happy to have chosen this lawyer.
"So we can't accept Asmodeus as the legal witness, do you have anything else to prove your words?" Evelyn asked, clearly annoyed.
"...Uh yes." Vritra thought for a few moments and nodded.
"Great, since you have enough evidence, I declare you to be the winner of this-" Evelyn began to pass her judgment quickly yet again got interrupted.
"W- Wait ma'am, he hasn't even shown anything yet." PetoPhil was about to go mad, what was even going on in this case.
Was he the abnormal one here?
"Hey come here!" one of the gods hurriedly called out, and the baffled PetoPhil finally walked towards them.
"What is it? Why do you keep disturbing me? This trial is getting critical, if you keep interrupting I'll lose focus and then the trial itself." PetoPhil warned.

"No, there is something important you should know. It will make our victory very easy and that Vritra will be given even harsher punishment." The rope god spoke, his voice calm yet possessing some excitement.
"Oh, hurry up, what is it?" he asked hurriedly, PetoPhil now felt that he had to win the trial at any cost.
"Vritra is directly related to the Divine and we have enough evidence to prove it, it was the Divine that had sent them here." The book god quickly shared all the information.
And PetoPhil became extremely confident, now he didn't even need to prove it, these guys were already criminals.
"That's just perfect, give me the video and other evidence and I'll win this trial for us!" PetoPhil announced and stretched his hand.
The gods looked at one another and hesitated but they had to win this so reluctantly they gave the video and other evidence to their lawyer.
"Sorry for the delay, honorable ma'am. I have just received a very important piece of news, one that will instantly prove that they are all criminals."
As everyone heard this, another wave of discussions rose, new twists kept rising in this trial, keeping them all invested and interested.
"Speak." Evelyn said, she knew exactly what was going to happen.
PetoPhil bowed and pulled out several pieces of evidence, with this he would be able to easily prove the connection between Divine and the ten of them.
The objects floated towards Evelyn, but first passed through the man in black clothes.
"Hmm we can't use these pieces of evidence for various reasons you aren't allowed to know but we can play the video." the man in black said as he destroyed the evidence right away.
"Wai-" PetoPhil was taken aback, now this was getting too obvious. He sighed, at least there was still a video.
"Play it." Evelyn said as she leaned back, her blonde hair caressed her milky cheeks, her ethereal beauty taking every man's breath away.
"Let's play a game..." the video played in which a guy disrespected the gods and even beat them up, making their heads explode.
"This!" Evelyn acted shocked, as she watched the video.

"How dare you hide the fact that you have seen that criminal Divine and that he has stolen something so important. All ten of the gods will be sent to world prison for a month and be smacked at least a hundred times every day!!" Evelyn announced in anger as she wrote something down.
All the people watching the video began to mock the gods, many laughing openly.
While PetoPhil was just confused, how come he was winning and had all the evidence, yet they were the ones receiving constant punishments.
"B- But honorab-" PetoPhil tried to speak.
"What? You want to refute me? You too will be included in that punishment, tell me if you have anything more related to the case or I'll pass my judgment." Evelyn spoke loud and clear.
"Okay I will give the absolute evidence and prove that these people have destroyed the game and should be punished." PetoPhil decided to play his biggest card.
"Vritra, can you come stand here, I have a few questions for you." PetoPhil asked politely.
"I don't want to." Vritra refused.
"H- Huh?" PetoPhil wondered if he heard wrong, this isn't something that people can just refuse, this is a court trial.
Won't refusing just prove them guilty and mean they are trying to oppose the law?
"..." With a strange look on his face he looked at Evelyn, he was sure she would feel the same.
"It's alright since he doesn't feel comfortable with it, do you have anything else?" Evelyn asked.
PetoPhil: "..."
Was this a parody court or something, what was even happening? Why was the higher being judge acting so strange?
"I... I have the proof that they disrupted the game and wasted all the resources, while cheating!!" But PetoPhil wasn't someone who accepted defeat.
"Sigh this is your last chance." Evelyn said.

"Thank you ma'am, let me present to you all the greatest evidence!! In the planet of our pitiful players, we recently found out a strange seed, and that seed can only be found on the Zoratian planet!!"
Since the other side was playing unfairly, he also decided to break the rules, this was the last strategy where he would need to break the law to win.

"But that proves nothing, I have this pen and I took it from your pocket and if I kill someone with it does it prove you are the killer?" Vritra said, sputtering whatever gibberish he wanted after all...
"Excellent, what a wonderful reply! There is no need for further trial, just based on this single line I declare the ten of them to be the victims of this entire shady deal!!"
Evelyn quickly announced, PetoPhil was about to interrupt but Vritra took a step forward and wrapped a piece of cloth around his mouth forcefully.
The rest of the court watched in stunned silence.
Vritra had literally silenced the lawyer of the opposition, what sort of trial was this?

"As compensation to these ten from the Zoratian planet, they can now skip the trial, 1st game, 2nd game and as they have already won the third game, so all ten of them will now be promoted to demigods at level 3!"
Evelyn made another shocking revelation, shocking everyone even further.
What sort of compensation? Even if they actually won, they shouldn't be receiving even half of that.

"Furthermore, the ten gods for their personal benefits had put them through unimaginable mental pressure, are responsible for many deaths. They will receive the harshest punishment that will be decided by my father and as for PetoPhil, for defending the criminals, twisting the truth and various other crimes, you can no longer be a lawyer, all your money and property will be seized, you'll be living in prison for two years and be whipped each day." Evelyn made the final judgment.
"Mmm uuuuuu" PetoPhil tried to scream but was already tied up, he wriggled on the ground.
How come a lawyer was the one getting punishments for a trial? Just what is happening?
"Hahaha this is the first time I'm seeing that the lawyer was found guilty in the case. But serves that arrogant dwarf bastard right, I didn't like his smile."
"Pffttt what's more pitiful are those gods, just look at them they are still shocked, I've never been to a trial this funny. Those ten even got beat up by the Divine, this is big news!!"
All the people excitedly exited the court, the news would soon be spreading everywhere.
"..." The ten gods just sat there, even if they had just accepted their crimes they would at most have received a warning and maybe a day or two in prison.
But now?
They were fucked.
Vritra ignored the gods and finally took off his foot from PetoPhil's head, maybe he could even be a lawyer.
He was just too talented.
Several people even came to congratulate him, and Vritra being the humble one just blamed the creators for making him overly talented.
Soon most people had left, the ten gods were still seated there.
"That was a good battle, very soon we will however be fighting a real battle, be ready." Vritra spoke, showing a big smile that irritated the gods a great deal.
{Sin Point Gained: Enraged +11}
'Oh this is back?!' Vritra thought in surprise, finally they were done with that apocalyptic land.
But he wondered if the people there would finally experience peace, yet it was out of his capability.
"You won't be smiling for long, I will make sure you cry blood tears!" the Sun god threatened, interrupting Vritra's thoughts.
"Heh you better pray that doesn't happen, or you will be left regretting." Vritra said and turned, he was still no match for them but very soon, they would be dethroned and beaten.
Finally the ten gods were taken away.
"PetoPhil, enjoy your time in prison and didn't you say something earlier you would do if you lose? Make sure to fulfill your promise." Vritra cut the rope as PetoPhil finally got free.
"You bastard, you are going to regret it, do you know who my step daddy is!! He will..." PetoPhil screamed as he got dragged away.

chapters.title: Chapter 742 Ill fated
paragraphs: Vritra just rolled his eyes at PetoPhil as he walked toward his wives, all of them hugged him one by one, clearly very proud of him.
"..." Evelyn looked at Vritra from her seat, despite him being in front of her she couldn't hold him.
She felt a bit sad, even if Vritra finally remembered his love for her, her family and the higher beings would still be a headache to deal with.
All the fights Vritra had fought before on this planet were no doubt dangerous but they couldn't even compare to the higher beings.
That place would be too deadly, even someone like the Divine or herself couldn't do as they pleased.
There was still so much Vritra didn't know, and Evelyn planned to start by making him remember all their time together in that long dream.
After taking a long look at him she turned and walked away, soon leaving the court.
Vritra glanced back while Evelyn was walking away, and for some reason he felt that she was so lonely, he almost instinctively wanted to hold her close.
To make her happy and make the loneliness disappear.
But he didn't do anything and watched as Evelyn disappeared from his sight, but he was certainly very grateful to her.

If it wasn't for her, he would have lost this trial, not to mention she is the one who had given him all these opportunities, all his skills, only thanks to her was he able to come into this new world.
Experience so many wonderful things, grow so strong, meet his wives, otherwise he would be just like those humans in the apocalypse.
Just trying to survive a death game, killed without even having a chance, so he was definitely very grateful to Evelyn.
Still, that was not something that would make him fall in love with her, if ever there comes a time he would do the same and help her to the best of his abilities.
For now, they had just survived a deadly game and were finally free to return to their homes.
All his wives were quite happy, the same was true for Shitless, Onest and Asmodeus.
[Your prizes will soon be delivered to you all.]
[All of you will now be returning to your respective planets!]
"But will Shitless continue to look like a red mutant?" Onest asked, he can't go around with something so strange.
[COUGH All abnormalities will be restored... Probably, I can only try.]
Shitless: "..."
No way he was going to lose his handsome appearance and be stuck looking like a red monster?
[Well, the color could still be changed but I don't understand why he looks too much like a mutant.]
The message window appeared, Vritra was surprised as it could communicate like that, he thought it was just a way to show messages.
"Oh uh, you just need to fix the color. The rest, he was born with it." Onest laughed as he put his arm around Shitless's shoulder.
[...Okay, you'll be sent back to your planets in five minutes.]
Shitless punched Onest but his body naturally dodged the attack as he jumped away, laughing loudly.

chapters.title: Chapter 743 The Distant Enemies
paragraphs: "This was the golden time?" Vritra asked in exasperation.
"Yes, the worst is going to be in the time that's to come." Shitless added, sighing.
"...Worse than what I have been through?" Vritra's lips stretched into a thin line.

"Yeah, it is a complete mess, so bad that I am feeling chills, people's futures could be bleak but yours is straight up disaster, it is so cataclysmic that-" Shitless let his emotion take control of him and began to pour his heart out.
"Enough!" Vritra's fragile heart could not handle such heavy words, he sighed, a disastrous adventure had just ended and he hadn't even reached the main difficulty yet?
He didn't want to imagine what a tough time would look like.
"It's alright, we will just have to handle whatever happens later on." Vritra shrugged, it was pointless to think about it for now.
And very soon, their strength was about to increase, it would reach the 3rd level.
After calming his mind, Vritra walked back to his wives.
"What's wrong hubby?" Yasmine asked, taking his hand.
"It's nothing." He shook his head and decided to warn them later, but what was even there to warn about.
They knew nothing and Vritra was always surrounded by trouble, so it really wasn't anything new.
[You are now being teleported back...]
Then all their bodies glowed together and then all eleven of them disappeared.
The ten gods were sent to be judged by Evelyn's father, he was a prominent figure among the higher beings.
Evelyn herself held quite a high position and strength, which is why she was able to be the judge of such a level of trial.
The ten gods for scheming and doing shady things in the background, would be punished.
Though it still wouldn't be too harsh since the gods would still need to continue working.
But in fact they were being punished for getting caught, it wasn't like the gods could actually fool the higher beings, but they would just look the other way if it's not too serious.
Or it doesn't blow up.
After the ten gods, PetoPhil was sent into the world prison, he received the due whips that brought him close to death.
But of course these strikes weren't meant to kill, after the whips he was thrown into the prison.
Until his father arrived and after bribing the guards and a few others, reduced the sentence to just a few days.
Somewhere far away from the Zoratian planet, inside a big glass container which was filled with some blackish sticky fluid.
Inside the fluid a faint figure of something gigantic could be seen, his eyes were closed and he kept absorbing energy from the medicinal fluid.
Various treasures were being used to deliver energy into the tank. Quite a few figures entered and exited the large hall to check up and arrange things.
A few moments of silence later, the tank began to buzz as the liquid inside it started to boil, cracks formed over the thick glass container.
The eyes of the figure opened, glowing with intensity as suddenly the container exploded and a loud roar rang out.
A large lizard-like creature jumped out, his body covered by thick dark scales and a dense aura around his body.
The roar made the floor crack up and several of the people around exploded at once, some fainted and others escaped in terror.
"OUT!! I am finally complete!!"
This guy was none other than Drino, the level 3 Demi-god who had attacked Yasmine and was contracted by the gods to kill her.
The battle against him was very deadly and one that Vritra barely won, that too after the help from his wives, who were using the treasures from the Divine.
Fire of vengeance burned in his eyes, he had been humiliated the last time, his body was destroyed.
He was shot into space and was so helpless that he wasn't even able to escape, that humiliation was buried deep in his mind, imprinted very deeply.
"That damned bug, this time I am going to crush you!" He had looked down on those people and instead of going all out initially he toyed around with them.
Vritra had even stolen so many of his weapons, he would never forget that hateful face.
"I am going to kill him and everyone around him! I want to see him beg, to see him cry, I will beat him to a state that he would start pissing himself!!" Drino roared, an explosive fire bursting out.
His strength was even higher than before, thankfully he had received special treasures from his friends.
"Right, so much time has passed, the strength of that bug must have also increased by a lot. I can't be reckless this time, I have to make preparations first."
Drino decided, he had used brute force last time and failed, he wouldn't let his pride make a fool of himself again.
Then he pondered who to ask for help.
Right, first he should contact the gods and ask for an early payment, so that he could kill Vritra.
The gods must have ways or treasures that would be of great help, they might even have stronger allies.
"Alright, let's meet the gods first!" After making up his mind, he flew away and travelled through space to meet the very god who had asked him to kill Yasmine last time.
After a long travel, he arrived in a bright white space.
He called out several times, but received no response, frowning he called out even louder.
"Quiet!" A loud voice rang out in irritation as a figure appeared before Drino.
It was not the god but the administrator that worked under the gods, still their strength was quite high.
"Administrator? Where is the god?" Drino asked, frowning.
"He has been arrested, in fact all the gods have been arrested after they got caught doing shady things in the background." The administrator spoke in an emotionless tone.
"Huh? Arrested? The gods? Why, what happened?" Drino asked in bafflement, those gods are so strong and plan everything through.
How could they have been arrested?

"They got matched with someone wrong, they messed with the wrong guy this time. They tried to weaken his planet but instead that group broke into the game, killed many players and won the game. Then in the trial, he won and the gods got punished." The administrator quickly explained.
This news had already spread far and wide so there was no problem in sharing it with him.
"What the fuck?!! Who could be this capable? The gods, they got beaten by some random people? Hoo" Drino breathed in cold air, how could the world have changed so much in the time he was away?
Before, the gods were so almighty that no one would dare to stand against them, even someone as excellent as the Divine ended up dead before them.
"Oh right, there is also this video circulating around which you should see." The administrator remembered something and opened the video in which the gods were beaten by someone.
"W- Wha- who is that? Is that someone among the higher beings? How can he beat the gods so easily?" Drino almost fell to his knees upon seeing that.
"I can't tell, it's classified." The administrator shook his head then asked: "So why were you here? Is it something important?"
"Uh... Yeah I wanted to ask for the god's help in killing someone but I didn't expect the gods themselves to be so helpless sigh..." Drino shook his head in disappointment.

"Killing someone? I can help you get contact with some strong people but the commotion can't be too big, and Demi-gods at higher levels won't get involved in such petty matters." The administrator shrugged.
"That is fine, thank you." Drino was still happy, if he could bring several Demi-gods in, he was sure they could kill Vritra easily.
No matter what, he was sure Vritra's strength would be nowhere near his own, even if he got reincarnated during this time.
The games take time, no one can complete them so fast.
After getting more connections, Drino left, he needed to prepare for a powerful attack.
Ten figures flashed as they arrived inside a dark house, which was floating in the sky.
Vritra and the others found themselves back inside their house, they were really back.
Right away they all looked outside through the window and saw that the snow was all gone, everything was normal, there were no mutants roaming the roads.
It was all so normal.
"We are back!" Fiona exclaimed.
She thought for a few moments and decided: "Darling I'm going to check up on the Phoenix Kingdom and see how those slackers are doing."
Vritra nodded and in the next second, Fiona turned into a ray of light and disappeared from his sight.
"Guess I will also go check the Succubus Kingdom." Vanessa said, she waited for a moment to see if Vritra also wanted to go.
But he didn't say anything and just nodded, so after a kiss on his lips she too left.
"Hmm should I go check the continent too?" Diana wondered, she was the new empress after all.
"Sure, go ahead, we need to enjoy this peaceful environment." Vritra spoke, patting the goddess's head.
"Thanks dear." Diana too left, as she flew out of the window.
"I will go see that intelligence organization, and the demons of my kingdom." Maeve said as she merged into darkness and disappeared, but not before adding: "I will be back quickly master."
Now, Yennefer, Teresa and Yasmine remained beside him.
Seeing Maeve use that shadow ability, Vritra realised something as he flew out of the house and decided to check something.
