"Guess I will also go check the Succubus Kingdom." Vanessa said, she waited for a moment to see if Vritra also wanted to go.
But he didn't say anything and just nodded, so after a kiss on his lips she too left.
"Hmm should I go check the continent too?" Diana wondered, she was the new empress after all.
"Sure, go ahead, we need to enjoy this peaceful environment." Vritra spoke, patting the goddess's head.
"Thanks dear." Diana too left, as she flew out of the window.
"I will go see that intelligence organization, and the demons of my kingdom." Maeve said as she merged into darkness and disappeared, but not before adding: "I will be back quickly master."
Now, Yennefer, Teresa and Yasmine remained beside him.
Seeing Maeve use that shadow ability, Vritra realised something as he flew out of the house and decided to check something.

chapters.title: Chapter 744 Back to the Zoratian Planet
paragraphs: Vritra flew out of the house, Yasmine, Teresa and Yennefer followed him out.
Shitless and Onest had gone out to meet Bullo.
Just then Vritra noticed all the lord rank guards that were spread around the house and then his gaze focused on a few special figures.
There were the soul wraiths, Knight, Hellmancer, Bob, Bobby, Psyche and the Chimera.
"Knight, you have grown stronger."
He spoke, after absorbing Drino's dead body, Knight's strength had risen to level 3 of Demi-god.
The Knight had a long sword on his back and a deadly presence that made the surroundings shudder, the space around him was full of darkness.
Even Vritra was yet to receive the rewards from the game so he was not yet at level 3.
Knight bowed before him along with all the other soul wraiths, he really was back, this was such a wonderful feeling.
"Good job, you have all done well." Vritra said, in his absence they were the ones to protect and watch over everything.
Although he had cleaned up all the dark forces before leaving but there was no way people could be controlled and there might already be many new such groups.
It was fine though, with their current strength no one on this planet could be their match.
The main problems were the ones who were outside of the planet, after this win, the enemies they would be facing would be far stronger.
'But for now, let's all just relax.'
The soul wraiths all disappeared into his shadow while the other lord rank guards turned to stone and looked nothing more than statues.
Just as Vritra was looking around, several messages popped up before him.
[You have received your rewards!]
[Please check them out. In case of any problem, you may state your problems.]
Similar messages had popped up in front of all ten of them, the rewards had directly been delivered to their inventories.
Vritra looked into the inventory and saw two spheres, the two were of different sizes and all with increasing power levels.
One was for level 2 while the other for level 3 Demi-god, their strength would increase as soon as they finished absorbing them.
"I see no problem in them." Yennefer spoke, Yasmine and Teresa nodded as well.
But they were in no hurry to absorb them.
He looked back at the three women, all three of them also had places they would like to visit.
But they didn't directly leave probably because they wanted him to go with them.
After staying with his wives for so long, he had understood that many times, they wouldn't say what it is exactly that they want.
So he must guess that they expect something from him and then find what they expect.
After thinking, he spoke: "Yenni, let's go there first. Wifey, Tess, wait a little for me."
"Okay hubby." Yasmine smiled, she wouldn't mind such small things.
"Mmm" Teresa hummed.
"..." The empress looked at Vritra with an infatuated look, seeing how he understood what exactly she wanted, she wanted to kiss him so bad.
'I sure am lucky-' Yennefer was looking at Vritra's face with a dreamy look but got interrupted by him.
"Yes yes you are very lucky, shall we go now?" Vritra spoke, taking her soft warm hand.
For a second, Yennefer was surprised, did he read her mind or something? How did he find out?
"Hmph I didn't think that, but... I am indeed lucky." Yennefer first acted proud but still couldn't disagree.
Vritra rolled his eyes as the two flew away, their speed was fast enough that none of the lords would even be able to see them.
"Yenni..." while flying Vritra called out.
"Yes?" The two were looking at the ground, the peaceful surroundings while flying.
"How many elements are you able to control so far?" Vritra had been quite curious about it but forgot to ask.
"Hmm combining all the basic elements, and many others, so more than ten and I think I can just control all the elements. I haven't yet sensed any restrictions." She answered.
"That's impressive, I have never seen such an ability. Your physique must be pretty great." He spoke.
Vritra extended his right hand as hundreds of blood butterflies flew in all directions, it was a beautiful but eerie sight.
They had all retained their abilities from the apocalyptic planet, though Vritra didn't have the abilities he had taken from other players.
But this blood manipulation was pretty good, he already possessed his OP skill dust manipulation.
It was already incredibly powerful.
But in the upcoming battles he would need to upgrade all his skills further, just dust manipulation at full power would be very destructive.
"Yes, this is called Infinite Elemental Physique." Yennefer said, tapping over a butterfly as it flew away before disappearing.
"Oh it has a name too, so did someone else possess it too? Maybe in the past?" he asked, Vritra didn't think such a powerful physique could appear again.

"Hehe no, it was me who named it. Initially it was quite troublesome, when news of me being able to control several elements spread, quite a few human organizations, demons and other races had attacked us."
Yennefer said, her expressions turning solemn.
She had lost her family and so many others to the demons, that is exactly why she hated them.
But she had already wiped them all out, yet Yennefer still didn't feel satisfied, she felt as if there were still some that were yet to be killed.
"I see, I believe your abilities have a lot of growth potential. Once we get entangled with battles outside our planet, you will get your opportunities."
Hearing him, Yennefer nodded. The stronger they are the better it is for their family.
While chatting the two had arrived at the place where the grave of Yennefer's parents was present, she had brought him here once before.
As the two landed, Vritra looked at his blue-haired, beautiful and a little arrogant wife.
He too was lucky, she loved him enough to sacrifice herself.
Yennefer gave a gentle tug, as Vritra was lost in his thoughts.
The two walked closer to her parents' graves, even after going through all that she had, she still felt sad whenever she came here.
Yet this was a place she couldn't stop coming to.
"Mother, father, I am here... with my husband." Yennefer spoke, her tone low.
Vritra wrapped his arm around her shoulder to support her.
"Don't you worry, I will take proper care of her, forever." He spoke, holding her tight.
Yennefer felt quite happy, she shared various of their adventures, telling about the dangerous parts and some where it was fun.
The two stayed there for a bit, finally she said goodbye to her parents and the two walked out.
"Are you feeling okay?" Vritra asked.
"...Yes." Yennefer nodded but he knew just what could cheer her up, so taking her hand he flew away.
After arriving in the market, the two landed.
With Vritra's skill 'Lost', the people ignored the two.
"Husband, aren't we going back? They must be waiting." Yennefer asked in confusion.
He paused before a shop and told her to wait a moment, then Vritra went inside and after a minute came out, holding two ice creams.
The combination of hot and sweet would be quite good now.
"Ice cream?"
He really knew what she needed and even the things she didn't know she needed, Yennefer just felt like hiding in his arms.
It would be so comfortable and safe.
"Here, let's eat it while flying slowly." Vritra created a blood cart and the two climbed up.
It flew a little slower as they chatted and enjoyed the peaceful surrounding scenery.
Soon when the ice creams ended, Vritra increased the speed of the blood cart.
They could have arrived back even faster by flying themselves, but he also wanted to spend a little extra time with her.
Later on, he would bring his wives and go meet Gunter and Ava.
He was back in the clothes made of goop, its strength was quite high but soon wouldn't be enough to match his level.
'Looks like I need to feed you with more weapons soon.' Vritra thought, to upgrade all his skills he would also need to gain more sin points soon.
Though he currently had a few millions which he got after that battle but didn't get to use.
"Thank you husband..." Yennefer said as they got closer to their house.
Vritra put his arms around her waist, pulling her closer, their faces impossibly close.
"Thanks for what, that is what I must do. Of course, instead of thanks you can give me your special rewards." He said, looking straight into her eyes.
Yennefer wasn't one to shy away, she was one of his most direct wives, in fact the one to jump onto Vritra.
"That, I can keep giving you just for being with me~" Yennefer leaned forward as she put her arms over his shoulders and pressed her lips against his.
Vritra bit her lip, then pushing his tongue into her mouth, having a taste of her.
The kiss didn't last too long, Yennefer panted slightly as the two separated, a long bridge of saliva forming between their lips.
"Husband, now that you mentioned it, before any more danger arrives maybe I should try to work on controlling more elements." Yennefer spoke, staying in his arms.
Just the thought made her excited.
"Sure, we will need to find more elements for it and maybe Divine will be able to help." Vritra added, the two separated and looked down.
"Mmm but that's something we can think about later, for now we just need a long rest." She muttered.

chapters.title: Chapter 745 Omega
paragraphs: Vritra and Yennefer landed on the ground where Yasmine and Teresa waited for him.
He first looked at Yasmine, she would want to visit the dragon kingdom, no matter what that place was still something her parents had put so much effort into.
And it's not like all the dragons are bad, the ones who were had already been turned into wraiths by Vritra.
That was also the place where so many of her memories were tied.
Her father's grave was there, although her mother had just disappeared a long time ago, though she had made a grave for her.
Although Yasmine didn't want to believe it, there was a high chance she might already be dead, otherwise she wouldn't be gone for so long.
Then he looked at Teresa, she probably wanted to go visit her family.
Although he wasn't very fond of most of them, but it was fine, she had changed and was no longer the type who would let others harm her.
Remembering something, he asked: "Tess, can you now control that fate ability of yours?"
"Hmm let me see." Teresa still had that wall ability, she had never before tried to control the fate ability, allowing whoever she touched to steal all their bad fate.
But now, she felt she could choose whether to take the good or bad ones.
Though completely controlling the ability would still be a bit hard, though with the Wall ability, she could control it.
"I can." After thinking it through, she spoke.
"That's great then, well let's go to the dragon kingdom first, after that we will go meet your ex-family." He said, and the two women nodded.
Yennefer didn't really have any other place she wanted to go, and she wanted to stay close to Vritra so she decided to go along.
Jumping onto the blood cart, the three headed to the dragon realm.
[Null Activated!]
Instantly a portal opened before them and the cart was sucked inside.
The succubi were quite happy to see Vanessa return, Layla was the temporary empress in her absence.
And she had been taking care of everything very well.
Of course, Vanessa wasn't there to take back control, she had far more important matters now.
Previously she had done it to help her son once he returned but with his strength, he didn't need any of that.
Though with their combined efforts, they had cleared up Vritra's name and shown the people how much he helped everyone.
And that he wasn't the demon they all thought of him as.
Honestly, it didn't really matter to Vritra, but still they didn't like these people talking bad about him.
Diana, as the former human empress, also returned to find that everything was going fine.
There were problems initially but she had already set several people to take charge in her absence and it all sorted out in the end.
Though the people of the phoenix race weren't as happy, they were of course relieved that their empress was back.
But more than that, they were all afraid of her, she was too ruthless after all.
Though this time, shockingly, she didn't kill anyone.
Similarly for Maeve, she found that the organization had no problems, the world information centre was still going just as before.
After they all made sure everything was fine, they spent a bit more time and then decided to return to Vritra.
After passing through the teleportation portal and flying a little distance, the blood cart arrived in the dragon kingdom.
The population of the dragons had reduced quite a bit after Vritra had killed many before.
Still, they were one of the strongest beings in existence on the Zoratian planet.
Even though their ruler was gone, none of the other races still dared to attack them.
They might have also chosen a temporary emperor or maybe someone might have seized this chance to become the emperor.
"If nothing had gone wrong I would still be just ruling this kingdom, or maybe already dead." Yasmine muttered.
"Well one way or another, I am sure we would have met, though our marriage wouldn't have been so strange then." He added, making the dragoness giggle.
She still remembered how she had tricked him into marrying her, and now thinking back on it, it was too funny.
He must have known something was wrong but Vritra didn't really have any choice and he still needed the strength boost.
And with it he got his first wife.
Good old days, it had already been years, Vritra was so young back then.
They directly passed through the protective layer of the kingdom, though many dragons noticed the presence of the flying cart quickly.
Some of the guarding dragons approached them cautiously, not anyone could just pass through the protective barrier.
"Identify yourself- huh? Empress? You are back!!" the guard instantly recognized Yasmine, and in fact he seemed quite happy.
The other four also recognized her, the killing intent instantly disappeared and they had tears in their eyes.
The five guys, like pitiful children who had been bullied for months, instantly knelt in the air and started sobbing.
These were five grown men, and the sight of them sobbing like that was extremely strange.
"What's wrong?" Vritra asked, he moved the blood cart back to create some distance between them.
"Save us empress SOB we... we are getting bullied by that crazy emperor, he is retarded- umph" the dragon speaking quickly covered his mouth.
Afraid that that bastard might hear it and beat them again.
"Who is the new ruler?" Yasmine asked, her brows knitting slightly.
"It is Omega, that young cousin brother of Drago, he got support of a few other races and their top warriors, so he forcefully took the throne." Another guard explained.
Vritra glanced at Yasmine, wondering if she knew anything about this new guy.
"Oh Omega, he was quite young back then, I don't really remember much of him." She spoke, feeling her hubby's gaze.
"Yes, he didn't stand out much and only after you disappeared did he finally show his true colours." One of the guards spoke.
"In fact, when Drago was the emperor, he had disappeared and gone off to some other race. From there, he started gathering support."
Then Omega got lucky since Drago was killed and soon after Yasmine had left, unlike the other women she hadn't really left anyone to take care of the dragons.
She was too angry the previous time and went off to the game in a bit of a hurry.
So Omega used this chance to take control of everything and of course it wasn't too hard for him to get support.
Which race wouldn't want the dragons to work under them? By controlling Omega they would be able to control all dragons.
One or two races might not be able to do anything but several races would definitely pose enough threat.
Especially since the top warriors had mostly died already.
"Hmm since we are here anyway, I guess we will meet him." Yennefer spoke, it was already time for some action it seemed.
"W- Will you help us empress?" the five guards pleaded, their eyes still full of tears.
Life had been very bad recently, each day full of torture and pain and endless humiliation.

Especially since the top warriors had mostly died already.
"Hmm since we are here anyway, I guess we will meet him." Yennefer spoke, it was already time for some action it seemed.
"W- Will you help us empress?" the five guards pleaded, their eyes still full of tears.
Life had been very bad recently, each day full of torture and pain and endless humiliation.

chapters.title: Chapter 746 Piku, the tax slayer
paragraphs: Hearing their pleas, Yasmine glanced at Vritra though he said nothing so she came to an answer on her own.
"Alright, I will deal with him." Yasmine nodded, they were at the demi-god rank, so just one thought was enough to kill a few lords.
Although she won't be babysitting them, but helping once was fine.
Most of the dragons had always supported her too, so Yasmine made up her mind.
"Let's first just go meet him then." Vritra said, he didn't need to interfere in this matter, he was sure she could easily handle it.
"E- Empress, be careful, there are several lords around him, they are all very powerful!" the guards warned, they knew how powerful Yasmine was but weren't sure if she could directly fight them all.
"Just lead us to him, I will handle the rest." Yasmine said, her tone emotionless.
She seemed completely different from how she was with Vritra or other family members.
Like a true empress.
The dragon guards nodded and quickly flew away, the blood cart followed behind them.
In the market, a man with a big belly which seemed as if he had been pregnant for 3 years with at least 5 kids, was walking around.
He was on a regular round to make sure that the public was not trying to steal the tax money.
This was Piku, a member of the beast race and a powerful lord, who had recently become the right-hand man of the dragon emperor.
Unlike his short name he was rather large with a face that resembled a hippo, his jaw certainly had a powerful biting force.

"Get out here, and pay your daily taxes. 70% of whatever you earned and 10% additional as your thanks to the emperor, 5% for me since I am going door to door collecting it, instead of making you all go there."
Piku shouted, his loud voice reverberated throughout the market.
The people groaned in annoyance, yet none dared to raise their voice.
They were all dragons but they could do nothing against these outsiders and the emperor.
That bastard Omega had dared to let the outsiders infiltrate their kingdom, all of them hated him.
Of course, the outsiders would try to get as much of it as possible. The free labour and all the treasures, it was just too beneficial.
"Hmm you little one, come here and pay the small amount of tax, you can add 5% extra if the amount is lower than the mentioned one." He added.
The people had no choice but to comply, a man walked out limply and gave most of what he had earned the previous day.
"Hmph just this much?" Piku raised his leg which was like a horse's and shouted: "Take Piku's tax kick, Tax Shot!"
The man was thrown back, he was a dragon so he didn't receive life-threatening injuries but that was still a kick from a lord.
The sound of his ribs breaking rang out, as he coughed blood.
The others were frightened, but what could they even do. If all people are poor then who is even going to spend money?
Then they would just end up with less money, and earn less, it was a loop and they were all stuck in it.
Quite a few were following behind Piku, all of them looking quite arrogant.
"Look, sir what's that up there?! Are we getting attacked?" someone suddenly pointed to the sky in shock.
Piku looked up, his eyes narrowing.
Who dared to come attack his land? Someone had a death wish it seemed.
He saw a flying cart going straight towards the castle where the emperor is, someone actually had the guts to not greet him first before meeting the emperor?
Or were they really here to attack? Who could be so stupid?
In any case, these people weren't welcomed here, and Piku would make sure of it.
He took out a spear from a storage glyph and aimed at the quickly moving blood cart, then with all his might he shot it up.
"Go destroy it my special, Tax Spear Bullet!!"
WHOOSH
The spear shot up with very high speed, powerful enough to kill most of the dragons, ripping them apart.
All the dragons in the market looked up pitifully, and hoped that the cart contained someone important.
Someone, who proves that it was Piku's life's greatest mistake to attack it.
They all looked up hopefully.
Only after throwing the spear did Piku notice the guards who were leading the cart, and he hesitated a bit.
'But it is my race that has supported him the most, even if it offends someone important. Omega won't blame me right?'
After a moment, he regained his composure and shouted: "No one should fly above me, everyone needs to go from below me. Who allowed them to fly here?"
THUD
The spear struck the blood cart but unlike what they all expected it didn't explode, instead the spear blasted to pieces.
The guards were shocked, they looked down and then smiled.
"Kekeke you fat piece of Piku the ass eater, did you enjoy making a pillar of tax money and shoving it into you?" one of the guards shouted angrily.
Finally, they could let out their frustrations, they had been beaten by that fat pig so many times.
"W- What?!!" Piku was shocked by two things and he didn't know whether to look at the cart or the guards.
"You bastards- huh? That spear- wait, how dare you fuckers!!" Piku stuttered and didn't even know what to say.
That looked like a frail cart, how did it survive? In fact he was afraid, he had just accidentally attacked someone important.
Yasmine glanced down, the people on the ground all had strong senses that they were able to see her face.
"Empress!!" several of them exclaimed at once, instantly a wave of happiness rose.
They all began to chant the same thing, some even kneeling and thanking the heavens.
Piku frowned as he saw the face of the extremely beautiful redhead, for a moment he was dazed.
But then returned to his senses upon hearing the shouts of all the people around him.
'Empress? Is she Yasmine? She is back?!!' just hearing that name, Piku shivered.
She was dangerous, far too dangerous. Even before she was able to kill several lords like him without much difficulty.
His legs trembled and he almost fell, but trying to act tough and knowing there was a big backup, he shouted:
"So it is you, Y- Yasmine, how d- dare you b- break the laws of this kingdom. No one except the emperor or his special unit is a- allowed to fly h- here."
He was literally stuttering at every word, fearing she might attack.
But she must have also heard how much power Omega holds, so no way she would attack right?
'Oh right, she also knew Vritra- but hadn't he died? So I just need to worry about her.'
The news of Vritra's return hadn't spread, after all most of the ones who saw it were already dead.
"And you are?" Yasmine asked, her cold tone made Piku even more fearful, he tried to reply but Yasmine interrupted.
"Forget it, that's not important. Come along to the palace."
Then a large hand of dust rose, and then shot towards Piku, suddenly grasping him tightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 747 Unprecedented
paragraphs: Piku, the lord with a hippo-like face, was suddenly grasped by a large dust hand and pulled off the ground.
The ones standing around him were startled, it happened way too fast.
"Uwaaaaaah S- Stooopppp O- Omega is going to killll youuuuuu, I am his favourite m- man!!" Piku screamed in fright.
He might be a lord, but he had just achieved that rank through luck and favours, he didn't possess much fighting power.
Since he was so useless, he was made the tax collector, he had also begged to be one since it was his favourite job.
Beat up normal folks, which was very fun especially if they are dragons, and steal their money but legally.
His strength could only be said to be on the lower tiers of the lord rank, all the strong ones Omega always kept around himself.
"You are?" Vritra asked, he gazed at the fat lord.
This was the typical type of wannabe villain who bows to strength and acts superior to everyone weaker than them.
"P- Piku, I- I am Piku! The right-hand man of the emperor of dragons, Omega, if you want to survive then let me go ugghhhh!!"
But the grip only tightened, as scrunching sounds of bones breaking rang out.
The people on the ground were scared, if a lord was beaten so easily, what chance did they have?
"D- Don't worry boss, we will quickly go inform the emperor about this!!" the beast men following behind Piku prioritized their lives over their duty.
"Y- You fucking bastards, come here! H- Help meeeee, ahhhhh t- too tight, aaaaaah my belly is about to bursttttttt-" Piku screamed in pain but his dutiful underlings didn't let that distract them.
They ran at full speed, then flew up and headed straight towards the palace.
"..." Yasmine looked at the escaping figures and wordlessly released a powerful spiritual burst, the skill she had gotten from the game.
BANG BANG BANG
The heads of the several men exploded at once, the sight scared Piku even more, despite the pain he remained silent.
"Stay quiet, if you release another noise, you will suffer the same fate." Yasmine said, her eyes glowing with a dangerous glint.
She looked like a reaper from hell, so dangerous despite being extremely beautiful.
The dragons on the ground stared at this scene in shock, then they burst out in cheers, praising Yasmine, their real empress.
"Long live the empress!!"
The guards who were leading them in were also overjoyed, while Piku only hoped that Omega and the others could save him.
"Let's go, hubby." Yasmine said, her tone much softer as she looked at Vritra.
Nodding, he led the blood cart forward, while carrying Piku by the dust hand, the combination of both skills would be quite deadly.
'I wonder if there is some way to merge the two? That'll have to wait I guess.' He thought.
The dragons cheered louder, seeing the cart fly towards the palace, they all knew that Yasmine was going there to slay that crazy fake emperor.
There were a lot of guards who followed Omega spread across the kingdom, most of them flew up upon seeing the blood cart and dust hand.
They wanted to protect Piku to earn his favour but if a lord was caught like that, what could they even do?
Still wherever the cart passed, those creatures had their heads explode at once, Yasmine killed them without any mercy.
Before long, they had arrived close to the palace.
The blood cart landed and all four of them got off, walking towards the big doors of the outer perimeter.
"Stop right there!! Who are yo-" the guards were a mix of dragons, beast men and other races like fishmen, werewolves, elves.
The dragons were the first to recognize Yasmine, but unlike the other dragons they weren't overjoyed, after all they were already serving Omega.
"Omegaaaaaaa, save me!!" Piku began to scream instantly.
"Sigh, looks like you can't understand simple words." Vritra shook his head, in the next moment, particles of dust burst into his body.
CRACK SCRUNCH
Strange noises rang out as his bones broke, internal organs burst out, within moments the body was gone.
Only the head remained, still he was not dead because of lord rank vitality.
"Call Omega outside." Yasmine ordered, her presence was so oppressive that none of the guards dared to utter a word.
One on the back side quickly ran inside the palace to call their emperor.
"Wifey, don't kill him immediately, let us see if he has any important information, maybe he is just a puppet." Vritra said, though he was sure Yasmine must've already thought about it.
It's just sometimes, people forget simple things because of their emotions.
"Hmm" Yasmine nodded, she stood beside him and stared at the palace door.
The palace had been built again it seemed, this building didn't exist here before.
Yasmine looked to the other side and noticed the palace that Vritra had created for her, exactly like the one she had before, was gone.
It made her angry, not only was it given by her hubby but it was full of her childhood memories, the memories of her parents.
And this bastard Omega dared to break it?
He was going to regret it all so badly.
After a few minutes, quite a few figures walked out of the palace.
The one walking at the front had two horns above his head and had a burly body, it was none other than Omega, the self-proclaimed dragon emperor.
"Oh, if it isn't my cousin Yasmine, didn't expect to see you ever again." Omega said, he resembled Drago quite a bit.
"Omega, you have grown up." Yasmine said as she gazed at the people surrounding him.
All of them were lords, some from the dragon race while most from the other races, there were over 100 lords.
"Haha I sure have, but why did you come? I mean, had you told me before I would have prepared a big welcoming party for you." Omega said, he was bare-chested, only wearing pants on his lower body.
"There is no need for that, how did you collect all of them? I don't remember much of you but you weren't the type to hoard power.
So who asked you to do this?"
"Pfftt hahaha my cousin, you are still as funny as before. Why would I need someone to tell me anything? I collected these slaves, isn't it fun to rule over these bugs? I am just doing that."
Omega walked forward, his muscular arms spread wide as he continued.
"Didn't you and your parents feel the same? I remember when I was younger, you ruled the dragon race, it looked as if none of this mattered to you anymore-"
"Stop this gibberish, get to the point." Yasmine said, her eyes glowing for a moment.
BOOOOOOOOOOM
The bodies of all the lords standing behind Omega exploded at once, this was her second power.
Explosion, which she didn't get to use much before.
The power of the explosion would have been greater but Vritra used dust to control it.
The guards and others were all shocked to see that so many lords, the strongest beings, were all dead in an instant.
Just from a gaze? What was even happening? This was insane, maddening to the highest degree.
Unprecedented and unheard, when did she get so strong?

chapters.title: Chapter 748 The Unexpected
paragraphs: All the people didn't even realize what had happened and over a hundred of the lords were dead.
'What a waste.' Vritra shook his head, but he let the Nihilanima mythic halo spread around and consume all the souls.
Not to create any soul wraiths but just as its food.
The Nihilanima with his help had already returned to its peak strength, it could even devour demi-gods now.
Even Piku was killed along with the others, leaving only Omega alive among all the opposing lords.
"Hmm not bad, as expected of you."
But what was actually shocking was that Omega didn't show any change of expression.
Vritra was expecting him to show a complete 180 after seeing Yasmine's strength, shouldn't he be afraid?
Either he is really crazy or has some backup, and the latter case might not be good.
Vritra, Yasmine, Yennefer and Teresa, all of them were confused by Omega's strange behaviour.
"Huh? Oh right, I should be scared at this moment aaaaaah" Omega let out a dramatic scream before standing straight, his lips stretching wide.
"Hmm I am still getting used to this body, this skin is kinda tight, too small for me." Pinching his own skin as if he was handling a piece of cloth, Omega muttered.
"Wait, that's not Omega!" Yasmine and the others realized this at the same time.
"Who are you?" Vritra asked, his eyes narrowing. He glanced at the messages of the sin points but it wasn't of any help.
The man walked back and forth, looking at the pieces of the bodies of all the lords that had exploded.
'He has been here for quite some time, and he doesn't seem surprised by seeing us, was he waiting? But who can it be?' Vritra was ready to attack and defend.
"He has two fates..." Teresa muttered, the other guy, Omega, was still somehow alive.
It wasn't just a normal takeover, it was like half the body belonged to one and the other half to another.
"Well hello, as you guys already guessed. I am not Omega, I took over him quite some time ago." Omega spoke, throwing his long hair back.
Then he continued in the same tone: "As for your second question, I think my name was Zihong or something..."
Vritra: "!!!"
This name definitely rang a bell in Vritra, Teresa, Yasmine and Yennefer's minds, they had also heard of Zihong's inheritance.
This was the demi-god who got stuck on this planet? Wasn't this guy dead?
Vritra had obtained that charge fist from him which later evolved into radioactive fist, and it was a very powerful attack.
It had even helped him against Drino, the level three demon god who almost killed him.
And this guy was the original owner of that skill.
"Yes yes, judging from your shock, you have heard of that name." Omega spoke, his smile widening.
"And seems like you have also been into that inheritance, no?" Omega asked, his gaze focused only on Vritra.
"..." Vritra said nothing, as dust and blood began to swirl around him.
"Haha easy easy, I am not here to fight, not for now at least." Omega said with a shake of his head.
"What exactly are you here for?" Vritra asked, so this guy really was here because of him.
"Nothing much, how about you give me back my skill and the things you took from my treasury?" Omega said in a calm tone.
"Skill? Treasury? What are you talking about? I didn't get anything like that." Vritra shrugged, playing ignorant though he knew this wouldn't work.
Somehow this guy had managed to discover that it was him who had taken those things, so he had his ways.
But how did he escape? Wasn't he supposed to always be locked?
And die in the end.
This was giving him a headache, they had just returned from a nightmare and now this.
Zihong was quite a powerful demi-god, his strength was at level 5 or 6 probably, if he could get his full strength, then Vritra really would be in trouble.

"Haa not that I expected you to give it back just because I asked, the things from the treasury could be given back easily but the skill. It can only be obtained after you are dead, so can you die for me?"
Omega's smile became twisted as he asked, a crazed look on his face.
BANG
Vritra wasted no time, it was obvious this guy was an enemy and it was better to make the first move.
A blade of dust cleaved through the air and cut horizontally, and shockingly, it easily cut Omega into two.
THUD THUD
Both his arms fell off first, near the elbows and then the upper body slid off, cut from near the chest.
The two parts of the body fell down one by one, but Vritra was not done.
BOOOOOM
BANG CRASH SIZZLE
He launched one attack after another, until not a piece of Omega's skin was left, it was all destroyed.
"Huh? We are done? Is that all?" Vritra frowned, there is no way Zihong would be gone just like that.
"Sigh he might come back again, looks like this was just a warning." Yennefer spoke, she had sensed that Zihong was not serious at all just now.
He was just here to tell them what he wanted, or more importantly, warn them.
"Haa And here appears yet another problem, wifey, deal with things here. We will head to meet Tess's ex-family first." Vritra said.
"Hmm" Yasmine nodded.
'Knight stay here.' He ordered, with a level 3 demi-god ranked soul wraith, he would be more assured of her safety.
Not to mention she still had that protective barrier from the divine, so she would be fine.
Now he was starting to feel worried about his other wives too, maybe he was getting too confident and this simple encounter humbled him a great deal.
He still can't be too careless even on this planet, who knows what threats might arrive.
The gods might retaliate too.
They should quickly increase their strength to level 3, as soon as he is done with meeting the Fords, he will do it.
After thinking, Vritra ordered his other soul wraiths to spread and protect his other wives.
Then he created a portal and disappeared with Yennefer and Teresa, Yasmine looked around and sighed.
And here she was hoping to have some peaceful time, and wait a few months to welcome their child.
Soon after Vritra had left, all the other women arrived in the dragon kingdom, they were already done with checking up on various things.
Yasmine explained everything that happened, as they all got serious.
This was indeed a big problem, they had a powerful enemy hidden somewhere, someone who could attack at any time.
And his goal? To kill Vritra...
And from the short encounter with Zihong, he seemed to be the type of guy who would do anything to reach his goal.
So they would have to be extremely careful from now on.
Vritra, Yennefer and Teresa arrived directly inside the Ford realm.
Clearing his mind of the recent event, he wondered how Rich is doing, that is the only good person among the remaining Fords.
He also wondered how that live-in son-in-law of the Fords is doing, Tiny's husband.
It was time to pay them all a visit.

chapters.title: Chapter 749 Luckiest Son-in-law
paragraphs: The Ford realm had been quite peaceful all this time, they didn't really face any problem.
After all, the demons were gone and even the dark organizations were all killed off, so there was no one to fight them.
The strength of the Ford family only increased.
Shen had completely taken over the family as Sir Giant had weakened by a lot after Art Yates took away his special physique.
Jean, the live-in son-in-law of the Ford family, had been nurtured by them, his strength had grown a lot in this time and so had his influence.
Although he had to marry that Tiny for this, but the overall result was great.
He was even happy, after all Art Yates, Teresa and others were all gone and probably were already dead, yet he was still here.
Holding so much power, his mother-in-law liked him quite a lot.
Jean preferred marrying a hoe like Tiny than dying like Art, how could that guy even compare to the awesome him.
And not to mention, he had already gained great control over his wife, she did whatever he wanted, fulfilled all his wishes, and was nothing more than his slave-
"Jean!! Stop daydreaming and get a glass of juice for Rikki and Fen, can't you see how tired they are? Or do you want to die?" Tiny shouted, bringing the dazed Jean to his senses.
"Ah S- Sorry ma'am, I will get the juice right away." He spoke in a hurry, while inwardly crying at his pitiful state.
What had he become?
"Tsk so damn useless, even a pig would be better than you. What use are you, your dick is so tiny it disappears before even reaching inside me!" Tiny said, shaking her head.
She was seated over the lap of a man while another man was licking her feet.
This was life, she really was like a queen.
'That's because your hole is too damn big, you whore!!' Jean retorted, though only in his mind.
He did get nurtured and gained influence but in front of Tiny who held his fate, he was nothing more than a slave.
No, far worse than a slave.
She was always with new men, recently it had gotten worse as she even wanted to see him surrounded by men.
It was some strange fantasy of hers she got to discover recently from some book.
Jean wanted to run away so badly but the wealth and influence of the Fords were too juicy, after tasting it he couldn't let go.
Even if he had to sacrifice his pride and ass for it.
Sighing to himself, he walked towards the kitchen, many guards and servants bowed and greeted him.
Though, the ones who knew inner secrets didn't have any respect for him.
"My dear son-in-law, how are you doing? Where are you going?" Sakshi was in a great mood as she strolled in the hallway and approached Jean.
That demon Art Yates and demoness Teresa had disappeared, Sir Giant and her useless husband Shen had tried to find them to the best of their abilities.
They even tried divinations and other methods and just now, the result that came from one of the divinations made her so happy that she had announced a big dinner party.
'Dead, they are both dead, haa has the air always smelled so good? Has my son-in-law always been this handsome, has the floor always been this clean, I feel like flying...'
She was too happy, her biggest problems were gone.
It was a pity that their slave, Teresa, whom she wanted to make work tirelessly for the rest of her life, was gone too.
But Art's death made her forget those worries. If there is no Teresa, then they could just find another talented person to create all those treasures for them.
Good riddance.
"I am going to bring juice for the lovers of my wife." Jean replied in a suppressed tone, after making sure no one could listen to them.
"Oh how wonderful, ask the kitchen to make it extra cold- oh uh, haha Tiny is still too young, let her play around a bit, once she matures, she will love only you." Sakshi's pupils moved to the left.
And Jean already knew that when she lied, her pupils moved like that.
'So even she knows her whore of a daughter is never going to get better, damnit!!' he cursed in his mind but maintained his polite expression.
"Yes yes, I know. She can play around all she wants, I can even ask the guards to play with her if she is not satisfied by those men she brings, we have a million or so guards right?"
Jean said then laughed as if it was a joke.
SLAP

"You fucking pig, how dare you say that about my daughter! Do you think she is a whore just because she played around a little? Do you want to die? Do you want to see the anger of the entire Ford family? Shennnn, look this basta-"
Jean was terrified, as he quickly knelt and pleaded: "N- No dea- COUGH dear mother-in-law, I was just joking, please don't kill me!" Jean begged.
"My little Jean, get up what are you doing? What will others think if they see you like this, you are my son-in-law, be more dignified." Sakshi really enjoyed the power over others' lives.
Yes, this is exactly how everyone should act, she is the queen, the goddess, all of them should be worshipping her.
'Tiny has been doing too much lately, it wouldn't be good if she got pregnant by some random man's child. I have to make sure she is taking precautions.' She thought.
"Have you seen Rich?" Sakshi asked, patting Jean's shoulder.
"Uh He... I think he was with father-in-law, they were talking about something important and asked me to leave." Jean replied.
"You motherfucking piece of shit, what are you still doing there? Where is the juice?!!" Tiny's loud voice rang out, scaring Jean.
DING DING
Just then the sound of a bell ringing was heard all across the big palace.
"Huh? This bell only rings when someone important has come unannounced and we have to quickly get to the meeting room." Sakshi mumbled.
'Haa I am saved.' Jean was relieved.
"I will deal with you later!" Tiny, who sat over the back of the man who was walking on all fours, said.
Then the four of them headed towards the meeting room wondering who the important person was.
Inside the meeting room, Shen, Sir Giant, and Rich were already present and in front of them sat various people.
The three hadn't expected them to come out of nowhere.
"Uh So how can we help you?" Shen asked, he could be all high and mighty in this world but in front of these people he was like a chicken.
"We have-" just as the man began to speak, the door was pushed open wildly and in rushed four people.
The horse slave, Tiny, Jean and Sakshi.
"W- Woah, the Divine Kage is here? Can I finally join your organization? Can I finally be free?" Jean asked, almost crying.
"No, we have received intel that Vritra Arclis has returned and he is here, are you hiding him?" the question stunned everyone in the room.

chapters.title: Chapter 750 Silence...
paragraphs: "Huh? Vritra?" Sakshi was the first to react, her face scrunched up in contempt.
Why would these people even mention that bastard, he had beaten her up so many times and didn't respect her at all.
"He is dead, we just received the news, why are you here spouting nonsense-" Sakshi flowed in emotions and forgot who she was talking to.
Shen was sweating heavily, as he pulled her arm and made her stop.

"Mother, it seems you forgot to take your meds, how about you go back first? This isn't a meeting someone unburdened by the complexity of thoughts can partake in." Rich said, gesturing for the guards to take her out.
"Shen! I- I will stay quiet." although she was scared, but she wanted to hear more.
Rich sighed but could do nothing, somehow she had gotten her hands on some weakness of Shen.
That is how she had been able to control him all the time.
"Sir, about Vritra, we really don't know anything. We haven't heard anything about him and why would he even come here?"
None of them were still aware that Art Yates and Vritra were the same person, so the doubt was normal.
"He had committed a grave sin, we have received news from someone very high up, someone who works right under the gods." One of the Divine Kage said, his eyes constantly observing them.
There were five members of Divine Kage in the room, the strongest being number thirty while all the others were between thirty and fifty.
All of them had the permission to use the god's punishment.

"We really don't know anything, I am friends with him but it has been a long time since we last met." Rich spoke, even if Vritra was in all that trouble, he wasn't going to end their friendship or pretend they weren't friends.
He didn't like most in his family, they all just looked after profits.
DING DING DING
Just then bells began to ring in the Ford realm, it seemed yet another important guest had arrived uninvited and unannounced.
"We sure are getting a lot of guests today, sigh" Shen shook his head, hoping no new problem would arrive.
"S- Sir how about my recruitmen-" Jean tried to speak, seeing that everyone had fallen silent, waiting for the new guests.
"Shut up!" number 30 silenced him.
Few moments passed in silence then footsteps sounded, there seemed to be more than two people.
'Three people? Who could it be?' hearing the footsteps, they all wondered.
"Well well, what have we got here?"
Just as the anticipation rose, a familiar voice sounded and then a man appeared, following him were two beautiful women.
The person who appeared before them was none other than Art Yates, on one side of him was Teresa and on the other side was some other woman.
Both the women had covered their faces with veils.
"Teresa! Art!" Sir Giant exclaimed as he rose to his feet like a spring, his eyes widening.
They were alive and right in front of him! After all this time, he had understood what he had done wrong.
Although he loved his granddaughter but at some point he too had started to treat her like some sort of tool.
And Art had made him realize it, Sir Giant had changed a great deal especially after that torture from Vritra.
Rushing forward, he pulled the two into a hug.
Rich was also shocked then overjoyed, his aunt was one of the people he cared for the most in the family after all.
"Aunty and Art- Uncle?" he called out, walking towards them too.
"W- What?!" Sakshi took a step back in shock, her face twisted strangely.
How could this be possible? Weren't the two of them already dead? Damn that shaman, that scammer, he was wrong.
Jean looked at Art and just sighed, at this point he couldn't even hate him.
He just felt self-pity, and jealous of him, some people die of thirst while others drown...
Why was the world so unfair?
"Come inside, where have you been all this time? Are you both alright?" Sir Giant pulled them in and made them sit on the chairs.
Then he remembered that there was someone else too, he pulled a chair as Sakshi who was seated on it fell off.
"Please take a seat." Sir Giant said respectfully.
Yennefer nodded and sat beside Vritra, she was sure a great show was about to start.
And it would lighten the mood too.
"Are you two okay?" Rich asked.
"Yes we are completely fine, but looks like you have got some other guests here." Vritra's gaze moved over to the five Divine Kages.
They were staring at him with narrowed eyes, maybe even suspecting he is Vritra.
Vritra wasn't going to delay things and decided to directly blow everyone's mind, but before that.
ACHOO
He sneezed and accidentally a dust knife that had formed in his palm flew towards Sakshi and accidentally stabbed into her thigh.
"H- Huh? What? Uwaaaaaaah m- my leg, aaaaaah I am bleeding!!" she screamed and fell down.
COUGH
Vritra coughed lightly to grab everyone's attention, as they all ignored the painfully writhing bitch.
"We have been away doing something important. Anyway, this is my wife Teresa Arclis, this is my wife Yennefer Arclis and..." Vritra paused a bit, as shocked expressions appeared over their faces.
Yennefer removed the veil from her face, Teresa too removed it but she created a small thin wall before her that made her face a little blurry.
Her appearance could make most men go crazy, so she had to do this.
Rich wasn't really shocked as he already knew Art had many other wives but his next words shocked them all.
"And I am Vritra Arclis."
SILENCE...
For a few moments there was pin-drop silence as they all stared in disbelief at him then the five members of the Divine Kage burst out in loud laughs.
"Hahaha Kid, we were suspicious of you earlier but haha there is no way you can be him."
'Huh? I am telling them directly and they don't believe it?' Vritra was taken aback.
His face after being born again was quite a bit different from before, that might be it.
He used the Internal Shuffle and in front of everyone, his face changed and now he looked like Vritra.
SILENCE...
"Hahaha Kid, where did you learn this trick? Looks like someone decided to play a prank after returning home." One of the Divine Kage spoke.
Vritra: "..."
Were these guys stupid? What was going wrong?
'Haa If I kill one of them, then they will definitely believe.' Vritra shook his head and decided to just prove it in the most perfect way.
Raising his hand, he pointed a finger towards one of the Divine Kage and then.
BOOOM
A dust bullet shot out, hitting the man straight in the forehead, making his entire head explode.
Then even the soul was devoured by some invisible fire.
Sir Giant, Shen, Jean, Tiny, Sakshi, all of them were so shocked, they couldn't think straight.
So all along, Vritra was Art? He was the one to marry Teresa? He even infiltrated the Yates family?
"Hahaha Kid, you sure are full of tricks. I used to do this when I was just born as a Divine Kage, did you use illusion or some other method, interesting."

DING DING DING

ACHOO

COUGH

SILENCE...

SILENCE...

Vritra: "..."

What was going wrong?

BOOOM
